English (遊戲原文): The base fighter-type in The Bard's Tale, warriors can use nearly every weapon there is. For every 4 levels of experience after the 1st, Warriors get an extra attack ability in combat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 戰士是《冰城傳奇》中的基礎戰鬥型職業，幾乎能使用所有武器。從第1級之後，每提升4級經驗等級，戰士在戰鬥中就會獲得一次額外攻擊能力。

English (遊戲原文): Paladins are fighters who have sworn to abstain from all evil and to uphold honor and purity in all places. They can use most weapons and some that no other fighters can. They get multiple attacks at higher levels. They also have a greatly increased resistance to evil magic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 聖騎士是宣誓摒棄一切邪惡、在所有地方堅守榮譽與純潔的戰士。他們能使用大多數武器，甚至包括其他戰士無法使用的某些武器。在高等級時可獲得多次攻擊。他們對邪惡魔法也有極高的抗性。

English (遊戲原文): A professional thief with so-so combat ability, the rogue can hide in shadows, and leap out at distant enemies to land critical hits. They can also search for traps and disarm them. Without a rogue your party will pay very dearly for the booty it wins.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 盜賊是戰鬥能力平平的專業小偷，能隱藏在陰影中，並躍出攻擊遠處的敵人造成暴擊。他們還能搜尋陷阱並將其解除。沒有盜賊，你的隊伍將為獲得的戰利品付出極其慘痛的代價。

English (遊戲原文): The Bard is a wandering minstrel. You'll see them with a tankard of ale in front of them in the less reputable taverns -- the rowdier the better. Their song magic can help your party immensely in and out of combat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 吟遊詩人是流浪的樂手。你會在名聲較差的酒館裡看到他們，面前擺著一杯麥芽酒——越吵鬧的地方越好。他們的歌曲魔法能在戰鬥內外極大地幫助你的隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): An assassin, a mercenary, a ninja. The hunter can use most weapons, and has the ability (which grows with experience) to do critical hits in combat (i.e., to attack a nerve center or other vital area and instantly kill an opponent). A good skill.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 刺客、傭兵、忍者。獵人能使用大多數武器，並擁有隨經驗成長的能力，可在戰鬥中造成暴擊（即攻擊神經中樞或其他要害部位，瞬間殺死對手）。這是個好技能。

English (遊戲原文): A martial artist, an almost inhuman fighting machine trained to fight without weapons or armor. The monk can use them, but, at higher levels particularly, often does better without.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 武僧是武術家，一種近乎非人的戰鬥機器，受過訓練能在不攜帶武器或盔甲的情況下戰鬥。武僧可以使用它們，但在高等級時，通常不裝備反而表現更好。

English (遊戲原文): Conjurers deal in the physical creation and manifestation of real things (like fire, light, healing).
Chinese (請填寫中文): 咒術師擅長實際創造與顯化真實事物（例如火焰、光線、治療）。

English (遊戲原文): Magicians deal with magic as it affects physical objects (i.e., enchanting a sword, making armor stronger, making a dungeon wall disappear).
Chinese (請填寫中文): 幻術師處理影響實體物品的魔法（例如附魔劍、強化盔甲、讓地下城牆壁消失）。

English (遊戲原文): Sorcerers are magic users who deal with the creation and manipulation of illusion. Due to the power of sorcerer spells, this class is not available to newly created characters.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 術士是擅長創造與操控幻象的魔法使用者。由於術士法術的強大力量，這個職業不開放給新創建的角色。

English (遊戲原文): Wizards are magic users who are dedicated to the summoning and binding of various supernatural creatures. These creatures are not friendly to humankind and trying to control them is extremely hazardous. The Wizard-class is not available to new characters either.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 巫師是專注於召喚與束縛各種超自然生物的魔法使用者。這些生物對人類並不友善，試圖控制它們極其危險。巫師職業也不開放給新角色。

English (遊戲原文): These magic users have learned at least three levels for each of the previous four magic user classes. The Archmage is one of the most powerful and important characters in The Destiny Knight because an Archmage can do almost anything. Remember, Lagoth Zanta is an Archmage... fight fire with fire.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這些魔法使用者已精通前四個魔法職業類別中每個至少三級。大法師是《天命勇士》中最強大且最重要的角色之一，因為大法師幾乎無所不能。記住，Lagoth Zanta 就是一位大法師……以火攻火。

English (遊戲原文): Chronomancers are the travel experts of the magic users. Before becoming one, a magic user must master all the spells of any three mage classes. And once you become a Chronomancer, you lose the power to use all the spells you previously learned. It may sound unfair, but the Chronomancer needs to focus all of his or her attention on the important dimension teleport spells. Don't think you can get around without this spellcaster, because you just can't.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 時空術士是法師當中的旅行專家。在成為時空術士之前，法師必須精通任三種法師職業的所有法術。而一旦成為時空術士，你將失去使用先前所學所有法術的能力。這聽起來或許不公平，但時空術士必須將全部心力專注於重要的次元傳送法術。別以為少了這個施法者也能過關，因為你絕對辦不到。

English (遊戲原文): Fighters who want to convert to a life of a magic can become Geomancers. Once they choose to change, they can still use the armor, weapons, and magic items that the fighter classes use. Beware: Bards lose their songs, Warriors lose their multiple attacks, Hunters lose their critical hit ability, and Monks lose their armor class bonus and multiple attacks. It's part of the trade off. To become a Geomancer, you must find the one special location that performs the rite of passage to this mage class.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 想要轉換成魔法生活的戰士可以成為大地術士。一旦他們選擇轉變，仍然可以使用戰士職業適用的護甲、武器與魔法物品。請注意：吟遊詩人會失去他們的歌曲，戰士會失去多重攻擊，獵人會失去暴擊能力，武僧則會失去防禦等級加值與多重攻擊。這是取捨的一部分。要成為大地術士，你必須找到某個特殊地點，進行晉升此法師職業的入門儀式。

English (遊戲原文): While possibly being of hardier stock, this character is nonetheless like you or me.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 雖然體格可能較為強健，但這個角色終究與你我無異。

English (遊戲原文): Patterned after the Tolkien elf, the elf is slight of build, frequently taller and nimbler than a human, and very inclined to magic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 以托爾金筆下的精靈為藍本，精靈身形纖細，通常比人類更高挑、更敏捷，且極具魔法天賦。

English (遊戲原文): The Dwarven people are short and stout, extremely strong and healthy, but not amazingly intelligent (i.e. excellent fighters).
Chinese (請填寫中文): 矮人族身材矮壯，極其強壯健康，但智力並不特別出眾（也就是說，他們是出色的戰士）。

English (遊戲原文): Hobbits are slightly smaller than Dwarves but are nimble and dexterous. Just the right make-up for a rogue.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 哈比人比矮人略小，但身手矯健靈巧。正是當盜賊的料。

English (遊戲原文): These crossbreeds are usually blond and fair-skinned, like elves, and get some added size and strength from their human ancestry.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這些混血兒通常像精靈一樣金髮白膚，並從人類血統中獲得了一些體型和力量上的加成。

English (遊戲原文): An orc is a large, goblin-like creature often found working for evil wizards. The Half-orc, being half human, is not quite as despicable as his orc parent, but you wouldn't want to date one. They are tough but incredibly stupid.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 獸人是體型龐大、類似哥布林的生物，常為邪惡巫師效力。半獸人因具有一半人類血統，不像其獸人親族那般可憎，但你絕對不會想跟牠約會。牠們強悍但極度愚蠢。

English (遊戲原文): Gnomes closely resemble dwarves, but have less hair and even shorter tempers. They are also more magically inclined, as a rule. Highly intelligent but not very robust.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 地侏與矮人極為相似，但毛髮較少，脾氣也更暴躁。一般來說，他們也更傾向於魔法。智力極高，但體魄不算強健。

English (遊戲原文): Strength is physical power and chiefly affects the amount of damage a character can do to an opponent in hand-to-hand combat. Make sure your fighting characters are strong.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 力量代表體能，主要影響角色在近身戰鬥中能對敵人造成的傷害量。請確保你的戰鬥型角色擁有足夠的力量。

English (遊戲原文): Intelligence is mental power. A high intelligence will enable your magic users to get bonus spell points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 智力代表心智能力。高智力能讓你的魔法使用者獲得額外的法術點數。

English (遊戲原文): Measures agility & nimbleness. A high score makes your characters harder to hit and helps them strike the first blow in combat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 衡量靈巧與敏捷度。高敏捷值能讓你的角色更難被擊中，並有助於在戰鬥中搶先出手。

English (遊戲原文): Measures healthiness. It takes more damage to kill a character with a high constitution score. This is reflected in bonus "hit points", the character's life span.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 衡量健康程度。體質高的角色需要承受更多傷害才會死亡。這體現在額外的「生命值」上，也就是角色的壽命。

English (遊戲原文): Luck is an ambiguous attribute, as it has a number of unseen effects on gameplay. For example, lucky characters are more likely to resist evil magic and avoid nasty traps.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 幸運是一個模糊的屬性，對遊戲有許多看不見的影響。例如，幸運的角色更容易抵抗邪惡魔法並避開惱人的陷阱。

English (遊戲原文): Hit Points measure the damage a character can take before they are killed. The current status is shown in the characters status bar, followed by their current maximum potential.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 生命值衡量角色在死亡前能承受的傷害。當前狀態顯示在角色狀態列中，後方則為目前的最大潛力值。

English (遊戲原文): This shows current spell point status. Points are used up with each cast of a magic spell. If a Conjurer has 20 spell points and casts a Mage Flame spell at a cost of 2 spell points, his new total would be 18. The characters status line lists both their current and maximum spell points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此處顯示目前的法術點數狀態。每次施展法術都會消耗法術點數。如果咒術師有20點法術點數，並施展消耗2點法術點數的「法師火焰」法術，那麼新的總數將變為18。角色的狀態列會同時列出目前與最大法術點數。

Chinese (請填寫中文): 法師隊伍中的所有成員將獲得完美的夜視能力，效果永久持續。你的敏銳視力也將讓你能夠辨識祕門。

English (遊戲原文): Causes a group of your enemies to fear you greatly, lessening their morale and their ability to hit and damage you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使一群敵人對你極度恐懼，降低他們的士氣以及命中與傷害你的能力。

English (遊戲原文): This incantation is very likely to instantly kill one selected enemy, big or small.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此咒語極有可能立即殺死一名選定的敵人，無論大小。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will do {0}-{1} points of damage to a single demon. The power to summon is the power to destroy.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術將對單一惡魔造成 {0} 至 {1} 點傷害。召喚之力即毀滅之力。

English (遊戲原文): This spell works like Demon Bane, but it will affect an entire group of demons.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術效果與惡魔剋星相同，但會影響一整群惡魔。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will reveal the true nature of any illusion attacking the party, causing it to instantly vanish.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術將揭露任何攻擊隊伍的幻象的真實本質，使其瞬間消失。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will make any possessed party member return to their normal state.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術將使任何被附身的隊伍成員恢復正常狀態。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will destroy any illusion fighting the party, and any new illusions created later in the combat. It will also point out any doppelgangers in the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術將摧毀任何與隊伍作戰的幻象，以及在戰鬥中後續產生的新幻象。它也會指出隊伍中的任何變形怪。

English (遊戲原文): This powerful spell earns its name by doing the following: 1) Turns illusionary characters into real characters; 2) Cures characters of all illnesses but age; and 3) Restores all hit points to the party. If you're in combat, it also does the following: 1) Lowers your armor class, saving throw, to hit, and damage by 20 points; 2) Increases your attack by eight points; and 3) Casts Mangar's Mallet.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個強大的法術名副其實，效果如下：1) 將幻影角色轉變為真實角色；2) 治癒角色所有疾病（衰老除外）；3) 恢復隊伍所有生命值。若在戰鬥中使用，還會：1) 降低你的防禦等級、豁免檢定、命中與傷害20點；2) 提升你的攻擊力8點；3) 施展「曼加的槌子」。

English (遊戲原文): Allows the mage to breathe fire at a group of foes, doing {0}-{1} points of damage to each.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 讓法師能對一群敵人噴吐火焰，對每個目標造成 {0} 至 {1} 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): This powerful spell earns its name by doing the following: 1) Turns illusionary characters into real characters; 2) Cures characters of all illnesses but age; and 3) Restores all hit points to the party. If you're in combat, it also does the following: 1) Lowers your armor class, saving throw, to hit, and damage by 20 points; 2) Increases your attack by eight points; and 3) Casts Mangar's Mallet. When used out of combat, the Dreamspell can be used to escape the current dungeon.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個強大的法術名副其實，效果如下：1) 將幻影角色轉變為真實角色；2) 治癒角色所有疾病（衰老除外）；3) 恢復隊伍所有生命值。若在戰鬥中使用，還會：1) 降低你的防禦等級、豁免檢定、命中與傷害20點；2) 提升你的攻擊力8點；3) 施展「曼加的槌子」。若在非戰鬥狀態下使用，夢之法術可用來逃離當前的地下城。

English (遊戲原文): Cuts down the enemy with holy daggers for 200 to 800 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 以神聖匕首斬殺敵人，造成 200 至 800 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Summons an Earth Elemental, which is a creature created from the raw elements of the earth.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 召喚一個土元素，這是由大地原始元素構成的生物。

English (遊戲原文): Commands the ground beneath the enemy's feet to open wide and drop the foes in, so they're never seen again.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 命令敵人腳下的地面裂開大洞，將敵人吞沒，使其永不見天日。

English (遊戲原文): Reveals all booby-trapped areas that can injure the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 揭露所有可能傷害隊伍的陷阱區域。

English (遊戲原文): Casts the Trap Zap spell on the entire level.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 對整個樓層施放陷阱電擊法術。

English (遊戲原文): This incantation will cause a real ogre to appear and join the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此咒語將召喚一個真實的食人魔出現並加入隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): Materializes a slayer who joins your party. What's a slayer? The name speaks for itself...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 實體化一個屠殺者加入你的隊伍。什麼是屠殺者？顧名思義……

English (遊戲原文): With this spell the caster can make a real wolf appear and join the party, fighting in its defense.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 施法者藉由此法術能讓一頭真實的狼出現並加入隊伍，為其戰鬥防禦。

English (遊戲原文): Lands a cone of gravitational energy on a group of your foes, inflicting {0}-{1} points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 對一群敵人釋放圓錐狀的重力能量，造成 {0} 至 {1} 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Launches a chilling ice missile against a group of foes, inflicting 100-400 damage points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 對一群敵人發射冰冷的寒冰飛彈，造成 100 至 400 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): A long-range spell that drops a distant foe dead in its tracks.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一種長程法術，能讓遠處的敵人當場斃命。

English (遊戲原文): Pushes a group of foes 40 feet further away from your party, up to a total distance of 90 feet.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將一群敵人推離你的隊伍 40 英尺，最遠可達 90 英尺。

English (遊戲原文): Crushes the enemy under an unearthly gravitational force for 400-1500 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 以超凡的重力碾碎敵人，造成 400 至 1500 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Creates a cyclone of flame that lashes out and delivers {0}-{1} points of damage to a group of your foes.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 創造一道火焰旋風，猛烈襲擊一群敵人，造成 {0} 至 {1} 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): This spell behaves like the "Flesh Restore" spell, except that it will affect every member of the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術效果如同「血肉復原」，但會影響隊伍中的每一位成員。

English (遊戲原文): This powerful healing spell will restore {0}-{1} hit points to a party member and cure poisoning and insanity.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個強大的治療法術能恢復一名隊伍成員 {0} 至 {1} 點生命值，並治癒中毒與瘋狂狀態。

English (遊戲原文): Casts Witherfist and Sandstorm for a double offensive punch.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 同時施展枯萎拳與沙塵暴，形成雙重攻勢。

English (遊戲原文): This spell binds your enemies with a magical force, slowing their movements and making them easier to hit.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術以魔法力量束縛你的敵人，減緩其行動速度，使其更容易被擊中。

English (遊戲原文): Blasts the enemy with a deadly frost for 50 to 400 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 以致命的寒霜轟擊敵人，造成 50 至 400 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Bids a shadowy wraith to unwillingly join your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 強迫一名陰影幽靈不情願地加入你的隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): Instills tremendous power in your party, increasing their strike ability by 10.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 為你的隊伍注入龐大力量，使其打擊能力提升 10 點。

English (遊戲原文): This survival spell lets your party breathe under water. It is cumulative in effect; casting it more than once will extend the amount of time you can spend underwater.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這個生存法術讓你的隊伍能在水下呼吸。效果可累積；多次施展能延長你待在水下的時間。

English (遊戲原文): Impales the enemy with an icy stalagmite, causing 400 to 1600 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 以冰錐刺穿敵人，造成 400 至 1600 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): A holy spell where blazing red fires are sent from the angry gods to roast the enemy for 60 to 240 damage points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一道神聖法術，憤怒諸神降下熾紅烈焰灼燒敵人，造成 60 至 240 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): The finest in offensive obliteration, this spell annihilates the opponent for around 2000 damage points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 最頂尖的攻擊性毀滅法術，能徹底消滅對手，造成約 2000 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Casts Beyond Death and Regeneration for a life-giving combination of spells.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 同時施展「超越死亡」與「再生」，形成賦予生命的複合法術組合。

English (遊戲原文): Like a "Lesser Revelation" spell, only it illuminates a wider area.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 如同「小啟示」法術，但能照亮更廣闊的區域。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will gate a greater demon into our universe and bind him to the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此術將召喚一名大惡魔進入我們的世界，並使其聽命於冒險隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): A Beyond Death spell that resurrects every dead party member (except those turned to stone), and heals all wounds, paralysis, and insanity."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一種「超越死亡」法術，能復活所有死亡的隊伍成員（石化者除外），並治癒所有傷勢、麻痺與瘋狂。

English (遊戲原文): A spray of water will emanate from the mage's fingers, doing 6-24 points of damage to any undead foe (e.g. skeleton, zombie, vampire).
Chinese (請填寫中文): 法師指尖噴射出聖水，對任何不死敵人（如骷髏、殭屍、吸血鬼）造成 6 至 24 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): If successfully cast, this spell will make a group of your enemies miss the next combat round.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 若成功施放，此術將使一群敵人在下一回合戰鬥中無法行動。

English (遊戲原文): Pummels a group of monsters with chunks of ice, causing 20-80 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 以冰塊猛擊一群怪物，造成 20 至 80 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Cast this spell on something to find out just what the heck it is.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 對某物施放此術，以查明它到底是什麼玩意兒。

English (遊戲原文): Wrenches the earth below the enemy, smashing them to the ground and gives them a jolting electrical shock to cause 400-1600 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 扭曲敵人腳下的大地，將其猛摔在地，並施以強烈電擊，造成 400 至 1600 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): A Compass of shimmering magelight appears above the party, telling the direction they face.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一道閃爍著魔法光芒的指南針出現在隊伍上方，指示他們面對的方向。

English (遊戲原文): This invocation will perform a Vanishing Spell on the entire party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此咒語將對整支隊伍施展「消失術」。

English (遊戲原文): The mage casting this spell will turn nearly invisible in the eyes of their enemies, who will have great difficulty in striking them.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 施放此術的法師在敵人眼中近乎隱形，敵人將極難擊中他們。

English (遊戲原文): This is an extended "Mage Flame" spell which also reveals secret doors.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這是「法師火焰」的強化版，還能揭露隱藏門扉。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will gate into our universe a lower power elemental or demon, who will (under protest) join the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術會將一個低階元素或惡魔召喚至我們的宇宙，該生物將（在抗議下）加入隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): Partially negates the effect of gravity on the party, giving a 75% chance to avoid traps and allowing them to travel up through portals.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 部分抵消重力對隊伍的影響，給予75%機率避開陷阱，並允許他們向上穿越傳送門。

English (遊戲原文): In a state of magically-heightened awareness, the spell caster will be able to sense a trap within 30 feet, if they face it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在魔法強化的感知狀態下，施法者若面對陷阱，能察覺30呎內的陷阱。

English (遊戲原文): Increases your chances of hitting or defending by eight points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 提升你命中或防禦的機率八點。

English (遊戲原文): A small, mobile "torch" will appear, and float above the caster as they travel.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個小型、可移動的「火炬」會出現，並在施法者移動時漂浮於其上方。

English (遊戲原文): Makes a party member's hands (or weapon) more deadly, adding 4-16 points of damage to every wound they inflict.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使隊伍成員的雙手（或武器）更具殺傷力，每次造成傷口時額外增加4-16點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Assaults a group of opposing spellcasters and may do one of the following: inflict {0}-{1} points of damage, turn them to stone, or kill them outright. However, because the maelstrom is illusionary in nature, a disbelieving enemy can totally nullify it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 攻擊一群敵對施法者，可能造成以下效果之一：造成 {0}-{1} 點傷害、將他們石化，或直接擊殺。然而，由於漩渦本質上是幻象，不相信的敵人可完全抵銷其效果。

English (遊戲原文): Burns a group of foes with a blast of hot, fiery magma for 300-1200 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 以熾熱的岩漿噴射灼燒一群敵人，造成300-1200點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): This will make the party levitate, as does the level 3 spell, but its effects will last until dispelled.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 如同三級法術般使隊伍漂浮，但其效果將持續直到被解除。

English (遊戲原文): Inflicts 200-800 bone-crushing damage points against every monster group you face.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 對你面對的每個怪物群組造成200-800點碎骨般的傷害。

English (遊戲原文): A sharp explosion of psychic energy that inflicts {0}-{1} points of damage to each and every enemy you face.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一股強烈的精神能量爆炸，對你面對的每個敵人造成{0}-{1}點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): A higher power "Mind Jab", does 3-12 points of damage to one foe, times the experience level of the mage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 更高階的「心靈刺擊」，對一名敵人造成3-12點傷害，乘以法師的經驗等級。

English (遊戲原文): The mage casts a concentrated blast of psychic energy at one opponent doing 2-8 points of damage for each experience level of the mage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 法師對一名敵人施放集中的精神能量衝擊，造成法師每個經驗等級2-8點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Pull an attacking group into melee range (10') regardless of how far they were when they began attacking.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將攻擊中的群組拉至近戰範圍（10呎），無論他們開始攻擊時距離多遠。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will make a member of your party go totally insane. Useful for possessions.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術會使你的隊伍成員完全陷入瘋狂。對抗附身狀態時有用。

English (遊戲原文): Increases the armor protection of each party member by enhancing their armor's natural strength by magic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 以魔法強化每位隊員護甲的自然強度，提升其防護力。

English (遊戲原文): If successful, this spell causes every attacking group to do nothing during the next round.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 若成功施放，此法術將使所有攻擊群組在下一回合內無法行動。

English (遊戲原文): Allows a member of your party to damage monsters as if they were as incredibly strong as an ogre.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 讓隊伍中的一名成員能像食人魔般力大無窮，對怪物造成傷害。

English (遊戲原文): An instant map, this shows the entire maze that the party's in.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 立即顯示隊伍所在整個迷宮的地圖。

English (遊戲原文): Turns an enemy up to 60 feet away into the hardest stone.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將最遠 60 呎內的敵人化為最堅硬的石頭。

English (遊戲原文): The entire party will seem to waver and blur in the sight of the monsters, making the party very difficult to strike.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 整個隊伍在怪物眼中變得搖曳模糊，極難被擊中。

English (遊戲原文): This incantation will alter the structure of almost any wall directly in front of the party, turning it to air for exactly 1 move.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此咒語能改變隊伍正前方幾乎任何牆壁的結構，使其化為空氣，持續恰好 1 次移動。

English (遊戲原文): This spell hurls porcupine-sharp needles from the mages finger into a selected monster, poisoning it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術從法師指尖射出豪豬般尖銳的毒針，擊中並使選定的怪物中毒。

English (遊戲原文): Keeps the enemy from being able to summon any creatures.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 阻止敵人召喚任何生物。

English (遊戲原文): Has a 80% chance of preventing enemies from summoning creatures.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 有 80% 機率阻止敵人召喚生物。

English (遊戲原文): This spell gates in a medium level elemental or demon, to fight with the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術召喚一個中階元素生物或惡魔，與隊伍並肩作戰。

English (遊戲原文): Regenerates 8 hit points for a character, up to the character's maximum hit point level.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 為一名角色恢復 8 點生命值，最高恢復至該角色的生命值上限。

English (遊戲原文): Return to the Wilderness from Arboria.
Return from Gelidia to the Wilderness.
Return from Kinestia to the Wilderness.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 從基內斯提亞返回荒野。

English (遊戲原文): Return the party from Lucencia to the Wilderness.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將隊伍從盧森西亞返回荒野。

English (遊戲原文): Return from Malefia to the Wilderness.
Return the party from Tarmitia to the Wilderness.
Return to the Wilderness from Tenebrosia.
A health spell that revives all the hit points for one lucky member of the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一種恢復法術，能為隊伍中一名幸運成員恢復所有生命值。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will do 16-80 points of damage to a group of undead creatures.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術能對一群亡靈生物造成16到80點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Makes all wounds disappear as your entire party is reforged into unflawed bodies. Also cures poisoning and insanity.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 讓所有傷口消失，使整支隊伍重塑為完美無瑕之軀。同時也能治療中毒與瘋狂狀態。

English (遊戲原文): Rakes enemies with shards of ice, inflicting 50 to 200 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 以冰晶碎片掃向敵人，造成50到200點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Reveals to the party where the anti-magic areas are.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 向隊伍揭示反魔法區域的位置。

English (遊戲原文): Causes all metal near the party to glow with magical light, illuminating the surrounding area.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使隊伍附近所有金屬散發魔法光芒，照亮周圍區域。

English (遊戲原文): Makes all stone and earth within range of the party glow with magical light, revealing even secret doors.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使隊伍範圍內的所有石頭與大地散發魔法光芒，甚至能顯露隱藏門扉。

English (遊戲原文): Teleports your entire party to the Adventurers' Guild, minus all gold. Use this spell only in dire emergencies.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將整支隊伍傳送至冒險者公會，但會失去所有金幣。僅在緊急危難時使用此法術。

English (遊戲原文): Shows all mage regeneration squares, so your spellcasters can be refreshed.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 顯示所有法師恢復方格，讓施法者得以恢復法力。

English (遊戲原文): With a violent swirl of sand, all foes are whipped back 60 feet.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 以猛烈的沙塵漩渦，將所有敵人擊退60英尺。

English (遊戲原文): The walls themselves will speak, under direction of this spell, revealing to the spell caster their location in the labyrinth. This spell works even in areas resistant to magic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在此法術引導下，牆壁本身會開口說話，向施法者揭示他們在迷宮中的位置。此法術即使在抗魔法區域也能生效。

English (遊戲原文): The mage will experience heightened awareness and be able to sense stairways, special encounters, spell negation zones, traps and other unusual occurrences.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 法師將獲得增強的感知力，能夠察覺樓梯、特殊遭遇、法術無效區域、陷阱及其他異常事件。

English (遊戲原文): Casts a gray shadow around the party, and lowers their armor class by 4.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在隊伍周圍施放一道灰色暗影，降低防禦等級4點。

English (遊戲原文): A large globe of intense electrical energy envelops a group of enemies, doing {0}-{1} points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一顆巨大的強烈電能球體包圍一群敵人，造成{0}-{1}點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): The mage is protected by an invisible "shield" of magic, that turns aside many blows that would otherwise hit them.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 法師受到一道看不見的魔法「護盾」保護，能擋開許多原本會擊中他們的攻擊。

English (遊戲原文): This spell functions the same as the Second Sight spell, but it will last indefinitely.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術效果與「千里眼」相同，但持續時間無限。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will drain a single enemy of {0}-{1} points of damage, as if touched by a spectre.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術會對單一敵人造成{0}-{1}點傷害，如同被幽靈觸碰一般。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will gate in a higher-level undead creature to fight for the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術會召喚一隻高等級亡靈生物為隊伍作戰。

English (遊戲原文): The air surrounding a group of your enemies will instantly ignite, causing them to be burnt for 6-24 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一群敵人周圍的空氣會瞬間點燃，造成6-24點灼燒傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Takes a character who has been turned to stone and restores him to his natural flesh state.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 將一名被石化的角色恢復成原本的血肉之軀。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will turn an enemy to stone, but won't affect a creature already made of stone.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術會將一名敵人石化，但對已經由石頭構成的生物無效。

English (遊戲原文): Whips out a tendril of psionic (mind) power to strike a selected foe, inflicting {0} to {1} damage points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 揮出一道靈能（心靈）觸鬚攻擊選定的敵人，造成{0}至{1}點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): An electric spell that gives the enemy a high-voltage zap for 50 to 200 damage points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一道電系法術，對敵人施以高壓電擊，造成50至200點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Shows all heal-party squares, so your party can put an end to their weakness and pain.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 顯示所有治療隊伍的方格，讓你的隊伍得以終結虛弱與痛苦。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will gate into our universe a zombie or skeleton to fight for the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術會將一隻殭屍或骷髏召喚到我們的世界，為隊伍作戰。

English (遊戲原文): Creates a fire-being from the raw elements of the universe to join and fight for your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 從宇宙的原始元素中創造一個火焰生物，加入並為你的隊伍作戰。

English (遊戲原文): Summons Herb to join your party. Herb is really busy, but he'll hang out with your party for a while if you need him.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 召喚赫伯加入你的隊伍。赫伯很忙，但如果你需要他，他會陪你的隊伍待一陣子。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will bring a medium level undead creature into the party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術會召喚一個中等級的不死生物加入隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): A magical illusion appears in the party. Unable to attack, it will serve to draw enemy attacks to himself.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個魔法幻影出現在隊伍中。無法攻擊，但會吸引敵人的攻擊到自己身上。

English (遊戲原文): The brothers are always ready to help friends in trouble. Enough brothers appear to fill the empty slots in your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這對兄弟總是樂於幫助陷入困境的朋友。出現足夠的兄弟來填滿隊伍中的空位。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will disarm any trap within 30 feet, in the direction the party is facing. It will also disarm traps on chests.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術會解除隊伍面向方向三十呎內的任何陷阱。也能解除寶箱上的陷阱。

English (遊戲原文): Fries all foes with wickedly hot flames for 150 to 600 points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 用極度灼熱的火焰燒烤所有敵人，造成 150 到 600 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Invigorates a character by healing 4 to 8 hit points times the spellcaster's level.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 恢復一名角色的活力，治療量為施法者等級乘以 4 到 8 點生命值。

English (遊戲原文): This spell causes the weapon (or hands) of a party member to be covered with a magical field, which causes them to do an additional 2-8 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術使一名隊員的武器（或雙手）覆蓋一層魔法力場，使其額外造成 2-8 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): An electric spell that creates a pyrotechnical storm over a group of monsters, inflicting {0} to {1} damage points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個閃電法術，在一群怪物上方引發一場煙火風暴，造成 {0} 到 {1} 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Dissolve the dungeon wall that the party if facing. Lasts until the party leaves the dungeon.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 溶解隊伍面對的地下城牆壁。效果持續到隊伍離開地下城為止。

English (遊戲原文): Causes a spray of energy to spring from the caster's extended finger, sizzling a group of opponents for {0}-{1} points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 從施法者伸出的指尖噴出一道能量束，灼燒一群對手，造成 {0}-{1} 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): This incantation will create an illusionary red dragon to fight with your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此咒語會創造一隻幻影紅龍與你的隊伍並肩作戰。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will create an illusionary storm giant, to join with, and fight for, your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術會創造一個幻影風暴巨人，加入你的隊伍並為其戰鬥。

English (遊戲原文): Creates an illusionary hero to join your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 創造一個幻影英雄加入你的隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): Creates an illusionary Archmage to join your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 創造一個幻影大法師加入你的隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will create the illusion of an ogre, which will accompany and fight with your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術會創造一個食人魔的幻影，它會伴隨你的隊伍並與之並肩作戰。

English (遊戲原文): This spell will create the illusion of a battle-ready warrior that joins your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術將創造出一個備戰戰士的幻影，加入你的隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): This spell creates an illusionary wolf to join the party. This and other illusions are only effective as long as an enemy "believes" them. Depending on power and location, the monster may see through the illusion, and cause it to vanish.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此法術創造出一隻幻影狼加入隊伍。此幻影與其他幻術僅在敵人「相信」時有效。根據力量與地點，怪物可能看穿幻影，使其消失。

English (遊戲原文): Any foe at whom this spell is cast is likely to be turned old, thus reducing their ability to attack and defend in combat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 任何被施以此法術的敵人很可能變得衰老，從而降低其在戰鬥中攻擊與防禦的能力。

English (遊戲原文): Crushes a group of enemies under a huge fist of power for 300 to 600 points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 以一隻巨大的力量之拳壓碎一群敵人，造成 300 到 600 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Creates a wall of force that travels with the party and absorbs many of the enemy's attacks.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 創造一道力牆，跟隨隊伍移動，並吸收許多敵人的攻擊。

English (遊戲原文): This incantation will make a group of your enemies shake in fear, reducing their ability to attack and do damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此咒語將使一群敵人因恐懼而顫抖，降低其攻擊與造成傷害的能力。

English (遊戲原文): With the utterance of a single word the spell caster can cure a party member of minor wounds, healing {0}-{1} points of damage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 只需說出一個字，施法者即可治癒一名隊伍成員的輕傷，恢復 {0}-{1} 點傷害。

English (遊戲原文): Makes a member of your party fight with the strength and accuracy of ancient Norse heroes for the entire combat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使一名隊伍成員在整場戰鬥中以古代北歐英雄的力量與精準度作戰。

English (遊戲原文): The air in front of the party will bind itself into metallic hardness, and will accompany the party when it moves, as a sort of invisible "shield".
Chinese (請填寫中文): 隊伍前方的空氣將凝結成金屬般的硬度，並在隊伍移動時跟隨，如同一面隱形的「盾牌」。

English (遊戲原文): Causes an effect like "Air Armor" to cover every member of the party, lasting indefinitely.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 產生類似「空氣護甲」的效果，覆蓋隊伍中的每一名成員，效果永久持續。

English (遊戲原文): Coats a character with a light, fragrant lotion to cure oldness.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 為一名角色塗上輕盈芬芳的乳液，以治癒衰老狀態。

English (遊戲原文): This appears to be the old stables, now converted into a storage space since the horses were eaten long ago when Mangar's ghastly creatures roamed the streets.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這看起來是舊馬廄，自從馬匹在很久以前被曼加的恐怖生物在街上遊蕩時吃掉後，就被改造成了儲藏空間。

English (遊戲原文): Looks pretty empty at the moment.\nWould you like to leave some items here?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 目前看起來相當空曠。\n你想在這裡留下一些物品嗎？

English (遊戲原文): Would you like to inspect the place for items, or drop off some of your own?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你想檢查這個地方是否有物品，還是放下一些自己的東西？

English (遊戲原文): Who would like to inspect the items to take?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 誰要檢查可取走的物品？

English (遊戲原文): Who would like to leave some items in the storage house?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 誰要將一些物品存放在儲藏室？

English (遊戲原文): Your inventory is full. You must drop some items to make space.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你的道具欄已滿。你必須丟棄一些物品以騰出空間。

English (遊戲原文): {0} has no unequipped items to leave...
Chinese (請填寫中文): {0} 沒有未裝備的物品可以留下……
你位於霍克·斯卡巴德街
你位於吟遊詩人紋章街

English (遊戲原文): As you enter the guild, you catch the eye of the Guild Master.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 當你走進公會時，你引起了公會長的注意。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): "Well met, brave adventurer, but you come in the most dire of times."\n\n"The evil wizard, Mangar, has cursed our town with this blizzard, and the streets are overrun with all matter of evil miscreants."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「幸會，勇敢的冒險者，但你來得正是最危急的時刻。」\n\n「邪惡的巫師曼加爾，用這場暴風雪詛咒了我們城鎮，街上到處都是各種邪惡的惡徒。」

English (遊戲原文): "You must help us defeat Mangar! In this guild you will find many skilled warriors and mages that would join you in this quest."\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「你必須幫助我們擊敗曼加爾！在這間公會裡，你會找到許多技藝精湛的戰士與法師，願意加入你這趟任務。」\n\n

English (遊戲原文): "When your party is ready, set out into town. Be sure to visit Garth's Shoppe to the north and equip yourself for battle. He has the finest weapons and armour in Skara Brae, and indeed is the only shoppe brave enough to open these days!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「當你的隊伍準備好之後，就出發進城吧。記得去北邊的加斯商店，為戰鬥做好裝備。他那裡有斯卡拉布雷最好的武器與護甲，說真的，現在還敢開門營業的商店也就只剩他這一家了！」

English (遊戲原文): "The city has an abundance of temples that are open night and day to heal your wounds, and I believe Roscoe is still doing good business restoring magic points for your mages."\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「城裡有許多神廟，日夜開放為你治療傷勢，而且我相信羅斯科還在繼續做他的好生意，幫你的法師恢復法術點數。」\n\n

English (遊戲原文): "And when your bard gets thirsty, be sure to visit one of the many Inns and Taverns. The Scarlet Bard, to the south, has the best selection in town!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「而當你的吟遊詩人渴了，記得去拜訪其中一間旅館或酒館。南邊的『緋紅吟遊詩人』，可是全城選擇最豐富的地方！」

English (遊戲原文): "Now I will bid you good day and good luck in your quest!"\n\nThe guild master smiles and returns to what he was doing.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那麼我就祝你日安，任務順利！」\n\n公會長微微一笑，轉身繼續忙他的事了。

English (遊戲原文): You have stepped out into the town of Skara Brae for the first time. Would you like a quick tutorial on the game controls before you proceed?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你初次踏入了斯卡拉布雷鎮。在繼續前進之前，是否要快速學習遊戲操作教學？

English (遊戲原文): Use W,A,S,D to move around the town, or the cursor keys. You can also left click on the game view to move around.\n\nHold down right mouse on the game view and you can look around to take in the view.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使用 W、A、S、D 鍵或方向鍵在鎮上移動。你也可以在遊戲畫面上按左鍵來移動。\n\n在遊戲畫面上按住右鍵，即可環顧四周欣賞景色。

English (遊戲原文): There is a Pause button at the top left of the game view that gives access to graphics, audio and game settings, as well as saving or loading the game.\n\nThere is an Actions button on the top right of the game view that will drop down a ribbon of actions to choose from. These actions are not usable during game events.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 遊戲畫面左上角有一個「暫停」按鈕，可用來調整圖形、音效與遊戲設定，以及儲存或載入遊戲進度。\n\n遊戲畫面右上角有一個「行動」按鈕，點擊後會下拉一排行動選項。請注意，這些行動在遊戲事件進行中無法使用。

English (遊戲原文): You can change the speed that combat messages scroll by pressing the 'greater than' and 'less than' keys, or by adjusting the slider in the 'game settings' menu.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你可以按下「大於」與「小於」鍵，或在「遊戲設定」選單中調整滑桿，來改變戰鬥訊息捲動的速度。

English (遊戲原文):
Pressing 1 to 7 lets you view the stats of one of your party members.

If you left click and drag with your mouse on one of the party member names below, you can change their position in the party. Only the first 4 character slots can be hit by enemy melee attacks.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
按下 1 到 7 鍵可檢視隊伍中某位成員的狀態。

如果你在下方任一隊員名稱上按住左鍵並拖曳滑鼠，即可改變他們在隊伍中的位置。只有前 4 個角色欄位會受到敵人的近戰攻擊。

English (遊戲原文): You should try to keep a character slot free so that you can summon creatures or allow roving monsters to join your party.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你應該保留一個角色空位，這樣才能召喚生物或讓遊蕩的怪物加入你的隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): Below the game view, totals of your party's gold and inventory items are shown.\n\nAny item that is not equipped by a character will go into the communal inventory and is accessible through any player's inventory screen.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在遊戲畫面下方，會顯示隊伍的總金幣與道具庫存數量。\n\n任何未由角色裝備的物品都會進入共用庫存，並可透過任一角色的道具欄畫面存取。

English (遊戲原文): That is all... Now go and stop Mangar!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 就這樣了……現在去吧，阻止曼加爾！

English (遊戲原文): You have entered the home of Longinus the Mad. He is busy writing in a tome, but lowers his quill as he sees you entering, then abruptly rises to greet you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你進入了瘋狂的隆基努斯的住所。他正忙著在一本巨冊上書寫，但一見你進來便放下羽毛筆，隨即起身迎接你。

English (遊戲原文): The home of Longinus the Mad.
Longinus looks away and mumbles,\n\n"Go then, if you were even here, for I was not..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 隆基努斯移開目光，喃喃自語道：\n\n「去吧，就算你真的來過，我也不曾在此…」

English (遊戲原文): He is lost in thought for a moment, then looks at you and proclaims\n\n"Twice will the Lestradae come for Caith... once for gold and once for faith."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他沉思片刻，然後看著你宣告道：\n\n「萊斯特拉德會為凱斯而來兩次……一次為黃金，一次為信仰。」

English (遊戲原文): Twice will the Lestradae come for Caith... once for gold and once for faith.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 萊斯特拉德將兩度找上凱斯……一次為黃金，一次為信仰。

English (遊戲原文): He withdraws into himself, and looking down, mutters\n\n"Summer follows Winter, Darkness follows Day, Singing follows Sorrow, as they stride through Skara Brae."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他縮回自己的世界，低頭喃喃自語\n\n「夏日隨冬去，黑暗隨晝來，歌聲隨悲傷，他們大步走過斯卡拉布雷。」

English (遊戲原文): Summer follows Winter, Darkness follows Day, Singing follows Sorrow, as they stride through Skara Brae.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 夏日隨冬去，黑暗隨晝來，歌聲隨悲傷，他們大步走過斯卡拉布雷。

English (遊戲原文): He steps towards you and whispers in your ear\n\n"Mangar the Dark is but the first, thrice more will come to Caith the cursed."

Chinese (請填寫中文): 兩條沉睡的巨龍因你的經過而甦醒。「高爾，又是人類當晚餐，」較小的那條說。「我們這裡怎麼都吃不到豬肉？」

English (遊戲原文): As Gor gasps his last, he croaks out, "we should have sent out for pizza instead... Aaaaahhrrrrgg..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 高爾嚥下最後一口氣時，嘶啞地說：「我們當初應該叫披薩外送才對……呃啊啊啊……」

English (遊戲原文): Your music caused two sleeping dragons to continue slumbering.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你的音樂讓兩條沉睡的巨龍繼續安眠。

English (遊戲原文): There is a pair of dragons snoring quite loudly here.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一對巨龍正鼾聲如雷。

English (遊戲原文):
A magic mouth on the wall speaks:

"Name the greatest son of Odin and win his aid."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
牆上的魔法嘴說道：

「說出奧丁最偉大的兒子之名，以獲得他的幫助。」

English (遊戲原文): "Brush up on your mythology and come back later!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「回去複習你的神話學，晚點再來吧！」

English (遊戲原文): We were awarded a small figurine of Thor
Chinese (請填寫中文): 我們獲得了一尊索爾的小雕像

English (遊戲原文): On the wall to the north are etched 3 geometric shapes: a square, a circle, and a triangle.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 北面的牆上刻有三個幾何圖形：一個正方形、一個圓形和一個三角形。

English (遊戲原文): A voice whispers, "You see farther... Passage has been granted."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音低語：「你看得更遠了……通道已獲准通行。」

English (遊戲原文): A voice whispers, "To gain passage, you must see farther..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音低語：「要獲得通行，你必須看得更遠……」

English (遊戲原文):
A magic mouth speaks to the party:

"What can bind the mightiest foes?"
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一個魔法之口對隊伍說道：

「什麼能束縛最強大的敵人？」

English (遊戲原文): Return when you have space for your reward.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 等你空出道具欄再回來領取獎勵。
一條魔法套索憑空出現。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): There is a pool of boiling liquid here.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一池沸騰的液體。

English (遊戲原文): There is a pool of boiling liquid here. Will the party dive in?\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此處有一池沸騰的液體。冒險隊伍要跳進去嗎？\n\n

English (遊戲原文): We found Mangar's treasure trove, guarded by two very hungry dragons.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 我們找到了曼加的寶庫，由兩條極度飢餓的巨龍守護著。

English (遊戲原文): This is Mangar's treasure trove. Two dragons are here, and they're very hungry. You're in some real trouble.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這是曼加的寶庫。兩條巨龍在此，而且牠們非常飢餓。你們這下麻煩大了。

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you, saying:\n\n"Death to those who would attack the mighty one!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上一個魔法嘴對你說話：\n\n「膽敢攻擊偉大者之人，必將喪命！」

English (遊戲原文): An evil spirit possessed one of our party!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個邪靈附身了我們隊伍中的一名成員！

English (遊戲原文): The corpse of Mangar the Dark, and a portal back to the Skara Brae Adventurers Guild.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 黑暗曼葛的屍體，以及一道通往斯卡拉布雷冒險者公會的傳送門。

English (遊戲原文): You are relieved to see the rotting corpse of Mangar the Dark still lies here undisturbed since your last visit.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你鬆了一口氣，看到黑暗曼葛腐爛的屍體仍躺在這裡，自你上次造訪後無人打擾。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): There is a swirling portal here. A remnant of Kylearan's magic. Will you enter it?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一道旋轉的傳送門。那是凱利蘭魔法殘留的痕跡。你要進入嗎？

English (遊戲原文): There is a swirling portal here.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一道旋轉的傳送門。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): You stand in the antechamber of Mangar the Dark, evil Archmage of Skara Brae. Mangar glares at you with deep hatred. "Die, mortals!" he screams.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你站在黑暗曼加爾的前廳，這位斯卡拉布雷的邪惡大法師。曼加爾滿懷深仇地瞪著你。「去死吧，凡人！」他尖叫道。

English (遊戲原文): With a wave of his hand a few of his close friends drop by. They don't look like a fun group.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他揮了揮手，幾位親信便現身到場。這群人看起來可不怎麼有趣。

English (遊戲原文): Kylearan, the good Archmage, appears before you in a flash of light. "Well done!" he cries, beaming. "Your quest in Skara Brae is fulfilled!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一道光芒閃過，善良的大法師凱利蘭出現在你面前。「幹得好！」他滿臉笑容地喊道，「你在斯卡拉布雷的任務已經完成了！」

English (遊戲原文): "The evil one is now defeated, and his spell of winter will soon end."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「邪惡之敵已被擊敗，他降下的寒冬咒語也即將終結。」

English (遊戲原文): "You will all, as a symbol of my gratitude, receive 300,000 experience bonus. Also take this 300,000 gold to share amongst yourselves. Fare well and live long!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「為了表達我的謝意，你們每個人都將獲得三十萬點經驗值獎勵。此外，再收下這三十萬金幣，你們自行分配吧。願你們一路順風，長命百歲！」

English (遊戲原文): You're in the realm of Caith
A wise sage lives here, charging gold for the wisdom of the ancients!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一位睿智的賢者居住於此，以金幣換取古人的智慧！

English (遊戲原文):
The Sage says:

"Gold can buy thee the wisdom of the ancients, my friends."

You can:
Chinese (請填寫中文):
賢者說道：

「金幣能為諸位購得古人的智慧，我的朋友們。」

你可以：

English (遊戲原文): What will you ask him about?
"I have a more interesting tale than that", the Sage starts to tell you about his amazing travels abroad.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「我有個比那更有趣的故事」，賢者開始向你講述他在海外的驚奇旅程。

English (遊戲原文): "That is something better left unsaid", the Sage whispers.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那件事還是別說為妙」，賢者低聲說道。

English (遊戲原文): "Ah, yes", the Sage says, "therein lies a tale of great magnitude."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「啊，沒錯」，賢者說道，「其中蘊藏著一個意義重大的故事。」

English (遊戲原文): "Hidden beneath the city of Ephesus, the Tombs have been closed for centuries.\nSeek the entrance at the Temple of Darkness, in the city's center."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「隱藏在以弗所城地下的墓穴已封閉數世紀。\n前往城市中心的黑暗神廟尋找入口。」

English (遊戲原文): "Fanskar is a deadly warrior-mage who tried once to claim the title of Destiny Knight and failed.\nHis castle is a well-guarded fortress, located south-west of Colosse."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「凡斯卡爾是名致命的戰士法師，他曾試圖奪取天命勇士的稱號卻失敗了。\n他的城堡位於科洛塞西南方，是一座戒備森嚴的要塞。」

English (遊戲原文): "Dargoth is a creature more animal than man. He is a Lemurian... a being from another realm. Dargoth's tower is hidden in the city of Philippi. Take care, friends, for he is death itself."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「達戈斯是頭野獸多過人類的生物。他是雷穆里亞人……來自異界的存有。達戈斯的高塔隱藏在腓立比城中。朋友們，務必當心，因為他即是死亡本身。」

English (遊戲原文): "The Maze is said to be the home of the Graphnar Fist, a group of elite mercenaries who kill for both gold and pleasure. The Maze itself exists from ancient times. Seek it in Thessalonica."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「據說迷宮是格拉夫納之拳的巢穴，這群菁英傭兵為金錢與樂趣而殺戮。迷宮本身自古便已存在。前往帖撒羅尼迦尋找它。」

English (遊戲原文): "In the city of Corinth is the Fortress of the mage Oscon, whose strength is legendary and whose skill surpasses even Mangar's. The Fortress was, in fact, once the keep of a prominent Caith noble - Count Waldec. Oscon was his sorcerer. When the Lestradae mercenaries invaded, Oscon turned coat, slew the count, aided Lagoth, and took power for himself. Only an item of KAZDEK will gain you entrance."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「在科林斯城中，矗立著法師奧斯康的要塞，其力量傳說般強大，技藝甚至超越曼加。這座要塞其實曾是凱斯貴族——瓦爾德克伯爵的堡壘。奧斯康是他的咒術師。當萊斯特雷傭兵入侵時，奧斯康倒戈，殺死伯爵，協助拉戈斯，並奪權自據。唯有卡茲德克的物品才能讓你進入。」

English (遊戲原文): "Ah, yes, Kazdek. The immortal one, as he is called, he is in fact a living statue. Seek him between Thessalonica and Colosse, with the word of his name."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「啊，是的，卡茲德克。人稱不朽者，他其實是一座活雕像。在帖撒羅尼迦與科洛塞之間尋找他，並念出他的名字。」

English (遊戲原文): "Take care, my friends. None have left the Grey Crypt alive. Know you, however, that no magical spells will work therein."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「小心，我的朋友們。沒有人活著離開過灰色墓穴。但要知道，那裡任何魔法咒語都無法生效。」

English (遊戲原文): "A rock it is, in fact, yet much more. Ponder this, my friends: Never find and never fool, the last one drinks the poison pool, the first one reads the ancient tome, the third one breaks the double dome."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「它其實是一塊岩石，卻遠不止於此。深思吧，我的朋友們：永遠找不到也騙不了，最後一個喝下毒池，第一個閱讀遠古卷軸，第三個打破雙重穹頂。」

English (遊戲原文): "An evil genius is Lagoth, else he'd not have posed the threat to the Land that he has. Yet, an enemy to be respected, I think. His whereabouts are unknown, but I'd not be surprised to find him near."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「拉戈斯是個邪惡的天才，否則他不會對這片土地構成如此威脅。然而，我認為他是個值得尊敬的敵人。他的下落不明，但若發現他就在附近，我也不會驚訝。」

English (遊戲原文): "The master of songs, the Scarlet Bard. He can be found singing songs in a tavern in Ephesus. He may be able to teach you a powerful song or two... for a price."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「眾歌之主，緋紅吟遊詩人。你可以在以弗所的一間酒館裡找到他高歌的身影。他或許能教你一兩首強力的歌謠……只要價錢合適。」

English (遊戲原文): "Ah, that one makes you lucky at avoiding bad spells, thrown weapons and dragon breath."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「啊，那件東西能讓你幸運地避開惡咒、投擲武器與龍息。」

English (遊戲原文): "A ninja weapon, they do 16-64 points of damage and have a range of 60 feet."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「一種忍者武器，能造成 16 到 64 點傷害，有效射程 60 呎。」

English (遊戲原文): "The Mage Staff regenerates spell points and boosts the armor of the wielder."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「法師之杖能恢復法術點數，並提升持用者的防禦力。」

English (遊戲原文): "A thief with that has an increased chance of hiding in shadows."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「盜賊裝備此物後，藏身於陰影中的機率會提高。」

English (遊戲原文): "An ingenious device! If given to a monster ally, he is not likely to turn on you."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「真是個巧妙的裝置！若交給怪物盟友，他就不太可能反過來攻擊你。」

English (遊戲原文): "Ag's arrows do 24-96 points of damage and have a range of 90 feet."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「阿格的箭矢造成 24-96 點傷害，射程為 90 呎。」

English (遊戲原文): "Mithril arrows do 6-24 points of damage and have a range of 50 feet."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「秘銀箭矢造成 6-24 點傷害，射程為 50 呎。」

English (遊戲原文): "That ring casts a Safety Spell when you use it. Careful of that!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那枚戒指在使用時會施放安全法術。小心點！」

English (遊戲原文): "That ring protects the wearer from breath attacks. Most useful!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那枚戒指能保護佩戴者免受吐息攻擊。非常實用！」

English (遊戲原文): "Ah, that one casts Wizard War when you use it."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「啊，你使用那個的時候會施展巫師戰爭。」

English (遊戲原文): "Those boots aid you in running from fights. Not a very heroic item..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那雙靴子能幫助你逃離戰鬥。算不上什麼英雄裝備……」

English (遊戲原文): "Zen Arrows... oh yes. They do 40-160 points of damage, to a range of 70 feet."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「禪箭……哦，沒錯。它們能造成 40 到 160 點傷害，射程 70 呎。」

English (遊戲原文): "The Drums of Death cast a Death Strike spell on an opponent."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「死亡之鼓會對一名對手施展死亡打擊法術。」

English (遊戲原文): "The Song Axe is a wondrous item which always returns to the thrower, and does 64-256 points of damage at a range of 80 feet."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「歌斧是一件神奇的物品，總是會回到投擲者手中，並在 80 呎範圍內造成 64 到 256 點傷害。」

English (遊戲原文): "That one makes a Wizard Wall appear."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那個會召喚出一道巫師之牆。」

English (遊戲原文): "Aram's Knife? Oh yes. 128-512 points of damage, thrown at any range. Not too shabby."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「亞蘭姆之刃？喔，沒錯。投擲攻擊，任何距離皆可，造成 128 到 512 點傷害。還不賴。」
「那顆眼球會視需要施展連鎖法術。」

English (遊戲原文): "Thor's Hammer does 32-128 points of damage at a range of 70 feet, and it always returns."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「索爾之鎚在 70 呎範圍內造成 32 到 128 點傷害，而且永遠會飛回來。」

English (遊戲原文): "The Sword is rarely spoken of, but it is said to be throwable, up to 80 feet for 96-384 points of damage."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「這把劍鮮少被提及，但據說可以投擲，最遠 80 呎，造成 96 到 384 點傷害。」

English (遊戲原文): "The Nospen... oh yes. It deactivates all spinners in dungeons. A handy item."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「諾斯潘之石……啊，沒錯。它能解除地下城裡所有迷向器。是個方便的小道具。」

English (遊戲原文): "Ali's Carpet will leave you feeling like you are levitating forever. You will get good use out of this."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「阿里的飛毯會讓你感覺像永遠在漂浮一樣。你會發現它非常實用。」

English (遊戲原文): "I almost forgot this existed. The Troll Ring will leave its wearer feeling healthier and healthier over time."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「我差點忘了這東西的存在。食人魔戒指會讓佩戴者隨著時間感到越來越健康。」

English (遊戲原文): "A very insightful ring. Use it for inner wisdom."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「一枚極具洞察力的戒指。用它來獲得內在的智慧吧。」

English (遊戲原文): "I have seen very few of these, but when I have, the bard who wielded it would never lose their voice... Strange... those bards."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「我見過這東西的次數屈指可數，但每次見到時，持有它的吟遊詩人從不會失聲……真奇怪……那些吟遊詩人。」

English (遊戲原文): "The Sorcerstaff can destroy illusions in battle and stops more from being summoned. It can also identify those pesky doppelgangers."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「法術師之杖能在戰鬥中摧毀幻象，並阻止更多幻象被召喚。它還能辨識那些惱人的分身怪。」

English (遊戲原文): "The Dayblade deals 3-33 damage and is known for its ability to, in a lesser capacity, reveal the way."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「日刃劍能造成 3-33 點傷害，並以其在較小程度上揭示道路的能力而聞名。」

English (遊戲原文): "When these drums are pounded, they cause an enemy to drop dead right in front of them."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「當這些鼓被敲響時，會讓一名敵人在鼓手面前當場倒地斃命。」

English (遊戲原文): "This figurine contains the essence of a Slayer. When shattered an enormous slayer will stand beside you. He swings for 31-124 damage. His swing can often kill instantly."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「這尊小雕像蘊含著一名殺手的精華。當它被擊碎時，一名巨大的殺手將現身在你身旁。他揮擊造成 31-124 點傷害，且他的揮擊經常能一擊必殺。」

English (遊戲原文): "This figurine contains the essence of a Storm Giant. When shattered, cracks of thunder reveal a Storm Giant with your party. He slams for 31-124 damage."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「這尊小雕像蘊含著一名風暴巨人的精華。當它被擊碎時，雷鳴聲中會有一名風暴巨人與你的隊伍並肩作戰。他猛擊造成 31-124 點傷害。」

English (遊戲原文): "This figurine contains the essence of an Ogre. When shattered the gruesome ogre will fight beside you. It swings multiple times for 4-16 damage."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「這尊小雕像蘊含著一名食人魔的精華。當它被擊碎時，這駭人的食人魔將與你並肩作戰。它會多次揮擊，造成 4-16 點傷害。」

English (遊戲原文): "This figurine contains the essence of a Bulldozer. When shattered it will release the essence and form the mighty warrior himself. He swings for 16-64 damage."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「這尊小雕像蘊含著一名推土機的精華。當它被擊碎時，精華將釋放，形成這位強大的戰士本人。他揮擊造成 16-64 點傷害。」

English (遊戲原文): "This figurine contains the essence of the Kringle Brothers. When shattered multiple brothers appear to fight alongside you, enough to fill your party. They swing for 64-256 damage. They have a deadly breath and aren't afraid to use it."

English (遊戲原文): You stand before a locked iron gate.\n\nIt has an unusual shaped keyhole. It almost looks... stone shaped.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你站在一扇上鎖的鐵門前。\n\n它有一個形狀奇特的鑰匙孔。看起來幾乎……像是石頭的形狀。

English (遊戲原文): You place the WardStone you found on Saradon's corpse, within the shaped hole. The gate opens to let you pass.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你將在薩拉頓屍體上找到的守護石，放入那個形狀特殊的孔洞中。鐵門開啟，讓你通過。

English (遊戲原文):
You stand on the ground level of Saradon's house.
A note on a table reads: 

"Adventurers, if you are reading this then I was unable to return to you and am surely dead... In my workshop upstairs you will find information crucial to your success. I have some modest magical measures protecting my workshop, but I'm sure they will be no match for you."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你站在薩拉頓之屋的地面層。
桌上有一張便條寫著：

「冒險者們，如果你們看到這張紙條，代表我未能返回你們身邊，想必已經死了……在我樓上的工作室裡，你們會找到對成功至關重要的資訊。我對工作室設下了一些簡樸的魔法防護，但我相信它們對你們來說不成問題。」

English (遊戲原文): You stand in the upper level of Saradon's house.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你站在薩拉頓之屋的上層。

English (遊戲原文): You inspect the bookshelf but can't find anything worthwhile.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你檢查了書架，但找不到任何有價值的東西。

English (遊戲原文): You search the scattered notes throughout the house but can't find anything worthwhile.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你搜遍了散落在屋內的筆記，但找不到任何有價值的東西。

English (遊戲原文): You open the chest but can't find anything worthwhile.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你打開了寶箱，但找不到任何有價值的東西。

English (遊戲原文): You read the scribbles but can't decipher the words.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你讀了那些潦草的字跡，但無法辨識其中的文字。

English (遊戲原文): You inspect the manual but can't find anything worthwhile.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你檢查了那本手冊，但找不到任何有價值的東西。

English (遊戲原文): You search the writings for meaning and get vague clues about Longinus the Mad.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你搜尋這些文字中的意義，得到了關於瘋狂的隆基努斯（Longinus the Mad）的模糊線索。

English (遊戲原文): A mage standing by a large stone.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一名法師站在一塊巨石旁。

English (遊戲原文):
A mage, standing by a large stone, blocks your way. He says:

"Tell me two things you knuckleheads, to split the stone."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一名法師站在一塊巨石旁，擋住了你的去路。他說：

「告訴我兩個詞，你們這群笨蛋，才能劈開這石頭。」

English (遊戲原文): And what is the second word?
The mage makes a gesture and with a great cracking sound, the stone splits revealing a dark passage...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 法師做出一個手勢，伴隨著巨大的碎裂聲，石頭裂開，露出一條黑暗的通道……

English (遊戲原文): A large stone in the city square with a large crevice.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 城市廣場上的一塊巨石，上面有一道巨大的裂縫。

English (遊戲原文): You stand before a large stone set in the city square. On one side is a crevice, leading into darkness. A mage stands beside the crevice, watching your actions but does not block your passage.\n\nYou can:
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你佇立於城市廣場上一塊巨大的石頭前。石頭一側有道裂縫，通往黑暗深處。一名法師站在裂縫旁，注視著你的行動，但並未阻擋你的去路。\n\n你可以：

English (遊戲原文): "Seek the answer in the tombs, but don't return here until you finish the crypt."\n\nThe mage disappears.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「在墓穴中尋找答案，但完成地窖之前別回到這裡。」\n\n法師消失了。

English (遊戲原文):
You stand in the entry to Oscon's Fortress.

A stairway leads to the upper levels.

You can:
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你站在奧斯康堡壘的入口處。

一道階梯通往上層。

你可以：

English (遊戲原文): You stand in the entry to Oscon's Fortress.\n\nYou see no entrance to the upper levels.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你站在奧斯康堡壘的入口處。\n\n你沒看到任何通往上一層的入口。

English (遊戲原文): There are stairs leading down into the Maze of Dread.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 有階梯向下通往恐懼迷宮。

English (遊戲原文):
A magic mouth appears and says:

"Where steel is bright and blood runs red...
Walk down the stairs to the maze of..."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一個魔法之口出現並說道：

「鋼鐵閃耀之處，鮮血染紅之地……
走下階梯，前往迷宮……」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall shouts:\n\n"Turn back, adventurers - you are not the first and won't be the last to attempt to save the Princess!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的魔法之口大喊：\n\n「回去吧，冒險者——你們既不是第一個，也不會是最後一個試圖拯救公主的人！」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall says:\n\n"Well, you've certainly lived up to my expectations... I'm sure the King will be most pleased with a dead princess..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的魔法之口說道：\n\n「哼，你們果然沒讓我失望……我相信國王看到死掉的公主一定會非常『滿意』……」

English (遊戲原文):
A magic mouth on the wall says:

"The Princess! You rescued her! I was wrong...

This never happens..."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
牆上的魔法之口說道：

「公主！你們竟然救了她！我錯了……

這種事從來沒發生過……」

English (遊戲原文):
An old man appears and speaks to you, saying:

"Below you now, thrice count the floors
play some light for the double doors."

He then vanishes.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一名老人現身並對你說話：

「在你下方，數三層樓，
為雙門奏響些許光芒。」

隨後他便消失無蹤。

English (遊戲原文):
In the room beyond the dark.
Lies the bite behind the bark.
To avoid a gruesome fate.
Line your arrow true and straight.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
在黑暗之後的房間裡，
藏著樹皮下的利牙。
為避免悲慘的命運，
讓你的箭矢筆直精準。

English (遊戲原文): The door here looks as if something was trying to get out.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這扇門看起來像是有什麼東西試圖從裡面衝出來。\n

English (遊戲原文): Beware the creature that lies in the middle of darkness...\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 當心那潛伏在黑暗中央的怪物……\n

English (遊戲原文):
There are some scribblings on the wall.

"The Princess lives..."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
牆上有一些潦草的字跡。

「公主還活著……」

English (遊戲原文): The blood-stained wall shows that many battles have been fought here.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 血跡斑斑的牆壁顯示此處曾發生過許多戰鬥。\n

English (遊戲原文): In areas unpassable, seek entrance by Phase Door to learn the secret of the double doors...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在無法通行之處，試著用相位門進入，以發掘雙重門的秘密……

English (遊戲原文): A larged winged creature offers to join up with you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一隻巨大的有翼生物提議要加入你的隊伍。

English (遊戲原文): Scrawled on the wall is a message:\n\n"Mangar was here..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上潦草地寫著一段訊息：\n\n「曼加爾到此一遊...」

English (遊戲原文): A sign on the wall says:\n\n"MONSTER REFORMATORY"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上有塊牌子寫著：\n\n「怪物感化院」

English (遊戲原文): A strange message is written on the wall:\n\n"SAMEN NGHOINT"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上刻著一段奇怪的訊息：\n\n「SAMEN NGHOINT」

English (遊戲原文):
One level down.
Map wall and door.
Look toward the corners.
And read the four...
Chinese (請填寫中文):
往下一層。
描繪牆壁與門。
望向角落。
並閱讀那四...

English (遊戲原文): A voice whispers:\n\n"Ask the wise one of THE TOMBS."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音低語道：\n\n「去問『墓穴』中的智者。」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks:\n\n"Speak the word to pass by:"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的魔法嘴開口說話：\n\n「說出通關密語：」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks:\n\n"Look at the spells of the Sorcerous kind; Who's the Master of the Mind?"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的魔法之口說道：\n\n「且看術士法術之奧妙；誰才是心靈之主宰？」

English (遊戲原文):
A magic mouth on the wall speaks:

"You have returned. I will grant your exit again."

A faint but familiar sound is heard in the distance.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
牆上的魔法之口說道：

「你回來了。我將再次准許你離開。」

遠處傳來微弱而熟悉的聲響。
一塊告示寫著：\n\n前方有樓梯。

English (遊戲原文): A corpse is here with a tombstone marked: Hotwind.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一具屍體，墓碑上刻著：Hotwind。

English (遊戲原文): The answer to the double doors lies hidden above.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 雙扇門的答案隱藏在上方。

English (遊戲原文): A voice proclaims:\n\n"The winged one can traverse the gap."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音宣告：\n\n「長翅膀者能跨越那道裂隙。」

English (遊戲原文): Two huge double doors block your path to the north.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 兩扇巨大的雙門擋住了你往北的去路。

English (遊戲原文): Two huge double doors to the north open at the sound of the Watchwood Melody.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 北方兩扇巨大的雙門在守望森林旋律響起時開啟。

English (遊戲原文): Two huge double doors to the north open at the sound of the Seekers Ballad.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 北方兩扇巨大的雙門在尋覓者之歌響起時開啟。

English (遊戲原文): There is a chasm ahead, blocking any further progress.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 前方有一道深淵，阻擋了任何進一步的進展。

English (遊戲原文): The Winged Creature carries you over the chasm which lies before you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 那隻帶翼生物載著你飛越了面前的深淵。

English (遊戲原文): There is a princess here. She really wants to be rescued.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一位公主。她非常渴望被拯救。

English (遊戲原文):
You've entered the throne room of the Dark Lord. He doesn't sound pleased to see you.

"Destroy these scum! he screams."

His friends advance on you hungrily.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你進入了黑暗領主的王座廳。他聽起來不太樂意見到你。

「把這些渣滓消滅掉！」他尖叫道。

他的手下們飢渴地向你逼近。

English (遊戲原文): A deep chasm can be seen to the north.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 北方可以看見一道深邃的峽谷。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): "Greetings, mortals.\n\nThese tombs are a trap for the unwary. Take care you do not perish as a result of your carelessness..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「凡人們，你們好。\n\n這些墓穴是為粗心者設下的陷阱。小心別因自己的疏忽而喪命……」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"Things change, even unnoticed, and not always for the better."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的一個魔法之口對你說話：\n\n「事物會改變，即使未被察覺，而且未必總是變得更好。」

English (遊戲原文): A living statue stands before you saying:\n\n"Name the city -- P......."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一座活雕像站在你面前說道：\n\n「說出城市之名——P.......」

English (遊戲原文): "Know this then, the first Snare lies on the third level of the tombs."\n\nHe suddenly vanishes.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那麼記住，第一個陷阱位於墓穴第三層。」\n\n他突然消失了。

English (遊戲原文):
A living statue stands before you saying:

"The first Snare lies on the third level of the tombs."

He suddenly vanishes.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一座活雕像佇立在你面前說道：

「第一個陷阱位於墓穴第三層。」

他突然消失無蹤。

English (遊戲原文): On the wall is etched this poem:\n\nThe Snare of Death right spins in whole...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上刻著一首詩：\n\n死亡陷阱向右完整旋轉……

English (遊戲原文): ... as fire-ones feast on the dead man's soul...
... yet savage words can cut the rock...
... and feathers split the headsman's block.
Chinese (請填寫中文): ……而羽毛能劈開劊子手的木砧。

English (遊戲原文): On the wall, scrawled in blood, is this message:\n\n"Look, oh ye mighty, and despair. The tombs are not..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上以血跡潦草地寫著這段訊息：\n\n「看啊，爾等強者，絕望吧。這些墓穴並非……」

English (遊戲原文): A voice whispers:\n\n"After the toxic one, check yourselves for a special thing that appears common..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音低語道：\n\n「在毒物之後，檢查你們自身，尋找一件看似平凡的特殊之物……」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth appears and says:\n\n"If the spell of dreams you seek, five magic words you must speak."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一張魔法之口出現並說道：\n\n「若你尋求夢境法術，你必須說出五個魔法詞語。」

English (遊戲原文): An old Keymaster is here trying to sell me something.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一位老鑰匙匠在此，試圖向我兜售某樣東西。

English (遊戲原文): An old man is here, and says to you:\n\n"I am the Keymaster, I have something to sell you for the low price of 50,000 gold pieces."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一位老人站在此處，對你說：\n\n「我是鑰匙匠，我有樣東西要賣給你，只要五萬枚金幣的低廉價格。」

English (遊戲原文): Bought a Master Key off the Keymaster for 50,000 gold pieces.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 向鑰匙大師花費 50,000 金幣購得一把萬能鑰匙。

English (遊戲原文): The test of time has lain to waste the power of the true wand. Only the One can save it, yet at a cost of losing his old life...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 歲月的考驗已將真法杖的力量消磨殆盡。唯有天命之人能拯救它，卻須付出失去舊日人生的代價……

English (遊戲原文): You've entered the chambers of the Dead King.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你進入了亡靈之王的寢殿。

English (遊戲原文): He doesn't look too pleased to see you.\n\nHe screams a curdling battle-cry and heads your way...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他看起來不太高興見到你。\n\n他發出一聲刺耳的戰吼，朝你衝了過來……

English (遊戲原文): Scratchings on the wall read:\n\nTrachaem's task was always reversed. This is the paradox.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的刻痕寫著：\n\n特拉查姆的任務總是顛倒的。這就是悖論。

English (遊戲原文): Scratchings on the wall read:\n\nThe great one knew success at all points. Defeat was never etched on his destiny.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的刻痕寫著：\n\n偉大者在所有關頭皆知曉成功。失敗從未刻寫在他的命運中。

English (遊戲原文): Scratchings on the wall read:\n\nHe was told to burn, and in that paradox knew a multitude of solutions.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的刻痕寫著：\n\n他被命令焚燒，而在那悖論中，他知曉了無數的解決之道。

English (遊戲原文): Scratchings on the wall read:\n\nThe great T had, at the end of things, to beg, with a kind word.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的刻痕寫著：\n\n偉大的 T 在一切終結之時，必須以溫言懇求。

English (遊戲原文): Scratchings on the wall read:\n\nThe strange mage wants two words: What Tr. did, in answer to the paradox, and what word he said at the end of things.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的刻痕寫著：\n\n那位怪異的法師想要兩個詞：關於悖論，崔做了什麼作為回應，以及他在萬物終結時說了什麼話。

English (遊戲原文): An old man (doing a fireball trick) wearing a garment of pure gold says:\n\n"The Name of it is the staff of:"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一位穿著純金長袍的老人（正在表演火球術）說道：\n\n「它的名字是法杖之名：」

English (遊戲原文):
"Correct. I will say this then: Go to the Sage, in the wilderness, and ask him of FANSKAR.
He will charge you a price, but the information will be valuable."

He suddenly disappears...
Chinese (請填寫中文):
「正確。那麼我就告訴你這個：去荒野中找那位賢者，向他詢問 FANSKAR。
他會向你索取代價，但這情報將會很有價值。」

他突然消失了……

English (遊戲原文): "You again... You know the name of the staff. I shall let you pass."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「又是你……你知道那柄法杖的名字。我就讓你過去吧。」

English (遊戲原文): A cloudy face appears, and says:\n\n"Your time draws to a close, mortals. Show the answer to me, or perish."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一張朦朧的臉孔浮現，說道：\n\n「你們的時辰將盡，凡人。向我展示答案，否則死路一條。」
你無法在黑暗中帶領隊伍……

English (遊戲原文): Only a leader can show the way...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 只有領袖才能指引道路……

English (遊戲原文): A cloudy face appears, and says:\n\n"Very impressive. Your way lies clear, for the time being. But my time will come..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一張陰沉的面孔浮現，說道：\n\n「令人印象深刻。你的道路暫時清晰無礙。但我的時刻終將到來……」

English (遊戲原文): There is an Old Warrior here.
There is a Toxic Giant here.
Since you are already sick, you tear into the toxic giant's body and pull out... A Torch!\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 既然你已經生病了，你撕開劇毒巨人的身體，從中拉出了……一支火把！\n\n

English (遊戲原文): Found a 'Torch!' in the body of a Toxic Giant
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在劇毒巨人的屍體中找到了一支「火把！」

English (遊戲原文): There is a fountain here full of foul water.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一座噴泉，裡面滿是污濁的水。

English (遊戲原文): There is a fountain here, full of foul water. Who will drink?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一座噴泉，裡面滿是污濁的水。誰要喝？

English (遊戲原文): Drinking the water gave us poison.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 喝了這水讓我們中毒了。

English (遊戲原文): There is a segment to The Scepter here.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有權杖的一個分段。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): You see some words etched on the wall:\n\nAge before all others, when time is short. For the last must be first.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你看見牆上刻著一些字：\n\n萬物之先，當時間短促。因為最後的必須成為最先的。

English (遊戲原文): On the wall (scrawled in old blood) is:\n\nPick yer poison, boys.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上（以陳舊血跡潦草寫著）：\n\n「選你們的毒藥吧，小子們。」

English (遊戲原文): Etched on the wall are these words:\n\nA party of sick people might escape where the healthy fail.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上刻著這些文字：\n\n「一群病弱者或許能逃出健康者無法通過之處。」

English (遊戲原文):
Etched in the wall is this rhyme:

The won flame in ancient grip
might cause the cloudy one to slip...
Chinese (請填寫中文):
牆上刻著這首韻文：

「古老掌握中的得勝火焰
或能使雲霧者失足滑跌……」

English (遊戲原文): It seems drinking all this poison subdued the voice.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 看來喝下所有這些毒藥後，那聲音便平息了。
我的天啊，你看起來真渴！

English (遊戲原文): Think quickly, mortals. Contrariness is often the key.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 快點思考，凡人。矛盾往往是關鍵。

English (遊戲原文): A voice says,\n\n"And the old shall lead the way."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「而老者將引領道路。」

English (遊戲原文):
On the wall is written:

The staff of Old once lost, once sold.
Name it to he of purest gold.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
牆上寫著：

古老法杖曾失落，曾售出。
向純金之人說出它的名號。

English (遊戲原文): The party has expired...\n\nBetter luck next time adventurers.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 冒險隊伍已全滅……\n\n願下次好運，冒險者們。

English (遊戲原文): You've entered the quarters of Fanskar's bodyguard. His grotesque form launches itself at you without fear.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你進入了凡斯卡護衛的居所。他那醜陋猙獰的身形毫無畏懼地向你撲來。

English (遊戲原文):
A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:

"Ponder this:
The white shall lie, and in this knowledge reflects your only answer."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
牆上的一張魔法之口對你說道：

「深思此理：
白色將說謊，而這份認知映照出你唯一的答案。」

English (遊戲原文): You've entered the living chambers of Fanskar himself. He and a friend are rather surprised to see you.\n\n"Kill them!" Fanskar screams.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你進入了 Fanskar 本人的起居室。他和一位同伴看到你時相當驚訝。\n\n「殺了他們！」Fanskar 尖叫道。

English (遊戲原文): As you enter the room a fiery cavalcade assaults your mortal forms, destroying you instantly.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 當你進入房間時，一團熾熱的騎兵隊襲擊了你的凡人之軀，瞬間將你摧毀。

English (遊戲原文): Some wandering adventurers find your ashes though, and return them to the Guild.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 不過，一些流浪的冒險者找到了你的骨灰，並將它們送回了公會。

English (遊戲原文): An old man in a black cloak says: "The door on the right leads to safety."\n\nHe then vanishes.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一名身披黑色斗篷的老者說道：「右邊的門通往安全之處。」\n\n語畢，他便消失了。

English (遊戲原文): An old man in a white cloak says: "The black-cloaked one speaks the truth."\n\nHe then vanishes.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一名身披白色斗篷的老者說道：「穿黑斗篷的人說的是實話。」\n\n語畢，他便消失了。

English (遊戲原文): Your light illuminates the dingy walls of Fanskar's Castle. You hear voices in the distance.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你的光源照亮了凡斯卡城堡陰暗的牆壁。你聽見遠處傳來人聲。

English (遊戲原文): Scrawled on the wall is this message:\n\nFar right and left is hazardous, when time runs short, yet in the far corners is knowledge...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上潦草地寫著這段訊息：\n\n極右與極左皆為險境，當時間緊迫之時，然而在遙遠的角落藏有知識……

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"Fanskar guards the Death Snare with his very life."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「凡斯卡爾以性命守護死亡陷阱。」

English (遊戲原文): A sign reads:\n\nGuards' Quarters -- women please wait in the hall.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一塊告示牌寫著：\n\n守衛宿舍——女性請在大廳等候。
一塊銘牌寫著：\n\n凡斯卡爾的寢室

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth appears and says:\n\n"To the worthy I reveal, a dream to mend, a dream to HEAL."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個魔法之口浮現並說道：\n\n「獻給值得之人，我揭示一個待修補的夢，一個待癒合的夢。」

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"Welcome, mortals! Choose one of three doors, but only one leads to the segment. The other two bring instant death..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「歡迎，凡人！從三扇門中選擇一扇，但只有一扇通往正確路段。另外兩扇將帶來即死……」

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"You have succeeded again, mortals..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「你們又成功了，凡人……」

English (遊戲原文):
A voice whispers,

"This room is unfair,
But do not despair,
We have cleared a pair,
Because we care."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一個聲音低語道：

「這房間不公平，
但請別灰心，
我們已清掉一對，
因為我們關心。」

English (遊戲原文):
A voice whispers,

"This room is unfair,
Do not go in there,
But if you should dare,
Scry with care."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一個聲音低語道：

「這房間不公平，
千萬別走進去，
但若你敢嘗試，
請謹慎地偵測。」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"Answer this, foolish ones: Is it better to:"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上一個魔法之口對你說道：\n\n「回答這個問題，愚蠢的人們：哪一種比較好：」

English (遊戲原文): A voice whispers:\n\n"There's more to the picture... Than meets the eye."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音低語：\n\n「這幅畫的背後……還有更多玄機。」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"What truly counts is rarely said; Ask the wise of the Maze of Dread."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上一個魔法之口對你說：\n\n「真正重要的事鮮少被說出口；去問迷惘迷宮中的智者吧。」

English (遊戲原文): Scrawled on the wall is a message:\n\nFrequency is the ultimate key.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上潦草地寫著一則訊息：\n\n頻率是終極之鑰。

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"Seek the Zen Master."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「去尋找禪宗大師。」

English (遊戲原文): There are 7 statues here. Which one will you examine?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此處有七座雕像。你要檢查哪一座？
檢查了「方塊運動員」雕像。

English (遊戲原文): On the wall is a message in blood:\n\nThe Death Snare is not on the first three levels of the tower.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上有一則血書訊息：\n\n死亡陷阱不在高塔的前三層。

English (遊戲原文):
On the wall is etched this poem:

In darkest calm he stalks the men.

Who seek the wand and read the ten.

His cry is called but none knows when.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
牆上刻著一首詩：

在至暗的寂靜中，他潛行追獵眾人。

他們尋找魔杖並誦讀十誡。

他的呼號響起，但無人知曉何時降臨。

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"The Sword of Zar can only be drawn by one who has faced the Battletest."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「薩爾之劍唯有通過戰鬥試煉者方能拔出。」

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"Cryptic origins are typified in the unnatural scheme..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「詭秘的起源體現在非自然的佈局之中……」
你沒看到什麼特別的東西。

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"Speak the three, in sequence:"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的一個魔法之口對你說道：\n\n「依序說出那三個詞：」

English (遊戲原文): "Correct. Your portal to the next level is now operational."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「正確。通往下一層的傳送門現在已啟動。」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you:\n\n"The three in sequence is known. I shall re-activate the portal to the next level."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的一個魔法之口對你說話：\n\n「三個順序已知。我將重新啟動通往下一層的傳送門。」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"In the lands within, and the traps between, what was secret once -- now cannot be seen!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的一個魔法之口對你說了這些話：\n\n「在內部的國度，與其間的陷阱之間，曾經的秘密——如今已無法看見！」

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"Three words of wisdom must be found, or else stay closer to the ground!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「必須找到三個智慧之言，否則就乖乖待在地面！」

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"The first says dwell, the second hell, the third of wisdom it will tell."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「首字為『dwell』（居），次字為『hell』（獄），三字即啟『wisdom』（智）之語。」

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"From the first take the last, fifth from the second, and eighth from the third."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「取首字（dwell）之尾，次字（hell）之第五，及三字（wisdom）之第八。」

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「地獄的憂傷環繞我；死亡的網羅臨到我。」

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「智慧人的法則乃是生命的泉源，使人脫離死亡的網羅。」

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「因為這網羅要臨到全地面上一切居住的人。」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth appears and says:\n\n"Illusions cunning and corrupt, a dream can shatter and DISRUPT."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個魔法之口出現並說道：\n\n「狡詐而腐敗的幻象，一場夢便能粉碎並擾亂。」

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"First five here, next five above. The fifth, of course, cannot be love."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上一個魔法嘴脣對你說話：\n\n「前五在此，上五在彼。第五者，當然，不可能是愛。」

English (遊戲原文): On the wall is written this note:\n\nNot everything has two sides. Take care, friends.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上寫著這則筆記：\n\n並非萬物皆有兩面。小心，朋友們。

English (遊戲原文): On the wall is written this:\n\nAnd this, the first, it quencheth thirst.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上寫著：\n\n而此，第一者，能解渴。

English (遊戲原文): On the wall is etched:\n\nFor three, you see, cannot be free.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上刻著：\n\n三者，你瞧，無法自由。

English (遊戲原文): On the wall is written this note:\n\nTo him give four... he'll not be poor!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上寫著這則筆記：\n\n給他四……他將不再貧窮！

English (遊戲原文): On the wall is printed:\n\nAnd number two is never true.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上寫著：\n\n「而第二句永遠不成立。」

English (遊戲原文): A voice yells:\n\n"I shall kick you out then!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音大喊：\n\n「那我就把你踢出去！」

English (遊戲原文): Don't look now, but you've walked in on Dargoth and a few of his close friends. Dargoth doesn't have much patience with humans.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 別回頭，但你已經闖進了達戈斯和他幾個親信的地盤。達戈斯對人類可沒什麼耐心。

English (遊戲原文): A voice says:\n\n"Thou hast bested me again, oh meagre ones. But I await thy coming, shouldst thou live that long!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n\n「你們這些渺小之輩，又勝了我一次。但我等著你們到來——如果你們能活到那時候的話！」

English (遊戲原文): The secret is hidden in the Dreamspell.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 秘密隱藏在「夢之咒語」之中。

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"The secret is hidden in the Dreamspell."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的一個魔法嘴對你說道：\n\n「秘密隱藏在『夢之咒語』之中。」

English (遊戲原文): The Snare of Death can be beaten by the mage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 死亡陷阱可以被法師擊敗。

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"The Snare of Death can be beaten by the mage."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的一個魔法嘴對你說道：\n\n「死亡陷阱可以被法師擊敗。」

English (遊戲原文): Turn right at the joke, then right, then forward, then left twice, ahead twice, right, then left.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在笑話處右轉，然後右轉，然後前進，然後左轉兩次，前進兩次，右轉，然後左轉。

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"Turn right at the joke, then right, then forward, then left twice, ahead twice, right, then left."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的魔法之口對你說道：\n\n「在笑話處右轉，然後右轉，然後向前，再左轉兩次，向前兩次，右轉，然後左轉。」

English (遊戲原文): Drop all your items, or you are lost.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 丟棄你所有的物品，否則你將迷失。

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"Drop all your items, or you are lost."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的魔法之口對你說道：\n\n「丟棄你所有的物品，否則你將迷失。」

English (遊戲原文): Cry havok, and let slip the dogs of war.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 高呼浩劫，釋放戰爭之犬。

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"Cry havok, and let slip the dogs of war."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上的魔法之口對你說道：\n\n「高呼浩劫，釋放戰爭之犬。」

English (遊戲原文): Kill off all your spellcasters, and you'll be saved.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 殺光你所有的施法者，你就能得救。

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth on the wall speaks to you saying this:\n\n"Kill off all your spellcasters, and you'll be saved."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上一個魔法嘴脣對你說話道：\n\n「殺光你所有的施法者，你就能得救。」

English (遊戲原文): A statue, standing before you, comes to life and says:\n\n"Give me your battle-cry, or die."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一座佇立在你面前的雕像突然活過來說道：\n\n「交出你的戰吼，否則死。」

English (遊戲原文):
"Correct. I give you a small token of my esteem."
He suddenly disappears.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
「正確。我賜你一份微薄的敬意。」
他突然消失無蹤。

English (遊戲原文): A voice proclaims:\n\n"Do not bother me without having the token!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音宣告道：\n\n「沒有信物就別來打擾我！」

English (遊戲原文): A voice proclaims.\n"Look at the wall."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音宣告道。\n「看看那面牆壁。」

English (遊戲原文):
A mage appears saying:

"The room maze leads to salvation."
He then disappears.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一名法師現身說道：

「這座房間迷宮將引領你走向救贖。」
隨後他便消失了。

You find a table with a letter on it...

"We can agree our goals are accordant. An alliance between our forces would be advantageous to both our desires. I will abide in the south while I await your decision."

你發現一張桌子上放著一封信……

Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：\n「智慧之言價值連城。聆聽三次，甚至五次，才能真正體會其價值。」

Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：「不經痛苦，焉能成功。」

Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個聲音說道：「歡迎，愚蠢的凡人。時間所剩無幾……」

English (遊戲原文): On the wall is:\n\nSix we know will try to crow.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上寫著：\n\n我們所知六人將試圖高鳴。

Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上刻著：\n\n七與八，反轉微小與遲緩。
