It seems that Saradon maintained a correspondence with Longinus, the mad prophet of Skara Brae. Longinus’ replies seem to have consisted of nothing more than inscrutable rhymes. You pick up one such example and read it...

By tor and loch by burn and tarn.
Your fate lies in the lap of Narn.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你被地上的一本翻開的書絆了一下。

看來薩拉頓與史卡拉布雷的瘋狂先知隆基努斯保持著書信往來。隆基努斯的回覆似乎盡是些難以理解的韻文。你撿起其中一封讀了起來……

越過山丘與湖泊，穿過溪流與池塘。
你的命運，掌握在納恩的膝上。

English (遊戲原文):
More notes from Longinus catch your eye, these just as cryptic as the previous

The greatest heroes number seven.
Assume their roles and rise to heaven.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
隆基努斯的更多筆記吸引了你的目光，這些和之前的一樣晦澀難懂：

最偉大的英雄共有七位。
扮演他們的角色，升天歸位。

English (遊戲原文):
On a low table there is yet another piece of nonsensical poetry from the mad prophet:

Though high you fly or low you stoop.
You will never be worthy of the soup.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
矮几上又放著一首來自瘋狂先知的無意義詩歌：

任你高飛或低俯。
你永遠不配那碗湯。

English (遊戲原文): You find what seems to be a longer draft of the letter you received from Saradon.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你找到了一封似乎是薩拉頓寄給你的信件更長的草稿。

English (遊戲原文): My name is Saradon, a wizard of some fame and little fortune. Though you know me not, and we have never met, I feel that I have known you all my life. For the story of your deeds, your entanglement with Mangar and his evil horde in Skara Brae, flows from the lips of every Bard throughout the Realm.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 吾名薩拉頓，一位小有名氣卻囊中羞澀的巫師。你雖不識我，我們也未曾謀面，但我卻覺得彷彿認識了你一輩子。因為你的事蹟——你在斯卡拉布雷與曼加爾及其邪惡大軍的糾葛——早已隨著王國中每位吟遊詩人的歌謠傳頌開來。

English (遊戲原文): For this reason, for your courage and experience, I have contacted you above all others. For now we face an evil much greater than Mangar's. An evil that threatens not the safety and tranquility of but one city, nae... an evil that threatens the existence of the entire Realm and all the cities and citizens within!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 正因如此，鑑於你的勇氣與經驗，我選擇聯繫你而非他人。如今我們面對的邪惡遠比曼加爾更為強大。這股邪惡威脅的不僅是一座城市的安寧……不，它威脅的是整個王國的存在，以及其中所有的城市與子民！

English (遊戲原文): Recall now the lessons of your childhood. The story of Turin, the Archmage who forged the Destiny Wand in the molten depths of the holy mountain Krontor. The Destiny Wand, the uniting force which has rallied armies to the aid of the Realm, and has maintained peace and prosperity for the last 700 years.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 現在，請回想你兒時聽過的故事。關於大法師圖林的故事——他在聖山克朗托的熔岩深處鍛造了命運之杖。命運之杖，那股團結的力量，曾集結大軍保衛王國，並在過去七百年間維持了和平與繁榮。

English (遊戲原文): But look around you now, where has the power of the Destiny Wand gone? Lawless mercenaries from the neighboring kingdom of Lestradae have invaded the Realm and now run rampant through the streets. Even in Tangramayne, our capital! It is they who have taken the Destiny Wand, with the guidance of an evil Archmage known as Lagoth Zanta.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 但看看你四周，命運之杖的力量如今何在？來自鄰國萊斯特拉迪的無法傭兵已入侵王國，在街頭橫行無忌。甚至在我們的首都坦格拉梅因也是如此！正是他們，在一位名為拉戈斯·贊塔的邪惡大法師指引下，奪走了命運之杖。

English (遊戲原文): Although Lagoth has thwarted each of my attempts to gain knowledge of his powers and location, I have been able to discover that the Destiny Wand lies broken in seven pieces, at seven different locations. Lagoth has placed each fragment of the scepter within a Snare of Death - a puzzle room that will require all the wisdom and cunning at your disposal in order for you to survive.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 儘管拉戈斯挫敗了我每一次探查他力量與藏身之處的嘗試，但我仍設法發現命運權杖已斷裂成七塊碎片，散落在七個不同的地點。拉戈斯將權杖的每一塊碎片都放置在「死亡陷阱」之中——這是一個謎題房間，你必須運用所有的智慧與機智才能存活下來。

English (遊戲原文): Do you believe in legends?\n\nLegend states that, Unimaginable power is bestowed upon the one who reforges the Destiny Wand... Regardless of whether or not you hold faith in the stuff of legend, you must defeat Lagoth Zanta, regain the seven fragments, and reforge the Destiny Wand - it is the only way to save the Realm.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你相信傳說嗎？\n\n傳說記載，無可想像的力量將賜予重鑄命運權杖之人……無論你是否相信傳說中的事物，你必須擊敗拉戈斯·贊塔，奪回七塊碎片，並重鑄命運權杖——這是拯救王國的唯一方法。

English (遊戲原文): Now I must hurry, for in my attempts to glean knowledge of Lagoth, he has discovered my prying magic and even now his mercenaries approach. I care not for my own safety, but I pray that my magic is still strong enough to deliver this letter into your hands.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 現在我必須趕緊行動，因為在我試圖窺探拉戈斯知識的過程中，他已發現了我的探查魔法，此刻他的傭兵正步步逼近。我並不關心自己的安危，但我祈禱我的魔法仍足夠強大，能將這封信送到你手中。

English (遊戲原文): My workshop contains powerful quest knowledge which I have gathered using magic and other, more physical, methods. Use it to help you during your quest. My only regret is that I cannot personally be there to counsel you during your quest. May fate smile upon you... and upon me.\n\nSaradon.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 我的工坊中藏有強大的任務知識，這些知識是我透過魔法以及其他更為實際的方法所收集而來。請善用它們來協助你的旅程。我唯一的遺憾是無法親自在你冒險途中提供建言。願命運眷顧你……也眷顧我。\n\n——薩拉頓。

English (遊戲原文):
You find a staff leaning against the bookshelf.

It has a note attached to it, which reads:

"This staff harmonizes the magical energies around it and channels them into the wielder, replenishing their spell points.

Take it, for it will surely provide some assistance to you on your journey, adventurers."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你發現一根法杖靠在書架上。

上面繫著一張紙條，寫著：

「這根法杖能調和周圍的魔法能量，並將其導入持有者體內，補充其法術點數。

拿去吧，冒險者們，它必定能在你們的旅程中提供一些幫助。」

English (遊戲原文): You find some handwritten notes from Saradon upon a stack of books. They read:\n\n"I've come across a spell of such power that a mage may only know it in transience. I first learnt of its existence in the Tombs, but to dream of wielding it one must delve into the Destiny Stone..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你在成堆的書本上發現薩拉頓的手寫筆記。內容寫著：\n\n「我偶然發現一道咒語，其力量之強大，法師僅能短暫領悟。我最初是在墓穴中得知它的存在，但若要夢想掌握它，就必須深入命運之石……」

English (遊戲原文): Some more notes lay here:\n\n"To learn the spell one must take five clues into the stone. But the order, it's all wrong..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡還有更多筆記：\n\n「要學會這道咒語，必須帶著五條線索進入石中。但順序完全錯了……」

English (遊戲原文): And another page reads:\n\n"The crypt holds the first, and a maze will lead you to the second..."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 另一頁寫著：\n\n「墓穴藏有第一條，迷宮將引你找到第二條……」

English (遊戲原文): And another page reads:\n\n"The third lies in a castle, and a fort for the fourth."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 另一頁寫著：\n\n「第三條位於城堡中，堡壘則藏有第四條。」

English (遊戲原文): A final page reads:\n\n"A tall tower keeps the final secret."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 最後一頁寫著：\n\n「高塔守護著最終的秘密。」

English (遊戲原文): You find a note from Saradon's personal journal.\n\nThe mysterious appearance of the tower to the south is of great concern to me. Combined with the treachery of Oscon's betrayal to Count Waldec, things are at a boiling point. The time has come to seek help from abroad.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你發現了一張來自薩拉頓私人日記的紙條。\n\n南方那座塔的神祕出現令我深感憂慮。加上奧斯康背叛瓦爾戴克伯爵的背信棄義之舉，局勢已一觸即發。是時候向海外尋求援助了。

English (遊戲原文): You're in the forest outside of Skara Brae
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你身處斯卡拉布雷城外的森林中

English (遊戲原文): You have stepped into the wilderness for the first time. Would you like a quick tutorial on the game controls before you proceed?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你初次踏入了荒野。在繼續前進之前，是否要快速學習一下遊戲操作教學？

English (遊戲原文): Use W,A,S,D to move around the wilderness, or the cursor keys. You can also left click on the game view to move around.\n\nHold down right mouse on the game view and you can look around to take in the view.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使用 W、A、S、D 鍵或方向鍵在荒野中移動。你也可以在遊戲畫面上按滑鼠左鍵來移動。\n\n在遊戲畫面上按住滑鼠右鍵，即可環顧四周，欣賞景色。

English (遊戲原文): That is all... You should start by investigating the ruins of Skara Brae in the valley below.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 就這樣……你應該先從調查下方山谷中的斯卡拉布雷遺跡開始。

English (遊戲原文): To the north is the refugee camp.
You are next to Scrapwood Tavern.
You are next to a small shrine.
Deeply hidden in verdant shadows, this grove, the Twilight Copse, is quiet and feels very peaceful.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這片名為暮光小樹林的林地，深藏在翠綠的陰影之中，寧靜而祥和。

English (遊戲原文): Here, halfway up Earthdagger Mountain, winds swirl around and make this place earn its name: Cold Peak.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此處位於地匕山半山腰，狂風迴旋，使其名符其實：冷峰。

English (遊戲原文): Amid the bountiful trees you find a bubbling Crystal Spring that almost glows with purity.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在豐饒的樹林間，你發現了一處冒泡的水晶泉，其純淨幾乎散發著光芒。

English (遊戲原文): Lovingly tunneled into the mountainside, the opening to the Old Dwarf Mine looks natural.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 舊矮人礦坑的入口被精心開鑿於山腰，看起來渾然天成。

English (遊戲原文): Stabbing up into the sky like an obsidian dagger, Shadow Rock is utterly alien to the surrounding landscape.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 暗影岩如黑曜石匕首般刺向天際，與周圍景觀格格不入。

English (遊戲原文): The flat, grassy plain stretches peacefully out in all directions. This is the Vale of Lost Warriors.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 平坦的草原靜謐地向四方延伸。這裡是失落戰士谷。

English (遊戲原文): Foul, noxious gases reeking of rotten eggs, bubble up through the turgid, yellow, mud-laden waters of Sulphur Springs.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 硫磺泉中翻騰著惡臭如腐蛋的毒氣，從渾濁、黃色、泥濘的水中冒出氣泡。

English (遊戲原文): The party sees the old review board to the east.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 隊伍看見東邊有座舊仲裁委員會。

English (遊戲原文): There is a statue of the Mad God Tarjan here. It's strange that it is clean and shiny as if someone has been caring for it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一座狂神塔爾揚的雕像。奇怪的是，它乾淨閃亮，彷彿一直有人在照料它。

English (遊戲原文): Among the ruins of Skara Brae is an unnatural silence. As if death itself has come to stay.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 斯卡拉布雷的廢墟中籠罩著一股不自然的寂靜，彷彿死亡本身已在此長駐。

English (遊戲原文): The feeling of evil is foreboding.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 邪惡的氣息令人不寒而慄。

English (遊戲原文): To the east is the Temple of the Mad God.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 東邊是瘋狂之神的神廟。

English (遊戲原文):
"This is the temple of the Mad God. What is thy business, unbeliever?"

Speak to priest?
Chinese (請填寫中文):
「此乃瘋狂之神的神廟。不信者，汝有何事？」

要與祭司交談嗎？

English (遊戲原文):
"Only those who know the name of the Mad one are welcome."
What wilt thou say?
Chinese (請填寫中文):
「唯有知曉瘋狂者之名者，方受歡迎。」
汝欲言何物？

English (遊戲原文): "Speak not the name of the High one so loudly, lest he answer," the priest says. "Enter the catacombs, believer."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「切勿如此大聲呼喚至高者的名諱，以免祂應聲降臨，」祭司說道。「信徒啊，進入墓穴吧。」

English (遊戲原文): "Welcome true believers! Follow the true path of Chaos and your destiny will come to you. Enter the realm of Brilhasti ap Tarj."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「歡迎真正的信徒！追隨混沌的真道，你的命運自會到來。進入 Brilhasti ap Tarj 的領域吧。」

English (遊戲原文): "Welcome true believers! Enter the realm of shadow.\n\nBrilhasti awaits you!!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「歡迎真正的信徒！踏入暗影之境。\n\n布里哈斯蒂在等你！！」

English (遊戲原文): "Welcome true believers! Those who live by the sword shall perish by the sword.\n\nBrilhasti awaits you!!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「歡迎真正的信徒！凡動刀的，必死在刀下。\n\n布里哈斯蒂在等你！！」

English (遊戲原文): There are some stairs leading down into the catacombs.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 有幾階階梯向下通往地下墓穴。

English (遊戲原文): Under a pile of rubble that was once the home of Longinus, you see a limp, lifeless body, reaching to the sky as if for some final profound gesture.\n\nAlas, poor Longinus.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在曾是隆基努斯家的一堆瓦礫下，你看見一具癱軟無生氣的身軀，向天伸著手，彷彿在做出某個最終的深遠姿態。\n\n唉，可憐的隆基努斯。

English (遊戲原文): A tattered note, written in the hand of Longinus the Mad reads:\n"Faith will not save you, nor belief, pray fate blesses you with a thief."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一張破舊的便條，以瘋狂的隆基努斯的手跡寫著：\n「信仰救不了你，信念也無用，祈禱命運賜你一個盜賊吧。」

English (遊戲原文):
You find a tattered note, written in the hand of Longinus the Mad. It reads:

"Faith will not save you, nor belief,
Pray fate blesses you with a thief."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你找到一張破舊的便條，以瘋狂的隆基努斯的手跡寫著。上面寫道：

「信仰救不了你，信念也無用，
祈禱命運賜你一個盜賊吧。」

English (遊戲原文): The last prophecy of Longinus the Mad.\n"Rage against it or sing its praises, A maze cares not if it amazes."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 瘋狂的隆基努斯最後的預言。\n「對它怒吼或歌頌讚美，迷宮不在乎是否令人驚奇。」

English (遊戲原文):
This looks to be the last prophecy of Longinus the Mad...

"Rage against it or sing its praises,
A maze cares not if it amazes."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
這看來是瘋狂的隆基努斯最後的預言……

「對它怒吼或歌頌讚美，
迷宮不在乎是否令人驚奇。」

English (遊戲原文): Original Game scenario design by Michael A. Stackpole.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 原版遊戲劇情設計：Michael A. Stackpole。\n

English (遊戲原文): Programming and Direction by Rebecca Ann Heineman.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 程式設計與指導：Rebecca Ann Heineman。\n

English (遊戲原文): Playtesters: Bruce Schlickbernd, Rebecca Ann Heineman, Jennell Jaquays
Chinese (請填寫中文): 測試玩家：Bruce Schlickbernd、Rebecca Ann Heineman、Jennell Jaquays

English (遊戲原文): Through the rubble to the east you can see the scorched walls of Harkyn's Castle. In the distance, the partially toppled tower of Kylearan tells the tale of the good wizard's fate.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 穿過東方的瓦礫，你可以看見哈肯城堡焦黑的城牆。遠方，凱爾拉蘭那半倒的高塔，訴說著這位善良巫師的命運。

English (遊戲原文): The collapsed remains of Roscoe's Energy Emporium lies before you to the north, its owner yet another victim of the Mad God's attack.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 羅斯柯能量商店的坍塌殘骸就在你北邊，店主也成了瘋神攻擊下的又一名受害者。

English (遊戲原文): As you turn the corner, you think you hear singing and the skillful strumming of a lute?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 當你轉過街角，似乎聽見了歌聲和熟練的魯特琴彈奏？

English (遊戲原文): To the south is all that remains of the old Dragonbreath Inn. You can clearly hear a melody now, cutting through the still smouldering wreckage of the tavern.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 南邊是舊龍息旅店僅存的遺跡。現在你能清楚聽見一段旋律，穿透酒館仍在悶燒的廢墟傳來。

English (遊戲原文): Reaching into the sky, Valarian's Tower stands as a monument for what once was.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 直入雲霄的瓦拉瑞安之塔，矗立為昔日榮光的紀念碑。

English (遊戲原文): Foul noxious fumes rise from a gaping pit.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 從一個張開的深坑中升起惡臭的有毒煙霧。

English (遊戲原文): The finger of the lake shimmers in a natural glow all its own.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 湖的手指在自身天然光輝中閃爍。

English (遊戲原文): An old hut sits by the shore of a beautiful lake. Fishing equipment is stacked neatly against the hut's wall.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一座老舊小屋坐落在美麗湖畔。釣魚用具整齊地堆疊在小屋牆邊。

English (遊戲原文): The ground is littered with acorns.

You see a large oak tree here, and the ground is littered with acorns.

Do you want to pick a fresh acorn off the tree?
Chinese (請填寫中文):
你看到這裡有一棵巨大的橡樹，地上散落著橡實。

你想從樹上摘一顆新鮮的橡實嗎？

English (遊戲原文): This field is full of beautiful flowers that float and dance on the light breezes.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這片田野開滿了美麗的花朵，在微風中飄揚起舞。

English (遊戲原文): There is a large pile of Arefolia leaves here.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一大堆阿雷佛利亞樹葉。

English (遊戲原文): \n\nDo you want to gather some leaves?
Hawkslayer alerts you that he has important items that you should take with you before you leave!
Chinese (請填寫中文): Hawkslayer 提醒你，他有一些重要物品，你應該在離開前帶上！

English (遊戲原文): You see a deep, dark pit scarring the land like a wound.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你看見一個深邃黑暗的深坑，像傷口般烙印在大地上。\n

English (遊戲原文): Do you wish to enter it?
You are inside a an old, battered tower.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你身在一座老舊破敗的高塔內。\n

English (遊戲原文): Do you wish to climb up?
Beneath the waves of the lake, you see a building.\n

Chinese (請填寫中文): 蘭納提爾的力量之杖散發出內在的光芒，散發著一股難以置信的力量靈氣。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): Warm to the touch, the Sphere of Lanatir seems to want to be used in the name of Good.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 蘭納提爾之球觸感溫暖，彷彿渴望以良善之名被使用。\n\n

Chinese (請填寫中文): 這座巨大城堡的堅實冰壁，將外頭的猛烈風暴阻擋在外。即便如此，堡內仍舊寒冷，凍死的危險即使在此處也如影隨形。

English (遊戲原文): You see a shadowy figure that resembles a beautiful woman. She says,:\n\n"I want the Flower of
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你看見一個形似美麗女子的朦朧身影。她說：\n\n「我要艾利里亞

English (遊戲原文): The shadowy figure liked the 'Rainbow Rose'.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 那朦朧身影很喜歡『彩虹玫瑰』。

English (遊戲原文): She liked the gift but it wasn't what she asked for.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 她喜歡這份禮物，但這並非她所求之物。

English (遊戲原文): You are in the resting place of Alliria. Objects of great beauty are lovingly placed in all the four corners.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你身處艾莉瑞亞的長眠之地。四個角落都精心擺放著極其美麗的物品。

English (遊戲原文): In this intricately decorated room sits the Crown of Truth.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在這間裝飾繁複的房間中，安放著真理之冠。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): Lying over the coffin of Alliria is her belt.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 艾莉瑞亞的棺木上放著她的腰帶。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): A hole in time... we didn't enter it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個時間之洞……我們沒有進入。

English (遊戲原文): You feel an electric tingling and know this place is a hole in time.\nDo you wish to use it?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你感到一陣電擊般的刺痛，明白此處是個時間之洞。\n你是否想使用它？

English (遊戲原文): A hole in time to K'un Wang.
A hole in time to Wasteland.
A hole in time to Nottingham.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 通往諾丁漢的時空裂洞。

English (遊戲原文): A hole in time to Berlin.
You see a ghostly death's-head floating above this spot and hear a voice ask, "Who am I?"\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你看見一個幽靈般的骷髏頭漂浮在此處上空，並聽見一個聲音問道：「我是誰？」\n\n

English (遊戲原文): A cruel, harsh wind sweeps over you and you hear, "I am known as MARS," whispered in your ear.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一陣殘酷凜冽的風掃過你，你聽見耳邊低語：「吾名為 MARS。」

English (遊戲原文): A dry wind drives dust over you that rattles off armor. The blood-red sky forms a bowl over a broken, glowing landscape that something hideous and powerful has smashed utterly.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一陣乾燥的風揚起塵土，打在盔甲上鏗鏘作響。血紅色的天空如碗般籠罩著一片破碎、發光的大地，顯然曾被某種可怖而強大的存在徹底摧毀。

English (遊戲原文): Shattered buildings surround you. Misshapen and misbegotten creatures lurk in the ruins. Whatever destroyed this place warped and destroyed these things as well.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 破碎的建築物環繞著你。畸形且墮落的生物潛伏在廢墟之中。無論是什麼摧毀了這個地方，也同樣扭曲並毀滅了這些東西。

English (遊戲原文): Through the smoke you see only shadows and swirls of light. Things gibber and cavort just out of sight, and the wind sounds like the groans of dying warriors.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 透過煙霧，你只看見陰影與旋轉的光流。有東西在視線之外吱喳亂語、嬉鬧跳躍，而風聲聽起來就像垂死戰士的呻吟。

English (遊戲原文): Here is the strongest feeling of power you have had in this strange warland. Through the door to the south, fate awaits you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這是你在這片奇異的戰爭之地所感受到最強烈的力量。穿過南方的門，命運正等待著你。

English (遊戲原文): To the east is an image of the wilderness back home in Skara Brae.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 東邊浮現出史卡拉布雷家鄉荒野的景象。

English (遊戲原文): A portal back to the Wilderness back home in Skara Brae.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一道傳送門，通往家鄉斯卡拉布雷的荒野。

English (遊戲原文): A portal from Tarmitia took us to this spot.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一道來自塔米提亞的傳送門將我們帶到了此處。

English (遊戲原文): Werra's Shield is here, it looks as it was forged yesterday.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 維拉之盾就在這裡，它看起來就像昨天才鑄造好的一樣。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): Having recovered Werra's Shield, and with the Strife Spear safely in Hawkslayer's capable hands, you decide it is time to return to the old man in Skara Brae and inform him of Werra's passing.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 尋回了維拉之盾，而紛爭長矛也安全地交到了鷹殺者那雙能幹的手中，你認為是時候回到斯卡拉布雷，將維拉已逝的消息告知那位老人了。

English (遊戲原文): A tall, hugely muscled man laughs. "You've come for my shield? Earn it!!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一名高大、肌肉虯結的男子大笑：「你是來拿我的盾牌？憑本事來拿吧！！」
興高采烈地向你發動攻擊的是

English (遊戲原文): "And I was beginning to enjoy myself!!"
Werra lies dead before the party's feet.
Chinese (請填寫中文): Werra 倒在冒險隊伍腳前，氣絕身亡。

English (遊戲原文): Werra sits up in a pool of his own blood and laughs. "That's the best fight I've had since I battled Hawkslayer and gave him Strifespear."
Chinese (請填寫中文): Werra 在自己的一灘血泊中坐起身來，大笑道：「這是我跟『弒鷹者』交手、把『紛爭之矛』給他之後，打過最痛快的一場架了。」

English (遊戲原文): He notices your looks of disbelief. "Come, you didn't think mere mortals could kill me, did you?"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他注意到你們難以置信的表情。「怎麼，你們該不會以為區區凡人就能殺死我吧？」

English (遊戲原文): He smiles. "Here, my shield is yours. You'll find it in the next room."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他微微一笑。「來，我的盾牌就交給你了。你會在隔壁房間找到它。」

English (遊戲原文): The smile fades from Werra's face as a wild screeching sound fills the room and black shapes manifest themselves all around you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一陣狂野的尖嘯聲充滿房間，黑色形體在你們周圍顯現，Werra 臉上的笑容隨之消失。

English (遊戲原文): "Uh, oh." is all Werra can say as you see
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「呃，喔。」Werra 只能這麼說，而你們看見

English (遊戲原文): The hordes of slayers didn't seem really interested in attacking the party. They disappear as fast as they appeared leaving only the dead behind.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 那群殺手大軍似乎對攻擊冒險隊伍沒什麼興趣。牠們消失得和出現時一樣快，只留下屍體在後方。

English (遊戲原文): Amid the bodies you see Werra's twisted form. Life drains from him and you know he is beyond help.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在屍體中，你看見 Werra 扭曲的身形。生命正從他身上流逝，你知道他已無可救藥。

English (遊戲原文): "It takes a god to kill a god. Drink deep of his blood." He shudders and lies very still.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「唯有神能殺神。暢飲他的鮮血吧。」他顫抖了一下，然後靜止不動。

English (遊戲原文): The body of the valiant warrior Werra, lies crumbled and beaten on the floor here.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 英勇戰士 Werra 的遺體，癱軟破碎地躺在這裡的地板上。

English (遊戲原文): A hole in time to Rome.
A hole in time to Berlin.
A hole in time to Wasteland.
You see a ghostly death's-head floating above this spot and hear a voice ask, "Who am I?"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你看見一個幽靈般的骷髏頭漂浮在此處上方，並聽見一個聲音問道：「我是誰？」

English (遊戲原文): "Now speak my true name, if you dare..."\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「現在，說出我的真名，如果你敢的話……」\n\n

English (遊戲原文): A cruel, harsh wind sweeps over you and you hear, "I am known as ARES," whispered in your ear.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一陣殘酷而凜冽的風掃過你，你聽見耳邊低語：「吾名為 ARES。」

English (遊戲原文): Through the smoke you see children in uniforms carrying weapons and scurrying for cover. Men in green, with red stars on their caps, oppose them.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 穿過煙霧，你看見身穿制服、手持武器的孩童們正匆忙尋找掩護。頭戴綠色軍帽、帽上綴有紅星的男人們與他們對峙。

English (遊戲原文): Men in ragged green uniforms, with red stars on their caps, stalk the streets. Children in black uniforms oppose them and battle fiercely for their city.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 身穿破爛綠色制服、帽上綴有紅星的男人們在街上巡行。身穿黑色制服的孩子們與他們對抗，為自己的城市奮勇作戰。

English (遊戲原文): A hole in time to Stalingrad.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 通往史達林格勒的時空裂隙。

English (遊戲原文): A hole in time to Hiroshima.
A cruel, harsh wind sweeps over you and you hear, "I am known as SDIABM," whispered in your ear.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一陣殘酷凜冽的寒風席捲而來，你聽見耳邊低語：「吾名 SDIABM」。

English (遊戲原文): Cold winds whip through the desolate streets. Men in black uniforms slink through the streets and battle with weary warriors in ragged green uniforms.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 冷風呼嘯掠過荒涼的街道。身穿黑色制服的男子們在街巷間潛行，與身穿破爛綠色制服的疲憊戰士交戰。

English (遊戲原文): Men in ragged, green uniforms, with red stars on their caps, rage through the streets and assault warriors in black uniforms. Despite the biting cold, the battle is very nasty.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 身穿破爛綠色制服、帽上綴有紅星的男子們在街上橫衝直撞，攻擊身穿黑色制服的戰士。儘管寒風刺骨，戰況仍舊十分慘烈。

English (遊戲原文): Here, out of the wind, you watch as men from opposing armies battle each other with clubs and shovels. All look weary, but they do not surrender to their fatigue.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在此處避風之處，你目睹敵對軍隊的士兵們以棍棒與鐵鍬互相廝殺。所有人看來都已疲憊不堪，卻無人向倦意屈服。

English (遊戲原文): A hole in time to Stalingrad.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 通往史達林格勒的時空裂縫。

English (遊戲原文): A hole in time to Hiroshima.
A hole in time to Troy.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 通往特洛伊的時空裂縫。

English (遊戲原文): A cruel, harsh wind sweeps over you and you hear, "I am known as TYR," whispered in your ear.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一陣殘酷凜冽的寒風掃過你，你聽見耳邊低語：「吾名為提爾」。

English (遊戲原文): Fierce warriors in tan fatigues patrol the streets. A rising sun flag flutters atop a nearby building, and your odd garb makes you an immediate object of everyone's attention.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 身穿卡其色作戰服的兇猛戰士在街道上巡邏。附近建築頂上飄揚著旭日旗，你奇異的裝束立刻讓你成為眾人注目的焦點。

English (遊戲原文): Buildings of wood and paper look out of place compared to the machined weapons the warriors carry through the streets. You are marked immediately as strangers and warriors move to engage you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 木造與紙造的建築，與戰士們攜帶的機械化武器格格不入。你們立刻被標記為陌生人，戰士們開始朝你們逼近。

English (遊戲原文): Warriors in tan fatigues contrast wildly with the subtle beauty of the wooden and paper buildings in the city. Everyone stares at you because you are obviously foreigners.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 身穿卡其色作戰服的戰士，與城中木造紙造建築的雅致之美形成強烈對比。每個人都盯著你看，因為你們顯然是外來者。

English (遊戲原文): A hole in time to Troy.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 通往特洛伊的時空裂縫。

English (遊戲原文): A cruel, harsh wind sweeps over you and you hear, "I am known as SVARAZIC," whispered in your ear.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一陣殘酷凜冽的寒風席捲而來，你聽見耳邊低語：「吾名為 SVARAZIC。」

English (遊戲原文): Greek warriors in ornate breastplates battle with bold Trojan warriors in the city streets. In the chaos you are able to pass through the area without organized opposition.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 身著華麗胸甲的希臘戰士，在城中的街道上與勇猛的特洛伊戰士交戰。在混亂之中，你得以穿過這片區域，而未遭遇有組織的抵抗。

English (遊戲原文): The Trojan palace is a gorgeous building filled with massive marble statues and gilded furnishings. Here warriors oppose your passage, but more, you sense, to stop your stealing their loot than out of loyalty.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 特洛伊宮殿是一座華美的建築，內部滿是巨大的大理石雕像與鍍金的陳設。這裡有戰士阻擋你的去路，但你感覺，他們更多是為了阻止你搶奪他們的戰利品，而非出於忠誠。

English (遊戲原文): Struggling warriors fight through the streets and attack anyone or anything belligerent within sight. You see bodies and blood everywhere, and you know this city is already lost.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 奮戰中的戰士們在街道上廝殺，攻擊視線內任何有敵意的目標。你四處可見屍體與鮮血，你知道這座城市已經淪陷。

English (遊戲原文): A hole in time to Rome.
A cruel, harsh wind sweeps over you and you hear, "I am known as ST. GEORGE," whispered in your ear.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一陣殘酷凜冽的寒風襲來，你聽見耳邊低語：「吾名為聖喬治。」

English (遊戲原文): Huns roam this city of marble and brick, killing citizens and battling soldiers. Despite your strange garb, you are ignored by many of those fighting around you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 匈奴人在這座大理石與磚石砌成的城市中四處遊蕩，屠殺市民、與士兵交戰。儘管你衣著奇特，周圍許多戰鬥中的人們並未理會你。

English (遊戲原文): Huns stalk the city streets looking for anyone to kill and anything to steal. Their cruel expressions send a chill up your spine. This city is doomed.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 匈奴人在城街中潛行，尋找任何可殺之人與可竊之物。他們殘酷的神情令你脊背發涼。這座城市已然注定滅亡。

English (遊戲原文): Roman legionnaires wander the streets in small squads, rooting out Huns and other looters, then killing them on the spot. Citizens flee lest they fall prey to these angry soldiers.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 羅馬軍團士兵以小隊形式在街道上巡邏，搜捕匈人與其他掠奪者，並當場處決他們。市民們紛紛逃竄，以免成為這些憤怒士兵的犧牲品。

English (遊戲原文): A hole in time to Nottingham.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 通往諾丁罕的時空裂洞。

English (遊戲原文): A cruel, harsh wind sweeps over you and you hear, "I am known as YEN-LO-WANG," whispered in your ear.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一陣殘酷凜冽的寒風席捲而來，你聽見耳邊低語：「吾名為閻羅王。」

English (遊戲原文): Ragged bands of Saxon peasants rush through the muddy streets and engage Norman knights wherever they meet. The Saxons appear to be winning their fight.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 衣衫襤褸的撒克遜農民成群結隊地衝過泥濘的街道，與諾曼騎士狹路相逢便展開廝殺。撒克遜人似乎正佔上風。

English (遊戲原文): Norman knights, clad in mail armor, battle a rabble of peasants and men in Lincoln green. Though the battle rages around you, no one side is clearly superior.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 身穿鎖子甲的諾曼騎士，正與一群農民和身著林肯綠的弓箭手交戰。雖然戰火在你四周蔓延，但雙方勝負難分，並無明顯優勢的一方。

English (遊戲原文): Warriors clad in Lincoln green lead a peasant mob in assaults against Norman knights. The battle appears to be even.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 身穿林肯綠的戰士率領農民暴民襲擊諾曼騎士。戰況看似勢均力敵。

English (遊戲原文): A hole in time to K'un Wang.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 通往 K'un Wang 的時空裂縫。

English (遊戲原文): A cruel, harsh wind sweeps over you and you hear, "I am known as SUSA-NO-O," whispered in your ear.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一陣殘酷凜冽的寒風襲來，你聽見耳邊低語：「吾名須佐之男。」

English (遊戲原文): The acrid scent of burning wood floats on the air. Mongol warriors and Imperial soldiers fight in the streets around you while Chinese peasants flee for their lives.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 燒焦木頭的刺鼻氣味飄散在空氣中。蒙古戰士與帝國士兵在你周圍的街道上廝殺，而中國農民則四散奔逃。

English (遊戲原文): Mongol invaders and Chinese warriors battle openly in the streets around you. In the confusion you pass almost unnoticed despite your odd garb and looks.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 蒙古入侵者與中國武士在你周圍的街道上公然交戰。在一片混亂中，儘管你衣著怪異、相貌奇特，卻幾乎無人注意。

English (遊戲原文): The smoldering ruins smell odd and seem somewhat unfocused. It seems very much as if they do not belong here at all. Something very alien is present.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 悶燒的廢墟散發著奇異的氣味，景象也顯得有些模糊失焦。它們彷彿完全不屬於此處，某種極其異質的存在降臨於此。

English (遊戲原文): There is a strange silence ahead.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 前方籠罩著一股詭異的寂靜。

English (遊戲原文): Foul reeking air is coming from under the door.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 門縫下傳來一股惡臭難聞的空氣。
祭司們正在尋找另一個字詞……

English (遊戲原文): Amongst some rubble you find some serviceable stairs leading back up to the ruins of Skara Brae.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你在瓦礫堆中發現了一條堪用的階梯，可以向上通往史卡拉布雷的廢墟。

English (遊戲原文): This dark, gloomy tunnel reeks of death and moldy rot. You shiver to think something could live down here, and you shiver to think you might die down here.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這條陰暗潮濕的隧道散發著死亡與腐爛的霉味。想到有什麼東西能在這裡生存，你打了個寒顫；想到自己可能死在這裡，你又打了個寒顫。
你的魔法在此處附近變得搖曳不定。

English (遊戲原文): There seems to be an odd magnetic disturbance near.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 附近似乎有一股奇異的磁場干擾。

English (遊戲原文): The floor sure feels sticky here.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡的地板摸起來確實很黏。

English (遊戲原文): ... this word will allow access to the unholy domain of Brilhasti ap Tarj.
Chinese (請填寫中文): ……這個字將允許進入 Brilhasti ap Tarj 的不潔領域。

English (遊戲原文): Written in Blood are large letters which spell out CHAOS.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 以血書寫的大字拼出了「CHAOS」。

English (遊戲原文): Lying sprawled on the cold marble floors you see a skeleton clad in armor. The back and breast plates are crushed as if some giant child grabbed a doll and squeezed it in rage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你看到一具身穿盔甲的骷髏攤臥在冰冷的大理石地板上。其前後胸甲都被壓碎，彷彿某個巨大的孩子抓起一個玩偶，在憤怒中將其捏扁。

English (遊戲原文): Carved from solid rock, the Dwarven castle you find yourself standing in radiates strength and power. Sadly, however, its walls also bear the scars of war -- and many of them are very recent.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這座由堅實岩石鑿成的矮人要塞，散發著力量與威嚴。然而，令人遺憾的是，它的牆壁上也滿是戰爭的傷痕——而且許多都是最近留下的。

English (遊戲原文): The castle's Grand Reception room looms high over your head, its vaulted ceiling lost in the dim light above you. Strewn throughout you see the torn and shattered bodies of Dwarves and strange machines.

English (遊戲原文): Ferofist's Throne Room, stripped of the fine furnishings it once had, seems violated and dead. Broken and long dead combatants fill the room. It is a very grim sight.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 費洛菲斯特的王座廳，昔日華麗的陳設已被剝奪殆盡，顯得既遭褻瀆又死氣沉沉。破碎且早已戰死的鬥士充斥整個房間。景象極為陰森。

English (遊戲原文): Scratched deep into the wall, with coppery shards of metal embedded in the stone, you read: Why must those who rise to rival their creators always be considered damned?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上刻著深深的字跡，石縫中嵌著銅色金屬碎片，你讀到：為何那些崛起挑戰創造者的人，總是被視為該受詛咒？

English (遊戲原文): Standing before you, blocking the hallway, you see Hawkslayer. He's younger than the last time you met, and shows none of the signs of his long adventuring career.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 站在你面前、擋住走廊的，是「獵鷹殺手」。他比你上次遇見時更年輕，身上完全沒有長期冒險生涯的痕跡。

English (遊戲原文): He stares at you and says, "The old one said I'd find allies, but I don't work with just anyone. I only want smart allies."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他盯著你說：「那位老者說我會找到盟友，但我可不是跟誰都合作。我只想要聰明的盟友。」

English (遊戲原文): "Answer this riddle:\nColder than myself, I cover myself with myself, and shrink so I can grow large again."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「回答這個謎語：\n比我更冷，我用自己覆蓋自己，縮小以便再次變大。」

English (遊戲原文): "If you can't answer that simple a riddle, I don't know how you'll survive in Kinestia. I better come along and keep you safe."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「如果你連這麼簡單的謎語都答不出來，我真不知道你要怎麼在 Kinestia 活下去。我最好跟著你，確保你的安全。」

English (遊戲原文): "Glad to be in smart company. Listen, you magickers should know, magic is screwy here. Be careful."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「很高興跟聰明人同行。聽著，你們這些法師應該要知道，這裡的魔法亂七八糟的。小心點。」

English (遊戲原文): You come upon a sleeping Hawkslayer. He awakens and jumps into a fighting stance in a blink of an eye. You are taken by surprise.

Chinese (請填寫中文): 一小隊矮人抬頭發出威脅性的低吼，但一名坐在他們保護圈中央的年長矮人命令他們安靜。

Chinese (請填寫中文): 他的盔甲，曾是矮人匠師的傑作，如今千瘡百孔。老矮人奄奄一息，但當他看見你時，眼中閃爍著光芒。

Chinese (請填寫中文): 他虛弱地咳嗽著：「你們正如預言般到來。你們必須摧毀我與黑暗者愚蠢結盟的產物，找到鑰匙，穿過我的工坊進入烏爾梅克的巢穴。」

Chinese (請填寫中文): 一道來自南方的光芒劃破黑暗，映照出被這座地下湖泊中濃稠液體磨得光滑的石牆。

English (遊戲原文): There is an opening in the ceiling that seems to go to a new area.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 天花板上有一個開口，似乎通往新的區域。\n

English (遊戲原文): Do you wish to swim to it?
Urmech's private sanctum is a beautiful world of symmetrical metal tubes, jeweled globes and silvery tools. Here you sense great power and feel a facet of magic you have never sensed before.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 烏爾梅克的私人聖所是一個由對稱金屬管、寶石球體與銀色工具構成的美麗世界。在此你感受到強大的力量，並觸及了前所未見的魔法面向。

English (遊戲原文): Seated in a scrap-metal throne you see Urmech. His iron features seem to move like flesh, and his expression is one of sorrow.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你看到烏爾梅克坐在一張廢鐵鑄成的王座上。他那鐵鑄的面容竟如血肉般蠕動，神情滿是哀傷。

English (遊戲原文): "Is this how it must end, in violence, or can we work out an accommodation?"\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「難道這一切終須以暴力收場，還是我們能尋求和解？」\n\n

English (遊戲原文): "Pity, I'm afraid you give me no choice then." Attacking you is
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「可惜，恐怕你讓我別無選擇了。」說著便向你發動攻擊

English (遊戲原文): "I'm glad we could avoid a confrontation."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「很高興我們能避免一場衝突。」

English (遊戲原文): Urmech's broken metal body rests on top of a scrap metal throne. We could fix him if we had a spanner, a lever, a nut and a bolt.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 烏爾梅克殘破的金屬身軀癱坐在一張廢鐵王座上。如果我們有扳手、槓桿、螺帽和螺栓，就能修好他。

English (遊戲原文): \nWe have the tools to repair him. He could still be useful.
Chinese (請填寫中文): \n我們有修理他的工具。他或許還能派上用場。

English (遊戲原文): Using your spanner, a lever, a bolt, a nut, and a bit of elbow grease, you manage to repair Urmech. He seems grateful for being put back together.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你用扳手、一根槓桿、一枚螺栓、一顆螺帽，再加上一點蠻力，成功修好了烏爾梅克。他似乎對被重新組裝起來心懷感激。

English (遊戲原文): \nUrmech doesn't look too damaged... perhaps we could repair him... We'll need a spanner, a lever, a nut and a bolt.
Chinese (請填寫中文): \n烏爾梅克看起來傷得不太重……或許我們能修好他……我們需要一把扳手、一根槓桿、一顆螺帽和一枚螺栓。

English (遊戲原文): "Ferofist created me, despite the Gods' Pact barring further creation, and through this heinous act, helped free the dark one."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「鐵拳創造了我，無視諸神之約禁止進一步創造的規定，而透過這項可憎之舉，他協助釋放了黑暗者。」

English (遊戲原文): "But what of me? I have done no evil except to live. I have, in turn, created others of my kind to protect me - and so I will not be all alone."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「但我呢？我除了活著之外，並未行惡。反過來，我創造了同類來保護自己——這樣我就不會孤單一人了。」

English (遊戲原文): "The items you seek are in my inner sanctum. I have no need of them and they are yours to take."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「你尋找的物品就在我的內殿中。我無需它們，你儘管取走。」

English (遊戲原文): "I have discovered a type of magic I will share with you, if you are willing."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「我發現了一種魔法，若你願意，我願與你分享。」

English (遊戲原文): "Those who wish to learn my magic should meet me at the rear of my sanctum. There I will instill this new power into your blood."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「想學習我魔法的人，到我的聖殿後方與我會合。在那裡，我將把這股新力量注入你的血脈。」

English (遊戲原文): With that, Urmech leaves and enters a chamber to the south.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 說完，烏爾梅克便離開，走進南邊的一間密室。

English (遊戲原文): We met Urmech here. He told us his story and entered a chamber to the south.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 我們在此遇見了烏爾梅克。他向我們訴說了自己的故事，然後走進了南邊的一間密室。

English (遊戲原文): A scrap metal throne is here. There is no sign of Urmech anywhere.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一座廢金屬製成的王座，但四處不見烏爾梅克的蹤影。

English (遊戲原文): Among the cold steel furniture that adorns Urmech's chamber is a small treasure chest.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在裝飾烏爾梅克房間的冰冷鋼製家具中，有一個小型寶箱。

English (遊戲原文): Ferofist's Helm is in the chest.\n\n
The Hammer of Wrath is in the chest.\n\n
There is a large machine here that radiates a magical aura. No one in the party can figure out how to use this machine and what it does.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一台散發著魔法靈光的大型機器。隊伍中沒有人能搞懂該如何使用這台機器，以及它的功用為何。

English (遊戲原文): Urmech stands before a strange and magical machine. This machine will transform a Warrior, Bard, Paladin, Hunter or Monk into a Geomancer!."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 烏爾梅克站在一台奇特而充滿魔法的機器前。這台機器能將戰士、吟遊詩人、聖騎士、獵人或武僧轉變為大地術士！

English (遊戲原文): Urmech stands before a strange and magical machine. He says...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 烏爾梅克站在一台奇特而充滿魔法的機器前。他說道……

English (遊戲原文): "This machine will instill into a Warrior, Bard, Paladin, Hunter or Monk the ability to use magic."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「這台機器將灌輸給戰士、吟遊詩人、聖騎士、獵人或武僧使用魔法的能力。」

English (遊戲原文): "You will be more than a warrior, you will be a Geomancer!!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「你將不僅僅是一名戰士，你將成為大地術士！！」

English (遊戲原文): "But know this, you will lose some of your fighter abilities and skills but the magic you possess will more than make up for the loss."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「但切記，你將失去部分戰士的能力與技巧，但你將擁有的魔法絕對足以彌補這份損失。」

English (遊戲原文): "Very well, I'll be here if you change your minds."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「很好，若你們改變心意，我會在此等候。」

English (遊戲原文): "I cannot change you, you aren't a warrior."
Urmech reaches out and caresses your temples with his copper fingers. You feel a tingle and you have been changed.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 烏爾梅克伸出他銅製的手指，輕撫你的太陽穴。你感到一陣刺痛，然後你被改變了。

English (遊戲原文): Through an open portal you see a viscous, bubbling liquid the color of pine pitch.\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 透過一道敞開的傳送門，你看見一灘黏稠、冒泡的液體，顏色如同松脂。

English (遊戲原文): Do you wish to climb into it?
Although Skara Brae lay in ruins, it felt far more alive than this place. Something here just feels wrong: it is not of this world. Even breathing this air feels dirty.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 儘管斯卡拉布雷已成廢墟，但感覺起來比這個地方更有生氣。這裡有些東西就是不對勁：它不屬於這個世界。就連呼吸這裡的空氣都覺得骯髒。

English (遊戲原文): Tacked on the door in the east wall you see the following message:\n\nThose who enter this door will never leave through it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 東側牆上的門貼著一張告示：\n\n「進入此門者，將永遠無法從此門離開。」

English (遊戲原文): The tint of melancholy paves the way.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 憂鬱的色調鋪平了道路。

English (遊戲原文): A splash of a noble's blood colors the exit.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一抹貴族的鮮血染紅了出口。

English (遊戲原文): The shade of the winds' home will make you free.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 風之故鄉的陰影將使你獲得自由。

English (遊戲原文): A magic mouth appears and says:\n"Speak the rhyming word to pass through!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一張魔法之嘴出現並說道：\n「說出押韻的詞語才能通過！」

English (遊戲原文): "Very good! You may be worthy to battle Brilhasti ap Tarj after all!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「非常好！看來你或許終究有資格與 Brilhasti ap Tarj 一戰！」

English (遊戲原文): Return from beyond this place is not possible by this means.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 無法透過此方式從此處返回。

English (遊戲原文): Down below, eschew the first right thing to do.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 往下走，避開第一個右轉的選擇。

English (遊戲原文): Light hurts me and bleeds me, but leaves me behind it always.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 光明會傷害我、使我流血，但總是將我遺留在它身後。

English (遊戲原文): The air down here smells of dry rot and other putrefaction. The dry air feels uncomfortable and leeches moisture from you as it saps your strength and courage.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此處的空氣聞起來有乾腐與其他腐朽的氣味。乾燥的空氣令人不適，它從你身上汲取水分，同時削弱你的力量與勇氣。

English (遊戲原文): A faded figure appears and asks:\n"I am nothing, I make nothing, but my opposite creates me even as it destroys me. What am I?"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個褪色的身影出現並問道：\n「我虛無，我創造虛無，但我的對立面在毀滅我的同時也創造了我。我是什麼？」

English (遊戲原文): Things that lurk, in shadows below Make it an unsafe place to go. First Ward: Spin lest ye be spun.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 潛伏在下方陰影中的事物，讓此處變得危險難行。第一守護：旋轉吧，以免你被旋轉。

English (遊戲原文):
The first Ward's Key:
NevEr Now,
EvEr iS SEEn,
ElitE aNd NarroW,
North by NorthWest Way,
Doves MourN.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
第一守護的鑰匙：
從不現在，
永恆所見，
精英而狹窄，
西北偏北之路，
哀悼之鴿。

English (遊戲原文): Only a fool would frontally assault the second Ward.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 只有傻瓜才會正面強攻第二守護。

English (遊戲原文): The third Ward's path of darkness is not without danger, but there is more to fear in the light of Brilhasti's insanity.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 第三守護的黑暗之路並非沒有危險，但在布里哈斯蒂瘋狂的光芒中，有更多值得畏懼之事。

English (遊戲原文): The three Wards below will try your soul, but that's the only way out of this hole. Brilhasti is cold and he is mean. Make sure his death is quick and clean.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 下方的三道守護將考驗你的靈魂，但這是逃出這個深淵的唯一途徑。布里哈斯蒂冷酷又無情。確保他的死亡既迅速又乾淨。

English (遊戲原文): The spectral hand of fear runs bony fingers down your spine. The air is hot and close. This place feels like the inside of a grave.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 恐懼的幽靈之手用骨感的手指滑過你的脊背。空氣炎熱而窒悶。這個地方感覺就像墓穴內部。

English (遊戲原文): A figure appears and asks:\n"I have no lips, yet my kiss is deadly. I am not a razor, but those I caress need never shave again. Your best friend, I will kill you."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個人影出現並問道：\n「我沒有嘴唇，但我的吻卻致命。我不是剃刀，但被我撫摸過的人無須再刮鬍子。你最好的朋友，我會殺了你。」
「說出我的名字，然後準備好迎接我。」

English (遊戲原文): Diddledy high,\nDiddledy low,\nCome brave blood sheep, you've a goodly way to go.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 高高在上，\n低低在下，\n來吧勇敢的血羊，汝還有漫漫長路要走。

English (遊戲原文):
So far, so good, this you all think,
Come even further, your blood I will drink.
Brilhasti am I, and great is my god.
Come to me, come, down the path few have trod.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
至今一切順利，汝等皆如此想，
再往前一步，我將飲汝之血。
吾乃 Brilhasti，吾神偉大無比。
來吧，到我這來，踏上這條少人走過的路。

English (遊戲原文): The party has entered the chamber of Brilhasti ap Tarj! He doesn't seem pleased to meet you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 冒險隊伍進入了 Brilhasti ap Tarj 的密室！他看起來並不樂意見到你們。

English (遊戲原文): You scream a hideous battle cry as you face
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你發出駭人的戰吼，直面眼前的敵人

English (遊戲原文): "You Wimps!" screams Brilhasti ap Tarj as the party bravely retreats.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「你們這些孬種！」Brilhasti ap Tarj 在隊伍英勇撤退時大聲叫囂。

English (遊戲原文): The party has killed Brilhasti ap Tarj!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 隊伍已擊殺 Brilhasti ap Tarj！

English (遊戲原文): A force is enveloping the party...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一股力量正籠罩著隊伍……

English (遊戲原文): This place is marked by the remains of a mighty battle... \n\nThis is where Brilhasti ap Tarj was defeated...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此處滿是激烈戰鬥的遺跡……\n\n這裡正是 Brilhasti ap Tarj 落敗之地……

English (遊戲原文): The god-awful stench of sulphurous tar swirls through this pit like a cyclone. Through the wisps of choking mist you see a small building amid bubbling tar flats.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 硫磺焦油的惡臭如同旋風般在這座礦坑中翻騰。透過令人窒息的煙霧，你看到在冒泡的焦油平地中有一座小建築物。

English (遊戲原文): You see the forest from here.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你從這裡可以看到森林。

English (遊戲原文): To the east you see a wide area of oozing tar that produces noxious burst of steam as bubbles burst and flick tar droplets around. To your horror you see things moving in the seething pool.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 向東望去，你看到一大片滲出焦油的區域，氣泡破裂時噴出有毒的蒸氣，並濺起焦油滴。令你驚恐的是，你看到翻騰的池中有東西在移動。

English (遊戲原文): North and south of you the skeletons and gnawed corpses of creatures trapped in the tar serve as grisly evidence of the deceptive dangers of the tar pit.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在你的南北兩側，被困在焦油中的生物骨骸與啃食過的屍體，成了這片焦油坑隱藏致命危險的駭人證據。

English (遊戲原文): The roiling slime-pit to the west reeks of putrefaction and decay. You see something move within the tar, but you are wise enough to keep your distance.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 西側翻騰的泥沼坑散發著腐敗與朽爛的惡臭。你看見焦油中有東西在移動，但你夠聰明，懂得保持距離。

English (遊戲原文): In the middle of the little building you see a small fountain jetting viscous black tar.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在小建築物的中央，你看見一座小噴泉正噴出黏稠的黑色焦油。

English (遊戲原文): {0} collects some of the gooey tar.
Chinese (請填寫中文): {0} 收集了一些黏稠的焦油。

English (遊戲原文): The Shadow Canyon stretches off into the distance. It appears to be without end but, you expect, this is, like so many other things in Tenebrosia, an illusion of some sort.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 暗影峽谷綿延至遠方，看似無盡，但你猜想，這和泰尼布羅西亞的許多事物一樣，不過是某種幻象。

English (遊戲原文): A passage is here back to the forest.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 此處有一條通道可返回森林。

English (遊戲原文): Scrawled in a crude hand on the canyon wall you see the message: A castle is only as weak as its strongest wall.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 峽谷壁上以粗劣的字跡刻著一則訊息：「一座城堡的弱點，在於它最堅固的城牆。」

English (遊戲原文): The canyon recedes into the land's twilight murk and you feel at the end of the canyon, yet still firmly in the middle of it. This place seems to ignore all logic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 峽谷逐漸沒入大地的暮色迷濛之中，你感覺自己已至峽谷盡頭，卻又仍深陷其中。這個地方似乎無視一切邏輯。

English (遊戲原文): Gibbering howls echo from black sandstone walls. You cannot tell from whence they originate, but you do know no human throat uttered the cries. You shiver involuntarily.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 從黑砂岩牆壁傳來陣陣囈語般的嚎叫。你無法辨別其來源，但你知道那絕非人類喉嚨發出的嘶吼。你不禁打了個寒顫。

English (遊戲原文): The walls are rotted around the traps.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 陷阱周圍的牆壁已經腐朽。

English (遊戲原文): Hidden away in a crevice on the cliff wall is a lock that looks more like a shadow than anything real.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 懸崖壁上的一道裂縫中，藏著一把看起來與其說是實物、不如說是影子的鎖。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): The darkness feels warm and living, yet is not menacing. It conceals things, but the sharply defined shadows also reveal a stability that lets you know this is the heart of Tenebrosia.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 黑暗感覺溫暖而有生命，卻不帶威脅。它隱藏了許多事物，但那些輪廓鮮明的陰影也展現出一種穩定感，讓你知道這裡正是泰諾布羅西亞的核心。

English (遊戲原文): Through the murk you see walls defining rooms with an utter absence of anything you would consider reason. You don't feel mortal dread, but a healthy fear of the unknown mixed with fear of surprises.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 透過昏暗的光線，你看見牆壁劃分出房間，卻完全沒有任何你認為合理的邏輯。你並不感到致命的恐懼，而是對未知懷有健康的畏懼，混雜著對突發狀況的戒備。

English (遊戲原文): Hushed whispers remind you of town gossips, and your ears burn as you are certain you've heard yourself mentioned several times, but you can recall no specific item and remember no definite words.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 低語的竊竊私語讓你想起了鎮上的閒言閒語，你的耳朵發燙，因為你確定好幾次聽到了自己的名字，但你無法回憶起任何具體的細節，也記不住明確的話語。

English (遊戲原文): Scratched on the wall you see: Just because you're paranoid, it doesn't mean you don't have enemies. You feel unfriendly eyes watching you closely.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 牆上刻著一行字：「就算你疑神疑鬼，也不代表你沒有敵人。」你感覺到不友善的目光正緊緊盯著你。

English (遊戲原文): Carved into the black basalt floor you see the gilded question: "If Nowhere is a circle, then the middle is at the end, isn't it?"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 黑色玄武岩地板上刻著鍍金的問題：「如果『無處』是一個圓，那麼中心就在終點，不是嗎？」

English (遊戲原文): You hear laughter echoing in your ears. "Close, but the other end is where your prize lurks."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你聽見笑聲在耳邊迴盪。「接近了，但另一頭才是你的獎賞潛伏之處。」

English (遊戲原文): A laugh floats hauntingly through the air. "Alas, this end is not the end you seek."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一陣笑聲幽幽飄盪在空中。「唉，這個結局並非你所追尋的終點。」

English (遊戲原文): Seated in a tall throne you see a powerful figure, but you notice almost immediately that it's easier to see him by not looking at him.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你看到一個威嚴的身影坐在高聳的王座上，但你幾乎立刻注意到，不直視他反而更容易看清他的模樣。

English (遊戲原文): He smiles somewhat uneasily. "I know what you have come for, but I cannot surrender it to you."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他略顯不安地微笑。「我知道你為何而來，但我無法將它交給你。」

English (遊戲原文): Sceadu, stripped of his life, cries out and collapses. "Damn you, Tarjan," he swears, then falls unconscious.
Chinese (請填寫中文): Sceadu 被奪去生命，慘叫一聲後癱倒在地。「去你的，Tarjan，」他咒罵道，隨即陷入昏迷。

English (遊戲原文): His labored chest heaves twice, then Sceadu lies utterly still.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他費力起伏的胸膛抽動了兩下，然後 Sceadu 便一動也不動了。

English (遊戲原文): Sceadu's Cloak covers its now deceased owner.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): Sceadu 的斗篷覆蓋著牠已故的主人。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): Next to Sceadu's throne is a beautifully crafted helmet. Too bad Sceadu wasn't wearing it when you ruined his day.\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在 Sceadu 的王座旁，有一頂做工精美的頭盔。可惜你毀了他的一天時，他沒戴著它。\n\n

English (遊戲原文): You look in pity at the body of Sceadu, "Why did he ally himself with the dark one?" someone asks.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你憐憫地看著 Sceadu 的屍體，有人問道：「他為何要與黑暗者結盟？」

English (遊戲原文): You feel an overpowering aura of evil here. You are close to finally fulfilling your quest.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你感受到一股壓倒性的邪惡氣息。你離最終完成任務已經不遠了。

English (遊戲原文): You feel power pulsing like a heartbeat. You are very close to the source of all evil!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你感覺到力量如心跳般脈動。你已非常接近所有邪惡的源頭！

English (遊戲原文): You feel that this is a gate back to the wilderness outside of Skara Brae.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你感覺到這是一道通往斯卡拉布雷城外荒野的傳送門。

English (遊戲原文): A one-way dimensional hole from Tarjan's realm dumped us out here.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一道來自塔爾然領域的單向次元洞將我們拋到了這裡。

English (遊戲原文): A dark, cloaked figure laughs. "So you think you could defeat me again, like the way you tricked me at Baron Harkyn's castle so many years ago?"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一個身穿黑袍的身影發出冷笑：「所以你以為你能再次擊敗我，就像多年前你在哈肯男爵城堡裡耍弄我的那樣？」

English (遊戲原文): "Now I'll have my revenge on you and I'll take what should rightfully be mine!!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「現在我要向你復仇，並奪回理應屬於我的一切！！」

English (遊戲原文): "I will possess control over all space and time!!"
Tarjan waves his arms and conjures up some friends.
Chinese (請填寫中文): Tarjan 揮動雙臂，召喚出一些幫手。

English (遊戲原文): "Here my pretties, time for target practice."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「來吧我的寶貝們，該練練靶子了。」

English (遊戲原文): "I knew you could never defeat my forces of darkness!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「我就知道你永遠無法擊敗我的黑暗大軍！」

English (遊戲原文): Tarjan has a look of complete surprise on his face, "Most impressive, you are a hardy lot."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 塔爾揚臉上露出完全驚訝的表情：「令人印象深刻，你們真是一群頑強的傢伙。」

English (遊戲原文): "Now I'll gleefully send you to the hell I came from and torment your souls for eternity."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「現在我會樂不可支地將你們送進我來時的地獄，並永遠折磨你們的靈魂。」

English (遊戲原文): Tarjan waves his arms and cries, "You will not live to see dawn!!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 塔爾揚揮舞雙臂大喊：「你們活不到黎明！！」

English (遊戲原文): You gather around Tarjan's dead body, carefully avoiding the steaming streams of vitriolic blood burning into the stone floor, and reality slowly begins to unravel around you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你們圍聚在塔爾揚的屍體旁，小心翼翼地避開那腐蝕石地、冒著蒸氣的酸性血液溪流，而你們周圍的現實開始逐漸崩解。

English (遊戲原文): You look up and discover, where there had only been a dark rock ceiling, a brilliantly lit chimney of stone.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你抬頭一看，發現原本只有黑暗岩石天花板的地方，出現了一道光芒四射的石頭煙囪。

English (遊戲原文): Time and space folds in upon itself and you reach a place made completely and utterly of light.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 時間與空間在自身中摺疊，你抵達了一個完全由光芒構成的所在。

English (遊戲原文): Seated in a glowing throne, a man smiles at you. Though he is youthful and handsome, you recognize him instantly as the old man who sent you upon your quest.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一位男子坐在發光的王座上，對你微笑。儘管他年輕英俊，你立刻認出他就是派你踏上任務的那位老人。

English (遊戲原文): Beside him stands your friend, Hawkslayer.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他的身旁站著你的朋友，Hawkslayer。

English (遊戲原文): The enthroned figure pulls out a sword and begins to speak...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 端坐於王座上的身影拔出一柄劍，開始說話……

English (遊戲原文): Looking around, you recognise the site where Tarjan was finally defeated. Now quiet, though still the remnants of Tarjan's beasts wander through this realm of evil.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 環顧四周，你認出這裡正是塔爾揚最終被擊敗的地點。如今雖已平靜，但塔爾揚的殘餘魔獸仍在這邪惡領域中遊蕩。

Chinese (請填寫中文): 你位於城市廣場的大門前

Chinese (請填寫中文): 我們在此處找到了赤紅吟遊詩人。
我們在此處找到了薩拉頓的遺體。

English (遊戲原文): We found a WardStone in Saradon's robes.

Chinese (請填寫中文): 近戰攻擊會對隊伍前四排中的單一角色造成傷害，除非其防禦等級夠低而能抵抗此攻擊。

Chinese (請填寫中文): 吐息攻擊會對所有未能以魔法抵抗的隊伍成員造成傷害。

English (遊戲原文):
THE LEGEND OF SKARA BRAE



Long ago in the land of Caith, when magic still prevailed, the evil wizard Mangar the Dark threatened a small but harmonious town called Skara Brae. Overnight, all the town's militiamen disappeared, and Mangar froze the surrounding countryside with a spell of Eternal Winter, totally isolating it from any possible help. 



As evil creatures oozed into the sewers to join Mangar’s shadow crusade, the future of Skara Brae hung in the balance. And who was left to resist? Only a handful of unproven young Warriors, some junior magic users, a couple of Bards barely old enough to drink, and a few out of work Rogues.



You are the leader of this ragtag group of freedom fighters. Luckily you have a Bard with you to sing your glories - if you survive - for this is the stuff of legends. 



And thus the story begins...
Chinese (請填寫中文):
斯卡拉布雷的傳說


許久以前，在凱斯這片土地上，當魔法仍盛行時，邪惡巫師「黑暗曼加」威脅著一個名為斯卡拉布雷的小鎮，那裡原本和諧安寧。一夜之間，鎮上所有民兵消失無蹤，曼加以永恆寒冬的法術冰封了周圍鄉野，使其完全孤立，無法獲得任何援助。


隨著邪惡生物滲入下水道，加入曼加的陰影遠征，斯卡拉布雷的未來岌岌可危。而留下來抵抗的又是誰呢？只有一群未經考驗的年輕戰士、幾名初階法師、幾位年紀尚輕的吟遊詩人，以及一些失業的盜賊。


你就是這群烏合之眾自由鬥士的領袖。幸運的是，你身邊有一位吟遊詩人，歌頌你的榮耀——如果你能存活下來的話——因為這正是傳奇的素材。


於是，故事就此展開……

English (遊戲原文): "The song I sing\nwill tell the tale\nof a cold and wintery day"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「我所吟詠的樂章，\n將訴說一段往事——\n那段冰封刺骨的凜冬歲月。」

English (遊戲原文): "When evil fled\nand brave men bled\nthe Dark One came to stay."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「當正義落荒而逃\n當勇士鮮血流盡\n那名黑暗的主宰，自此降臨肆虐。」

English (遊戲原文): "Of castle walls\nand torchlit halls\nand a price men had to pay."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那是關於高聳城牆\n與火炬長廊的過往\n以及凡人不得不付出的沉重代價。」

English (遊戲原文): "Till men of old\nfor blood and gold\nhad rescued Skara Brae."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「直到那些古老血脈的勇士，\n懷揣著熱血與對黃金的渴望，\n最終奪回並拯救了斯卡拉布雷。」

English (遊戲原文):
A LETTER RECEIVED



Greetings, heroes! My name is Saradon, a wizard of some fame and little fortune. Every bard in Caith sings of your victory over Mangar and his vile horde in Skara Brae. Thus, even though we have never met, I am seeking you out.



Our land now faces a danger even greater than Mangar - an evil that could leave it open to invasion and bloody conquest. The Destiny Wand, which has kept us safe for seven hundred years, has been shattered into seven fragments by the Archmage Lagoth Zanta, and those fragments hidden all across the realm. Until you recover them, reforge the wand, and defeat Lagoth Zanta, Caith is in peril. Save her, I beg you.



Now I must hurry, for while I was attempting to glean knowledge of Zanta, he sensed my prying magic, and even now his Lestradae mercenaries approach. I care not for my own safety, but I pray my magic will keep this letter safe until it reaches your hands. May fate smile upon you... and me.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
一封收到的信


致意，英雄們！我的名字是薩拉東，一位小有名氣卻財運不佳的巫師。凱斯境內每位吟遊詩人都傳唱著你們在斯卡拉布雷擊敗曼加及其邪惡大軍的勝利。因此，即使我們素未謀面，我仍設法尋找你們。


我們這片土地如今面臨比曼加更巨大的危險——一種可能讓國門洞開、遭受入侵與血腥征服的邪惡。守護我們七百年之久的命運之杖，已被大法師拉戈斯·贊塔擊碎成七塊碎片，並藏匿於王國各處。在你們尋回碎片、重鑄法杖、擊敗拉戈斯·贊塔之前，凱斯將危在旦夕。我懇求你們，拯救她吧。


我必須趕緊動身了，因為當我試圖窺探贊塔的知識時，他察覺到了我的探查魔法，此刻他的萊斯特拉德傭兵正步步逼近。我不在乎自身安危，但我祈禱我的魔法能保護這封信，直到它送達你們手中。願命運眷顧你們……也眷顧我。

English (遊戲原文):
As I lay dying...



I leave this record so those who come after will know what horrors that the Mad God Tarjan has perpetrated, and so that they will not be lulled into believing that Skara Brae was his sole target.



We held a great festival to celebrate the victory over Mangar. Then Mangar's Master, The Mad God Tarjan, arrived... His shadow ravaged the city and foul creatures burst forth to assault fair Skara Brae. People ran, but Tarjan's minions left none untouched.

 Tarjan gloated that Skara Brae was merely one in a series of conquests that would complete his revenge. He laughed when I promised that the legendary Hawkslayer, and those who defeated Mangar, would return again to triumph. As payment for my threat, he gave a swift twist of his jewelled sword into my belly. 



Tarjan must be stopped, for upon this rests the fate of more than Skara Brae, more than Caith. Failure will mean the extinction of all life - save for the wretched Tarjan and his servile parasites. Pray for success... and life renewed.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
在我垂死之際……


我留下這份記錄，好讓後來者知曉瘋狂之神塔爾揚犯下的恐怖罪行，也讓他們不會誤以為斯卡拉布雷是他唯一的目標。


我們舉辦了一場盛大的慶典，慶祝擊敗曼加的勝利。然後，曼加的主人——瘋狂之神塔爾降臨了……他的陰影蹂躪了城市，邪惡的生物蜂擁而出，襲擊美麗的斯卡拉布雷。人們四處奔逃，但塔爾揚的爪牙無一放過。


塔爾揚得意洋洋地宣稱，斯卡拉布雷只是他完成復仇的一系列征服中的一環。當我誓言傳奇獵鷹殺手以及那些擊敗曼加的人終將歸來、再次獲勝時，他放聲大笑。作為對我這番威脅的報償，他迅速轉動鑲滿寶石的長劍，刺入我的腹部。


必須阻止塔爾揚，因為這關係到的不只是斯卡拉布雷的命運，也不只是凱斯的命運。失敗將意味著所有生命的滅絕——除了可悲的塔爾揚與他那些奴性的寄生蟲。祈求成功……祈求生命重生。

English (遊戲原文):
Come hear the tale of Skara Brae -

A god returned to have his way.

Creatures of darkness, spawn of night,

The Mad One's kin destroyed the site.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
且聽斯卡拉布雷的故事——

一位歸來的神祇，欲遂其意。

黑暗的造物，黑夜的孽種，

狂人之親族，摧毀了此地。

Defenders fell, their bane come true,

Garth, Roscoe, Kylearan too!

As doom approached, the helpless fled.

It did no good, the streets ran red.

守護者隕落，災劫成真，

加斯、羅斯可、凱拉蘭亦同！

末日降臨，無助者四散奔逃。

一切徒勞，街道血流成河。

English (遊戲原文):
Survivors few, they sit and mope,

with but one final ray of hope:

Cross time and space, the legends say,

Heroes, at last! To steal the day!
Chinese (請填寫中文):
倖存者寥寥，坐困愁城，

僅存一線希望之光：

穿越時空，傳說有云，

英雄，終將現身！奪回勝利之日！

English (遊戲原文):
"Welcome, brave heroes. You have succeeded in destroying

the threat to all reality. As you know, to do this, you slipped

the bonds of time, and traveled forbidden routes through that

which has forever been. You pressed your struggle forward

despite danger and death, and you accomplished that which

the gods themselves were unable to do."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「歡迎，勇敢的英雄們。你們成功摧毀了威脅整個現實的危機。如你們所知，為此你們掙脫了時間的束縛，穿越了永恆存在的禁忌路徑。你們不顧危險與死亡，奮力向前推進，完成了眾神本身也無能為力的事。」

English (遊戲原文):
His praise washes over you like a warm ocean wave, and

you feel strength infuse your body. "In doing what you have

done, you have proven yourself worthy of nothing less than

the ultimate reward." He closes his eyes and raises his hands.

"The death of the gods tore reality asunder, but you bound

it up again. The gods of old are dead, therefore I accept you

as my new children. You shall be gods yourselves!"
Chinese (請填寫中文):
他的讚美如溫暖的海浪般洗滌你全身，

你感到力量注入體內。「你們的所作所為，

證明了你們配得上這終極的獎賞。」他閉上雙眼，高舉雙手。

「眾神之死撕裂了現實，但你們將其重新縫合。

舊神已逝，因此我接納你們為我的新子嗣。

你們自己將成為神祇！」

English (遊戲原文):
His eyes open again and you look upon infinity. At once you see

Skara Brae restored to its former beauty. You see beyond it

and the Six cities of the Plains. You see the whole world and 

each of its cultures, and you realize all of it is now your domain.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
他再次睜開雙眼，你望見了無限。你瞬間看到

斯卡拉布雷恢復了昔日的榮光。你看到平原六城

以及更遠之處。你看到整個世界與

其中的每一種文化，你明白這一切如今都是你的領域。

English (遊戲原文):
"And so it came to pass that eight new stars burned in the

night sky. The least of these, the Companion star, was

named Hawkslayer after a hero of legend. The other seven,

together known as the Company of Heroes, are each

named for one of the New Gods. Each night they can be seen

is betokened a good night, and adventurers know these gods

smile especially upon them..."
Chinese (請填寫中文):
「於是，八顆新星在夜空中燃燒。

其中最渺小的一顆，名為伴星，

以傳說中的英雄『獵鷹殺手』命名。其餘七顆，

合稱為英雄連星，每一顆都以一位新神之名命名。

每當夜晚能看見它們，

便預示著一個美好的夜晚，冒險者們知道這些神祇

正對他們微笑……」

English (遊戲原文): -- excerpt from The Gospel of the New Gods (Chap I, Verses 5-9)
Chinese (請填寫中文): ——摘錄自《新神福音書》（第一章，第五至九節）

English (遊戲原文): Quitting now will lose any unsaved progress because you cannot autosave outside of the Guild while Legacy Mode Save-At-Guild is active in Tales of the Unknown or The Destiny Knight. Do you wish to quit anyway?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 現在離開將會遺失所有未存檔的進度，因為在《未知傳奇》或《天命勇士》中啟用「公會存檔傳承模式」時，無法在公會外自動存檔。你確定要離開嗎？

English (遊戲原文): Quitting now will lose any unsaved progress because you cannot autosave during an active death snare event. Do you wish to quit anyway?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 現在離開將會遺失所有未存檔的進度，因為在死亡陷阱事件進行中無法自動存檔。你確定要離開嗎？

English (遊戲原文): Quitting now will lose any unsaved progress because you cannot autosave during combat. Do you wish to quit anyway?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 現在離開將會遺失所有未存檔的進度，因為在戰鬥中無法自動存檔。你確定要離開嗎？

English (遊戲原文): Quitting now will lose any unsaved progress because you cannot autosave during special events, or shops. Do you wish to quit anyway?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 現在離開將會遺失所有未存檔的進度，因為在特殊事件或商店中無法自動存檔。你確定要離開嗎？

English (遊戲原文): You cannot save during a death snare! They are the ultimate challenge...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 死亡陷阱進行中無法存檔！這是最終極的挑戰……

English (遊戲原文): You cannot save during special events, or shops
Chinese (請填寫中文): 特殊事件或商店中無法存檔

English (遊戲原文): Each character has their own inventory and gold to manage. Gold and items will need to be pooled and traded between characters. Each character can hold up to 16 items at a time, less if Misc Game Differences is enabled.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 每個角色都有自己的道具欄與金幣需要管理。金幣與物品需要在角色之間集中分配與交易。每個角色最多可攜帶 16 件物品，若啟用「雜項遊戲差異」則數量更少。

English (遊戲原文): With Save At Guild Only enabled, saving the game will only be possible when the party are in an adventurers guild or camp. Autosave will only fire when entering a guild. With Misc Game Differences also enabled, BT3 will still allow saving anywhere, since the original game introduced a save game option.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 啟用「僅在公會存檔」後，只有在冒險者公會或營地時才能儲存遊戲。自動存檔僅在進入公會時觸發。若同時啟用「各代遊戲差異」，BT3 仍允許在任何地方存檔，因為原版遊戲已提供存檔選項。

English (遊戲原文):
Enables differences between each game. These include:

- SPECIAL SLOT for monsters only in BT1.

- No archery in BT1.

- No item charges in BT1, instead items have a small chance to disappear on each use.

- 8 slot inventory in BT1 and 10 slots in BT2.

- Wine Skins only available in BT3.

- Rogue identifying items only available in BT3.

- Items and Spells adjusted to match each game.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
啟用各代遊戲之間的差異。包括：

- BT1 中怪物專用的特殊欄位。

- BT1 中無弓箭。

- BT1 中物品無充能次數，改為每次使用有低機率消失。

- BT1 道具欄為 8 格，BT2 為 10 格。

- 酒囊僅在 BT3 中可用。

- 盜賊鑑定物品僅在 BT3 中可用。

- 物品與法術已調整以符合各代遊戲。

English (遊戲原文):
Enable the full XP requirements from the originals, and also some exploits that helped with levelling.

- Up to twice the XP needed for each level.

- Allows party attack to be initiated anywhere.

- Enabled shop buy and sell any charged item.

- All game events and battles are now redoable.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
啟用原始版本完整的經驗值需求，以及一些有助於升級的漏洞。

- 每個等級所需的經驗值最多增加兩倍。

- 允許在任何地點發起隊伍攻擊。

- 啟用商店買賣任何已充能的物品。

- 所有遊戲事件與戰鬥現在皆可重複進行。

English (遊戲原文): Grab some grid paper and map the levels yourself. This was a big part of the 1980s experience and why all the spinners and teleports in dungeons exist. For those that have the time and temperament, this can be a rewarding experience. If Misc Game Differences is also enabled, then the Thief of Fate (BT3) will still allow for a simplified journal, just showing map walls and doors, as the original game introduced an automap feature.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 拿些方格紙，親手繪製地圖吧。這是1980年代體驗的重要一環，也是地下城中存在這麼多迷向器和傳送門的原因。對於有時間和耐心的玩家來說，這會是一段很有成就感的體驗。如果同時啟用「雜項遊戲差異」，那麼《命運之賊》(BT3)仍會提供簡化的日誌，僅顯示地圖牆壁和門，因為原始遊戲已引入了自動地圖功能。

English (遊戲原文): Enabling this setting restores the way song magic used to work in the originals.\n\nSongs in Tales of the Unknown (BT1) and The Destiny Knight (BT2) revert to having their strength vary with dungeon difficulty. Songs in the Thief of Fate (BT3) have their strength vary with level of the bard that is singing.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 啟用此設定會恢復歌曲魔法在原始版本中的運作方式。\n\n在《未知傳奇》(BT1)和《天命勇士》(BT2)中，歌曲的強度會隨地下城難度而變化。在《命運之賊》(BT3)中，歌曲的強度則隨吟唱詩人的等級而變化。

English (遊戲原文): On some platforms, such as the Commodore 64 (C64), it was possible to use items, that were not equipped, in combat. This has an especially large impact on bards, choosing to blow horns, or magic users in the Thief of Fate (BT3) using harmonic gems. Enabling this option also removes the ability to equip or unequip items during combat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在某些平台上，例如Commodore 64 (C64)，可以在戰鬥中使用未裝備的物品。這對選擇吹響號角的吟遊詩人，或在《命運之賊》(BT3)中使用和諧寶石的魔法使用者影響尤其巨大。啟用此選項也會移除在戰鬥中裝備或卸下物品的能力。

English (遊戲原文): The remaster adds some hints and random gear rewards to be found by searching the empty houses in cities. Ticking this option will remove those and empty houses will just be for finding random groups of enemies to fight, or the occasional dungeon entrance. This makes gaining the first few character levels just a little harder.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 重製版在城市中搜索空屋時，會加入一些提示和隨機裝備獎勵。勾選此選項將移除這些獎勵，空屋只會用來尋找隨機的敵人群戰鬥，或偶爾發現地下城入口。這會讓前幾個角色等級的升級過程稍微困難一些。

English (遊戲原文): Your first three dungeons should be the sewers, the catacombs and the castle (in that order). Each is progressively tougher.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你最初的三個地下城應該是下水道、墓穴與城堡（依此順序）。每個都比前一個更難。

English (遊戲原文): You can adjust the speed that messages scroll in combat in gameplay settings.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你可以在遊戲設定中調整戰鬥中訊息滾動的速度。

English (遊戲原文): Avoid traps. Higher level rogues are excellent at opening chests, but when in doubt use the 'Trapzap' spell.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 小心陷阱。高等級的盜賊非常擅長開啟寶箱，但若有疑慮，請使用「陷阱轟炸」法術。

English (遊戲原文): Be sure that your party is fully healed before entering a new dungeon.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 進入新地下城前，務必確保你的隊伍完全恢復生命值。

English (遊戲原文): Remember that each succeeding level goes UP in a tower or castle and DOWN in a dungeon.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 請記住，在塔或城堡中，每往上一層就是「向上」；在地下城中，每往下一層就是「向下」。

English (遊戲原文): Good maps will show you the logical spots for secret doors and secret rooms.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 好的地圖會顯示出秘密門與秘密房間的合理位置。

English (遊戲原文): Use your spells and Bard songs to lower the armor class of your entire party. The lower the better.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使用你的法術與吟遊詩人之歌來降低整個隊伍的防禦等級。越低越好。

English (遊戲原文): You can minimize damage by killing off all but one monster in either of the first two attacking groups.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你可以透過殺死前兩組攻擊怪物中其中一組的所有怪物，只留下一隻，來將傷害降到最低。

English (遊戲原文): Treat the undead with respect. In other words, kill them quickly.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 對待亡靈要心存敬畏。換句話說，快點殺了它們。

English (遊戲原文): Be prepared to die a lot with level 1 and 2 characters. Especially at night. Especially when you don't have any weapons and are just walking to Garth's Shoppe.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 做好準備，等級 1 和 2 的角色會經常死亡。尤其是在夜間。尤其是當你沒有任何武器，只是走去加斯的商店時。

English (遊戲原文): Monsters are smart. They usually attack your most vulnerable characters first, unless one of your members represents a significant threat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 怪物很聰明。它們通常會先攻擊你最脆弱的角色，除非你的某個成員構成重大威脅。

English (遊戲原文): Beware the Doppelganger monster. It enters your party and looks just like one of your members.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 當心變身怪。它會混入你的隊伍，看起來就像你的其中一個成員。

English (遊戲原文): Develop a Sorcerer fast. They are very useful in dungeons.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 快點培養一名術士。他們在地下城中非常有用。

English (遊戲原文): Don't venture too far into any dungeon without your maximum spell points. A good rule is to leave a dungeon when you are down to one quarter of your maximum spell points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在法術點數未滿的情況下，不要深入任何地下城。一個好規則是：當你的法術點數降到最大值四分之一時，就該離開地下城。

English (遊戲原文): Manage your spell points carefully. Don't waste a spell if you can accomplish the same thing without magic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 謹慎管理你的法術點數。如果能不用魔法就達成同樣效果，就不要浪費法術。

English (遊戲原文): Locate traps, second sight and sorcerer sight spells all identify traps within 30 feet.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「偵測陷阱」、「第二視界」和「術士視界」法術都能識別 30 呎內的陷阱。

English (遊戲原文): Cast a long lasting Bard spell right before entering a tavern. It's like getting a free spell.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 進入酒館前先施放一個持續時間長的吟遊詩人法術，就像免費獲得一個法術一樣。

English (遊戲原文): Generally, the more expensive the item is, the better it works. Almost like real life.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一般來說，物品越昂貴，效果越好。這幾乎跟現實生活一樣。

English (遊戲原文): There are no cursed or bad items, unlike real life.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡沒有被詛咒或劣質的物品，跟現實生活不一樣。

English (遊戲原文): Don't be stingy. Equip your fighters with the best armor, weapon, shield, helmet and gauntlets money can buy. After all, they can't take it with them.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 別吝嗇。用金錢能買到最好的盔甲、武器、盾牌、頭盔和護手來裝備你的戰士。畢竟，他們死後也帶不走。

English (遊戲原文): Experiment with all items you find to determine their capabilities. Magical items are key to success.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 嘗試使用你找到的所有物品，以了解它們的能力。魔法物品是成功的關鍵。

English (遊戲原文): The tavern on Rakhir Street is the only tavern that serves wine. And that wine "goes down" easily. Good luck!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 拉基爾街上的酒館是唯一供應葡萄酒的酒館。而且那種葡萄酒很容易「下肚」。祝好運！

English (遊戲原文): If your spell points aren't recharging fast enough, go see Roscoe. But be prepared for electrifyingly high fees.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 如果你的法術點數恢復得不夠快，就去找羅斯柯。但要做好準備，他的收費高得嚇人。

English (遊戲原文): Temples are divine places of resurrection and complete healing. In fact, this is the only place to cure characters who have been withered or drained of experience.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 神廟是進行復活和完全治療的神聖場所。事實上，這是唯一能治癒衰老或經驗耗盡角色的地方。

English (遊戲原文): Gold you receive in battles is pooled for the party and can be used to buy weapons, heal your wounds or regenerate your spell points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 戰鬥中獲得的金幣會歸入隊伍共有，可用來購買武器、治療傷口或恢復法術點數。

English (遊戲原文): After battles you may find items which go into a pool for anyone to use. Sell or drop items if your inventory gets too full.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 戰鬥後你可能會找到物品，這些物品會進入共用庫存，供任何人使用。如果你的道具欄太滿，就賣掉或丟棄物品。

English (遊戲原文): Every mage should know where Roscoe's Energy Emporium is. He will regenerate your magic if the price is right.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 每個法師都應該知道羅斯柯的能量商店在哪裡。只要價格合適，他就會幫你恢復魔力。

English (遊戲原文): If you cannot kill off all the magic-using monsters, you may want to cast anti-magic spells to protect against illusions, possessions and other spells.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 如果你無法殺光所有會使用魔法的怪物，你可能需要施放反魔法法術來抵禦幻象、附身和其他法術。

English (遊戲原文): It might be a good idea to stay close to a Temple at night, so you can quickly heal any wounds.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 晚上最好待在神廟附近，這樣可以快速治療任何傷口。

English (遊戲原文): Wizards are extremely important in advanced levels; they can summon demons, extremely powerful specials.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 巫師在高級階段極其重要；他們可以召喚惡魔，這是極其強大的特殊能力。

English (遊戲原文): Items that appear in the inventory in red cannot be used by that character class.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 道具欄中以紅色顯示的物品，該角色職業無法使用。

English (遊戲原文): Don't be shy about using magic in combat. When in doubt, blast 'em with magic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在戰鬥中不要吝於使用魔法。當你猶豫不決時，就用魔法轟炸他們。

English (遊戲原文): Trapzap spell disarms all traps within 30 feet.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「陷阱解除」法術能解除 30 呎內的所有陷阱。

English (遊戲原文): You may wish to drop by a tavern to wet the whistle of your Bard.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你可能想順道去酒館，讓你的吟遊詩人潤潤喉。

English (遊戲原文): Deeper dungeons require a higher Hide-In-Shadows and Critical Strike skill
Chinese (請填寫中文): 更深層的地下城需要更高的「陰影躲藏」和「暴擊」技能。

English (遊戲原文): There's dungeons deep underneath Skara Brae... sewers, catacombs, the castle and more, each more dangerous than the one before.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 斯卡拉布雷地下深處有地下城……下水道、地下墓穴、城堡等等，一個比一個危險。

English (遊戲原文): Explore and map every square in every maze. There are 'Magic Mouths' that give hints. There are 1-of-a-kind magic items and spell regeneration zones. Good maps will show you the logical spots for secret doors and secret rooms, too.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 探索並繪製每個迷宮中每一格的地圖。有些「魔法之口」會提供提示。還有獨一無二的魔法物品和法術恢復區域。好的地圖也會顯示出暗門和密室可能存在的合理位置。

English (遊戲原文): Avoid traps. Higher level rogues are excellent at opening chests, but when in doubt use the 'Trapzap' spell.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 避開陷阱。高等級的盜賊非常擅長開啟寶箱，但如果不確定，就使用「陷阱解除」法術。

English (遊戲原文): You can use 'Trapzap' to disarm any traps you encounter.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你可以使用「陷阱解除」來解除你遇到的任何陷阱。

English (遊戲原文): Be sure that your party is fully healed before entering a new dungeon.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在進入新的地下城之前，務必確保你的隊伍完全恢復。

English (遊戲原文): When you are finding your bearings in a maze, remember that each succeeding level goes UP in a tower or castle and DOWN in a dungeon.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 當你在迷宮中尋找方向時，請記住，在塔樓或城堡中，每下一層是往上走；在地下城中，每下一層是往下走。

English (遊戲原文): Your highest dexterity character will attack earliest in combat. Target particularly nasty monsters with spells and attacks from high dexterity characters first. Your less dexterous characters may not survive long enough to get in a first strike.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你敏捷度最高的角色會在戰鬥中最先攻擊。優先讓高敏捷度的角色用法術和攻擊鎖定特別難纏的怪物。你的低敏捷度角色可能撐不到發動先手攻擊的時候。

English (遊戲原文): Use your spells and Bard songs to lower the armor class of your entire party. The lower the better.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 使用你的法術和吟遊詩人之歌來降低整個隊伍的防禦等級。越低越好。

English (遊戲原文): If you are attacked by more than 2 groups of monsters, concentrate on magic users first. If you cannot kill off all the magic-using monsters, you may want to cast anti-magic spells to protect against illusions, possessions and other spells.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 如果你被超過兩組怪物攻擊，優先集中攻擊會使用魔法的敵人。如果你無法殺光所有會使用魔法的怪物，你可能需要施放反魔法法術來抵禦幻象、附身和其他法術。

English (遊戲原文): You can minimize damage by killing off monsters in melee range first. Non-magic users, further than 10' away, will need to advance before they can attack.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你可以先消滅近戰範圍內的怪物，以將傷害降到最低。距離超過 10 呎的非魔法使用者，需要前進才能發動攻擊。

English (遊戲原文): Many of the undead monsters are capable of draining experience levels, turning characters old and gray or even turning characters to stone. Treat the undead with respect. In other words, kill them quickly.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 許多亡靈怪物能夠吸取經驗等級，讓角色變得衰老灰白，甚至將角色石化。請對待亡靈保持敬意。換句話說，快點幹掉牠們。

English (遊戲原文): Be prepared to die a lot with level 1 and 2 characters. Especially at night. Especially when you don't have any weapons and are just walking to Garth's Shoppe. It might even be a good idea to stay close to a Temple at night, so you can quickly heal any wounds.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 做好準備，1級和2級的角色會經常陣亡。尤其是在夜間。尤其是當你沒有任何武器，只是步行前往 Garth 的商店時。夜間最好待在神廟附近，這樣就能快速治療任何傷勢。

English (遊戲原文): Monsters are smart. They usually attack your most vulnerable characters first, unless one of your members represents a significant threat.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 怪物很聰明。牠們通常會先攻擊你最脆弱的角色，除非你的其中一名成員構成重大威脅。

English (遊戲原文): Beware the Doppelganger monster. It enters your party and looks just like one of your members.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 小心變身怪。牠會潛入你的隊伍，看起來就跟你的其中一名成員一模一樣。

English (遊戲原文): Develop a Sorcerer fast. They are very useful in dungeons. Wizards are extremely important in advanced levels; they can summon demons, extremely powerful specials. Develop an Archmage, too. You'll need one; you'll want more.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 盡快培養一名術士。他們在地下城中非常有用。巫師在高級階段極其重要；他們可以召喚惡魔，這些是極其強大的特殊能力。也培養一名大法師吧。你會需要一個；而且你會想要更多。

English (遊戲原文): Don't venture too far into any dungeon without your maximum spell points. A good rule is to leave a dungeon when you are down to one quarter of your maximum spell points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在法術點數未達最大值時，不要冒險深入任何地下城太遠。一個好規則是：當你的法術點數降到最大值四分之一時，就該離開地下城。

English (遊戲原文): Manage your spell points carefully. Don't waste a spell if you can accomplish the same thing without magic. Torches, for example, often work as well as magic light spells. On the other hand, don't be shy about using magic in combat. When in doubt, blast 'em with magic.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 謹慎管理你的法術點數。如果不用魔法也能達成同樣效果，就不要浪費法術。例如，火把通常和魔法照明法術一樣好用。另一方面，在戰鬥中也不要吝於使用魔法。如果猶豫不決，就用魔法轟炸他們。

English (遊戲原文): Locate traps, second sight and sorcerer sight spells all identify traps within 30 feet. Trapzap spell disarms all traps within 30 feet.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「偵測陷阱」、「真知術」和「術士之眼」法術都能在 30 呎內辨識陷阱。「陷阱解除」法術能解除 30 呎內的所有陷阱。

English (遊戲原文): Cast a long lasting Bard spell right before entering a tavern. It's like getting a free spell.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在進入酒館前，先施放一個持續時間長的吟遊詩人法術。這就像免費獲得一個法術一樣。

English (遊戲原文): Generally, the more expensive the item is, the better it works.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 一般來說，物品越昂貴，效果就越好。

English (遊戲原文): There are no cursed or bad items.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡沒有詛咒或不良的物品。

English (遊戲原文): Don't be stingy. Equip your fighters with the best armor, weapon, shield, helmet and gauntlets money can buy. After all, they can't take it with them.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 別吝嗇。用金錢能買到的最好盔甲、武器、盾牌、頭盔和護手來裝備你的戰士。畢竟，他們死後也帶不走。

English (遊戲原文): Experiment with all items you find to determine their capabilities. Magical items are key to success. Remember that an item may only be usable for certain characters and classes, so trade items around if you have to.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 嘗試使用你找到的所有物品，以確定它們的能力。魔法物品是成功的關鍵。請記住，物品可能只對特定角色和職業可用，所以必要時請互相交換物品。

English (遊戲原文): Seek out the Review Board. You need to visit there to be awarded new levels and spells.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 尋找仲裁委員會。你需要去那裡才能獲得新的等級和法術。

English (遊戲原文): By the way, the tavern on Rakhir Street is the only tavern that serves wine. And that wine "goes down" easily. You may wish to drop by to wet the whistle of your Bard. Good luck!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 順便一提，拉基爾街上的那間酒館是唯一供應葡萄酒的酒館。而且那種酒「很容易下肚」。你可能想順道去那裡，讓你的吟遊詩人潤潤喉。祝好運！

English (遊戲原文): If your spell points aren't recharging fast enough, go see Roscoe. But be prepared for electrifyingly high fees.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 如果你的法術點數恢復得不夠快，就去找羅斯柯。但要做好準備，他會收取高得嚇人的費用。

English (遊戲原文): Temples are divine places of resurrection and complete healing. In fact, this is the only place to cure characters who have been withered or turned to stone.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 神廟是進行復活和完全治療的神聖場所。事實上，這裡是唯一能治癒衰老或石化角色的地方。

English (遊戲原文): Gold you receive in battles is pooled for the party and can be used to buy weapons, heal your wounds or regenerate your spell points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你在戰鬥中獲得的金幣會匯入隊伍的共用資金，可以用來購買武器、治療傷口或恢復法術點數。

English (遊戲原文): After battles you may find items which go into a pool for anyone to use. Sell or drop items if your party inventory gets too full.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 戰鬥後你可能會找到物品，這些物品會進入一個任何人都能使用的共用庫存。如果你的隊伍庫存太滿，就賣掉或丟棄物品。

English (遊戲原文): Every mage should know where Roscoe's Energy Emporium is. He will regenerate your magic if the price is right.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 每個法師都應該知道羅斯柯的能量商店在哪裡。只要價格合適，他就會幫你恢復魔力。

English (遊戲原文): The temples can heal your wounds, cure your illnesses and even bring back the dead for the right donation.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 神廟可以治療你的傷口、治癒你的疾病，甚至只要捐獻足夠的香油錢，就能讓死者復活。

English (遊戲原文): Deeper dungeons require a higher hide-in-shadows skill. Keep upgrading your skill to 100 and beyond or you will be discovered more often.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 更深層的地下城需要更高的「藏身陰影」技能。持續將你的技能提升到 100 或更高，否則你將更常被發現。

English (遊戲原文): Search all the buildings in all the towns. There is a dungeon to be found in every town, starting with Tangramayne.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 搜索所有城鎮中的所有建築物。從坦格拉梅恩開始，每個城鎮都有一個地下城可以探索。

English (遊戲原文): The forests of the Realm hide a variety of interesting buildings, huts and strongholds (as well as a host of evildoers). Crypts can also be found in the wilderness and are worth investigating if you can gain access.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 王國的森林中隱藏著各種有趣的建築物、小屋和據點（以及一大群邪惡之徒）。在荒野中也能找到墓穴，如果你能設法進入，這些地方值得調查。

English (遊戲原文): Be sure to tip the bartender. He has valuable information to give you. Try giving him more money when you can afford it.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 記得給酒保小費。他有寶貴的情報可以提供給你。當你負擔得起時，試著給他更多錢。

English (遊戲原文): Searching the room, you discover some parchment from the Adventurer's Guild Handbook. It reads:\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 搜索房間時，你發現了一些來自冒險者公會手冊的羊皮紙。上面寫著：\n\n

English (遊戲原文): There is a scrap of parchment from the Adventurer's Guild Handbook here. It reads:\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這裡有一張來自冒險者公會手冊的羊皮紙碎片。上面寫著：\n\n
這裡有一張便條，上面寫著：\n

Chinese (請填寫中文): 你在一個空無一物的建築物裡。

English (遊戲原文): You search the room for anything useful...\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你搜索房間尋找任何有用的東西……\n\n

English (遊戲原文): Thou art in the Guild of Adventurers.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 汝身處冒險者公會之中。

English (遊戲原文): Thou art in the camp of Skara Brae.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你身處斯卡拉布雷的營地。

English (遊戲原文):
All hail to the heroes of Skara Brae.

Now that Mangar is dead, this blizzard will surely lift soon.

Your work here is done. I wish you much luck in your future adventures in the land of Caith!
Chinese (請填寫中文):
向斯卡拉布雷的英雄們致敬。

既然曼加爾已死，這場暴風雪肯定很快就會平息。

你在這裡的任務已經完成。祝你在凱斯大陸的未來冒險中好運連連！

English (遊戲原文): Mangar protects himself using a riddle with 7 answers, and you found them all! Your skills are without limit. You will surely be able to rid us of this evil soon!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 曼加爾用一個有七個答案的謎語保護自己，而你找到了所有答案！你的技藝無可限量。你一定能很快為我們除去這個邪惡！

English (遊戲原文): You found the Mad God and defeated him?! That's amazing. Our faith in you was not wasted!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你找到了瘋狂之神並擊敗了他？！太驚人了。我們對你的信任沒有白費！

English (遊戲原文): I see you've found an entrance into the catacombs. Your progress is impressive!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 我看見你找到了一個進入地下墓穴的入口。你的進展令人印象深刻！

English (遊戲原文): What is this? The statue turned into a Samurai and attacked you? This must be Mangar's evil magic. There are guardian statues throughout the town and some are undoubtedly even tougher to defeat!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這是怎麼回事？雕像變成了一個武士並攻擊了你？這一定是曼加爾的邪惡魔法。城鎮各處都有守護雕像，有些無疑更難擊敗！

English (遊戲原文): An evil wizard Mangar is threatening the town. He's brought down a blizzard upon us and all manner of evil creatures are wandering about.\n\nTake a party out into town, explore everywhere for clues. You MUST find a way to stop him!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 邪惡巫師曼加爾正威脅著這座城鎮。他給我們帶來了暴風雪，各種邪惡生物四處遊蕩。\n\n帶一支隊伍到鎮上去，四處探索尋找線索。你必須找到阻止他的方法！

English (遊戲原文): Your party is full. Try removing some members before you add a new member.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你的隊伍已滿。請先移除一些成員，再新增新成員。

English (遊戲原文): The roster of heroes is empty. So sad...\n\nYou should go and create some new characters right away!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 英雄名冊空空如也。真是令人傷心……\n\n你應該立刻去創建一些新角色！

English (遊戲原文): There is nobody in your party, and so you cannot remove a member. Have a good day!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你的隊伍中沒有人，因此無法移除成員。祝你有美好的一天！

English (遊戲原文): Did you mean to delete everyone in the heroes roster? Because they are all gone... forever!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你確定要刪除英雄名冊中的所有角色嗎？因為他們將全部消失……永遠消失！

English (遊戲原文): That's not a party worth saving!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 這支隊伍根本不值得拯救！

English (遊戲原文): You need some active party members before you can enter the wilderness!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你必須先有活躍的隊伍成員，才能進入荒野！

English (遊戲原文): You need some active party members before you can enter the city!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你必須先有活躍的隊伍成員，才能進入城市！
將成員從你的隊伍中移除\n

English (遊戲原文): You cannot delete a character that is in your Party. {0} is not amused.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你無法刪除正在隊伍中的角色。{0} 對此很不高興。

English (遊戲原文): You cannot delete a character holding quest items... you will need to empty their inventory first.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你無法刪除持有任務物品的角色……你必須先清空他們的道具欄。

English (遊戲原文): Are you sure you wish to delete the party: {0}?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你確定要刪除隊伍：{0} 嗎？
