English (遊戲原文): Enter a name for your party:
Seek out Brilhasti ap Tarj beneath the Mad God's Temple!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 前往瘋狂之神神殿下方，尋找 Brilhasti ap Tarj！

English (遊戲原文): The old man in the Review Board scratches his head. "Yes, you are the prophesied ones, but you have come too early. No matter."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 仲裁委員會的老人搔了搔頭。「沒錯，你們就是預言中的人，但你們來得太早了。不過沒關係。」

English (遊戲原文): "Beneath Skara Brae you will find one of Tarjan's devotees. Brilhasti ap Tarj is a foul Necromancer, and his life impedes my efforts to stave off disaster."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「在 Skara Brae 地下，你們會找到 Tarjan 的一名信徒。Brilhasti ap Tarj 是個邪惡的死靈法師，他的存在阻礙了我阻止災難的努力。」

English (遊戲原文): "You may enter the Catacombs under the Mad God's Temple by uttering his master's name... 'Tarjan'"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「只要說出他主人的名字……『Tarjan』，你們就能進入瘋狂之神神殿下的墓穴。」

English (遊戲原文): "Destroy Brilhasti ap Tarj, then return to me for your true quest."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「消滅 Brilhasti ap Tarj，然後回來找我，接受你們真正的任務。」

English (遊戲原文): "Go to Arboria and retrieve for me Valarian's Bow and The Arrows of Life. The Chronomancer spell, Apport Arboria, cast at the Twilight Copse will get you there. The spell, Reditus Arboria, cast at the point where you arrived, will return you to Caith."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「前往 Arboria，為我取回瓦拉里安之弓與生命之箭。在暮光林地施展時空術士法術『傳送 Arboria』即可抵達該處。在你抵達的地點施展『回歸 Arboria』法術，則會將你送回 Caith。」

English (遊戲原文): "Welcome ye children of the prophecy. Upon your shoulders falls a great weight, for you must embark on what will be your greatest adventure ever."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「歡迎你們，預言的子民。一副重擔將落在你們肩上，因為你們必須踏上此生最偉大的冒險。」

English (遊戲原文): "That which has laid waste to Skara Brae is an ancient evil recently released. It threatens to destroy all reality and time as it has wrought havoc on Skara Brae."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那對斯卡拉布雷造成浩劫的，是最近釋放出的遠古邪惡。它已在斯卡拉布雷肆虐，並威脅要毀滅所有的現實與時間。」

English (遊戲原文): "If you cannot stop it, it will consume the universe. If you do stop it, you will be rewarded beyond all your dreams."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「如果你們無法阻止它，它將吞噬整個宇宙。如果你們成功阻止了它，你們將獲得超越一切夢想的獎賞。」

English (遊戲原文): "Prepare thyselves, and hasten to the place of trees, for it is most like the first dimension you must sojourn in to blunt the evil."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「準備好你們自己，趕往樹木之地，因為那裡最像你們必須首先停留以削弱邪惡的第一個次元。」

English (遊戲原文): "Arboria, the home of Valarian the bold, is reached through using powerful magic that only a Chronomancer can control."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「阿博利亞，勇敢者瓦拉利安的家鄉，必須透過只有時空術士才能操控的強大魔法才能抵達。」

English (遊戲原文): "Bring to me Valarian's Bow and The Arrows of Life if Valarian will not return here with you."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「如果瓦拉利安不願隨你們回來，就把瓦拉利安之弓和生命之箭帶回來給我。」

English (遊戲原文): "Yes, and be on the lookout for an ally, for you are not the first I have sent on this quest. Though your paths are different, they may cross, and you will do well together."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「是的，並留意尋找一位盟友，因為你們並非我派去執行此任務的第一批人。雖然你們的道路不同，但可能會交會，而你們聯手將會大有可為。」

English (遊戲原文): "Use Apport Gelidia at Cold Peak to travel to Gelidia and retrieve for me the Wand of Power and the Sphere of Lanatir."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「在冷峰使用『阿波特·格利迪亞』前往格利迪亞，為我取回力量之杖與拉納提爾之球。」

English (遊戲原文): The old man takes the news of Valarian's death hard, but he summons a smile to his lips and breathes deeply.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 老人聽聞瓦拉利安的死訊後顯得難以承受，但他強擠出一抹微笑掛在唇邊，深深吸了一口氣。

English (遊戲原文): "You have done well, children, and I take well the news that Hawkslayer has survived this long. Now you are bound for a place far distant."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「你們做得很好，孩子們，而『弒鷹者』能存活至今的消息，我也欣然接受。現在，你們將前往一個遙遠的地方。」

English (遊戲原文): "It is the dimension of magic. It is known as Gelidia and if your Chronomancer is able, I will share the spells to get you there and back again."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那是魔法的次元，被稱為格利迪亞。如果你們的時空術士有能力，我將分享讓你們往返那裡的咒語。」

English (遊戲原文): "I shall teach there Apport Gelidia and Reditus Gelidia. Seek out Cold Peak to the north west, as they will only work there."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「我將在那裡傳授『阿波特·格利迪亞』與『雷迪圖斯·格利迪亞』。前往西北方的冷峰，因為這些法術只在那裡有效。」

English (遊戲原文): "Bring Lanatir with you, or, if you cannot convince him to come, coax from him the Wand of Power and the Sphere of Lanatir."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「帶著拉納提爾一起來，或者，如果你們無法說服他前來，就從他那裡誘出力量之杖與拉納提爾之球。」

English (遊戲原文): Seek out Alliria in Lucencia. The Crystal Spring in the east offers passage to Lucencia using Apport Lucencia. Recover the Crown of Truth and the Belt of Alliria!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「在盧森西亞尋找阿利里亞。東方的水晶泉提供使用『阿波特·盧森西亞』前往盧森西亞的通道。取回真理之冠與阿利里亞之腰帶！」

English (遊戲原文): The old man appears visibly shaken by the news of Lanatir's death. After a long silence he stares off into space and mumbles, "Is it to be that way then?"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 老人聽到拉納提爾的死訊後，明顯地動搖了。經過長時間的沉默，他凝視著遠方，喃喃自語：「事情非得如此嗎？」

English (遊戲原文): His eyes focus upon you again, and a grim look washes over his features. "Now you are bound for Lucencia."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他的目光再次聚焦在你們身上，一抹嚴峻的神色掠過他的面容。「現在，你們將前往盧森西亞。」

English (遊戲原文): "To this end, I will teach thee Apport Lucencia and Reditus Lucencia which you must use at the Crystal Spring to the north east."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「為此，我將教導你們『阿波特·盧森西亞』與『雷迪圖斯·盧森西亞』，你們必須在東北方的水晶泉使用它們。」

English (遊戲原文): "I dare not hope Alliria lives, so I want you to recover the Crown of Truth and the Belt of Alliria. Beware, for she had a jealous consort, and he will protect her as best he can."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「我不敢奢望阿利里亞還活著，所以我希望你們取回真理之冠與阿利里亞之腰帶。小心，因為她有一位善妒的伴侶，他會盡其所能地保護她。」

English (遊戲原文): "Get thee to Kinestia and recover The Hammer of Wrath and Ferofist's Helm. Your path begins in the Dwarven Mines to the south west!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「前往基內斯蒂亞，取回憤怒之錘與費羅菲斯特之頭盔。你們的道路始於西南方的矮人礦坑！」

English (遊戲原文): The old man's look of grim determination withstands news of Alliria's death, but the information saps some of his strength.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 老人臉上堅毅決絕的神情承受住了阿利里亞死訊的打擊，但這個消息仍削弱了他的一些力量。

English (遊戲原文): "Quickly then, my children, to distant Kinestia!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「那麼，快去吧，我的孩子們，前往遙遠的基內斯蒂亞！」

English (遊戲原文): "Learn now, Apport Kinestia and Reditus Kinestia, which will take you to Ferofist in Kinestia if cast from the Dwarven Mines in the south west."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「現在學會『阿波特·基內斯蒂亞』與『雷迪圖斯·基內斯蒂亞』，若在西南方的矮人礦坑施放，它們將帶你們前往基內斯蒂亞的費羅菲斯特那裡。」

English (遊戲原文): "You must return here with The Hammer of Wrath and Ferofist's Helm. I know Ferofist yet lives, but I cannot be sure of how long he will survive."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「你們必須帶著憤怒之錘與費羅菲斯特之頭盔回到這裡。我知道費羅菲斯特還活著，但我無法確定他還能存活多久。」

English (遊戲原文): "Hurry, the pace quickens, and the outlook is horrible if you fail!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「快點，節奏正在加快，如果你們失敗，前景將不堪設想！」

English (遊戲原文): "Get to Tenebrosia! Bring me the Helm of Justice and Sceadu's Cloak. Seek the Shadow Rock!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「前往泰尼布羅西亞！為我帶來正義之盔與斯卡杜之斗篷。尋找暗影之岩！」

English (遊戲原文): The old man's eyes narrow as you tell of Ferofist's end. "An alliance with the dark one, did he say? It is well he realized his folly in the end."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 當你們訴說費羅菲斯特的結局時，老人瞇起了眼睛。「與黑暗者結盟，他是這麼說的嗎？他最終能認清自己的愚行，這很好。」

English (遊戲原文): He pauses a second, and you see utter weariness send a tremor through him. "Now to Tenebrosia for all of you."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他停頓了一秒，你們看見極度的疲憊讓他渾身一顫。「現在，你們所有人都要去泰尼布羅西亞。」

English (遊戲原文): I endow thee with the spells to travel there and return: Apport Tenebrosia and Reditus Tenebrosia. The spell must be cast at Shadow Rock, which can be seen towering in the east."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「我授予你們往返該地的咒語：『阿波特·泰尼布羅西亞』與『雷迪圖斯·泰尼布羅西亞』。此咒語必須在暗影之岩施放，那塊岩石高聳於東方，清晰可見。」

English (遊戲原文): "Remember, in the land where night is day and day is night, nothing is as you know it to be. Paradox lives there - trust no one but yourselves."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「記住，在那個夜晚是白天、白天是夜晚的土地上，一切都與你們所知的不同。矛盾存在於那裡——除了你們自己，誰也別相信。」

English (遊戲原文): "From there I require the Helm of Justice and Sceadu's Cloak."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「從那裡，我需要正義之盔與斯卡杜之斗篷。」

English (遊戲原文): "Off with you to Tarmitia, land of unceasing warfare. From the Vale to the South, thou must cast Apport Tarmitia. Recover Werra's Shield and the Strifespear."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「去吧，前往塔米提亞，那永無止境的戰爭之地。從南方的溪谷，你們必須施放『阿波特·塔米提亞』。取回維拉之盾與紛爭之矛。」

English (遊戲原文): "No!" the old man cries out, "not Sceadu as well. The dark one is utterly mad. Still," the old man smiles, "he burns the chaff while I sow the seed."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「不！」老人喊道，「連 Sceadu 也……黑暗者徹底瘋了。不過，」老人微微一笑，「他焚燒穀殼，而我播下種子。」

English (遊戲原文): "Off with you to Tarmitia, the land of unceasing warfare. A myriad of ages meld together there, and your success depends upon your ability to adapt."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「去 Tarmitia 吧，那片永無止境的征戰之地。無數紀元在那裡交織融合，你的成功取決於你適應變化的能力。」

English (遊戲原文): "Bring me Werra's Shield and the Strifespear."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「把 Werra 之盾與紛爭之矛帶來給我。」

English (遊戲原文): His eyes lose their focus. "It is almost done, the circle is almost joined."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他的眼神失去焦距。「就快完成了，圓環即將閉合。」

English (遊戲原文): The old man lies dead. His last request still plagues your memories. You must endure stench to get to Malefia and help Hawkslayer to defeat the Mad God Tarjan before he destroys all of reality.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 老人倒地身亡。他最後的請求仍縈繞在你記憶中。你們必須忍受惡臭前往 Malefia，幫助 Hawkslayer 擊敗瘋狂之神 Tarjan，以免他毀滅一切現實。

English (遊戲原文): "I know," the old man gurgles, "Werra lies dead."\n\nBlood bubbles up on his lips and joins the dark stains on the rest of his clothing. "I, too, have been slain by the Mad One."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「我知道，」老人咕噥道，「Werra 已死。」\n\n血沫從他唇邊湧出，與衣物上深色的血漬融為一體。「我也被那瘋狂者殺害了。」

English (遊戲原文): "Gather up the prizes you have won, the special ones, those I requested. Hawkslayer has already ventured into Malefia, the land of EVIL."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「收集你們贏得的獎賞——那些特別的、我指定過的物品。Hawkslayer 已經深入 Malefia，那片邪惡之地。」

English (遊戲原文): "I have placed the prizes in the storage building near the entrance of Skara Brae."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「我已將獎賞存放在 Skara Brae 入口附近的儲藏室裡。」

English (遊戲原文): "An acrid stench you must endure to reach the land of EVIL."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「你們必須忍受一股刺鼻惡臭，才能抵達邪惡之地。」

English (遊戲原文): "Get yourselves hence and help him. Destroy the Mad God Tarjan before he destroys all reality!!"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「動身前往，幫助他。在瘋狂之神 Tarjan 毀滅一切現實之前消滅他！！」

English (遊戲原文): With those final words, the old man slumps over, and his body dissolves into a mist that a slight breeze stirs and blows away.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 說完最後這些話，老人癱倒下去，身軀化為一團薄霧，被微風攪動、吹散。

English (遊戲原文): "Yes! You defeated Brillhasti... There is now no doubt. The prophecy begins. Take this experience and let it serve you in the coming battles."\n\nThe old man spreads his arms and your warriors are instantly advanced to level 35, while your mages are given the wisdom of a 5th level Archmage. You are now truly ready for the adventures ahead.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「是的！你擊敗了 Brillhasti……如今已無庸置疑。預言開始了。收下這份經驗，讓它在接下來的戰鬥中助你一臂之力。」\n\n老人張開雙臂，你的戰士們瞬間提升至35級，而你的法師們則獲得了5級大法師的智慧。你現在確實已準備好迎接前方的冒險。

English (遊戲原文): The old man rewards each member 600000 experience points.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 老人獎勵每位成員 600000 點經驗值。

English (遊戲原文): With a wave of his hand, the old man re-energizes all magic users.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 老人揮了揮手，為所有魔法使用者重新補充能量。

English (遊戲原文): The review board lies empty... The last elder is gone and you are alone.\n\nAll that is left is the elder's last words echoing in your mind... to endure the acrid stench that leads to the land of EVIL and to find and destroy the Mad God Tarjan before he destroys all reality!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 仲裁委員會已空無一人……最後一位長老已逝，如今只剩你獨自一人。\n\n耳邊僅存長老最後的話語迴盪……忍受那通往邪惡之地的刺鼻惡臭，找到並摧毀瘋狂之神塔爾揚，在他毀滅所有現實之前！

English (遊戲原文): Thou art in the hall of wizards.\n\nWould thou like...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 汝身處巫師大廳。\n\n汝是否想要……

English (遊戲原文): The last of the guild elders is here.\n\nWould thou like...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 公會長老最後一位在此。\n\n汝是否想要……

English (遊戲原文): Wouldst thou like to be reviewed for:
Chinese (請填寫中文): 汝是否想要接受審核以：

English (遊戲原文): Who seeks the special knowledge of the mystic arts?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 誰在尋求神秘技藝的特殊知識？

English (遊戲原文): Thou art not a spell caster!
You cannot afford to learn this spell. Come back when you have at least {0} gold.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你負擔不起學習此法的費用。當你至少有 {0} 金幣時再來吧。
汝可以花費 {1} 金幣學習 {0}。

English (遊戲原文): {0} cannot afford the {1} gold needed to learn this spell.
Chinese (請填寫中文): {0} 負擔不起學習此法術所需的 {1} 金幣。

English (遊戲原文): The Elders teach you the lore.
The guild elder prepares to weigh thy merits.\n\nWho shall be reviewed?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 公會長老準備評定你的功績。\n\n誰將接受審查？

English (遊戲原文): The elders prepare to weigh thy merits.\n\nWho shall be reviewed?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 長老們準備評定你的功績。\n\n誰將接受審查？

English (遊戲原文): The guild leaders prepare to weigh thy merits.\n\nWho shall be reviewed?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 公會領袖們準備評定你的功績。\n\n誰將接受審查？

English (遊戲原文): The guild elder deems that {0} hath earned a level of advancement...\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 公會長老判定 {0} 已獲得晉升一級的資格……\n\n

English (遊戲原文): The guild elder deems that {0} still needeth {1} experience prior to advancement...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 公會長老判定 {0} 在晉升前仍需 {1} 經驗值……

English (遊戲原文): The elders deem that {0} hath earned a level of advancement...\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 長老們判定 {0} 已獲得晉升一級的資格……\n\n

English (遊戲原文): The elders deem that {0} still needeth {1} experience prior to advancement...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 長老們判定 {0} 在晉升前仍需 {1} 經驗值……

English (遊戲原文): The guild leaders deem that {0} hath earned a level of advancement...\n\n
Chinese (請填寫中文): 公會領袖們判定 {0} 已獲得晉升一級的資格……\n\n

English (遊戲原文): The guild leaders deem that {0} still needeth {1} experience prior to advancement...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 公會領袖們判定 {0} 在晉升前仍需 {1} 經驗值……

English (遊戲原文): You have no members that can be taught new spell levels.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你沒有任何成員能夠學習新的法術等級。

English (遊戲原文): Thou art already at maximum spell level!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你已達到最高法術等級！

English (遊戲原文): Thou cannot learn new spells yet!
{0} spell level {1} will cost thee {2} in gold.
Chinese (請填寫中文): {0} 的法術等級 {1} 將花費你 {2} 金幣。

English (遊戲原文): Yes, I will pay now! Teach me...
Chinese (請填寫中文): 是的，我現在就付費！教導我吧……

English (遊戲原文): No, I will come back later.
You need {0} gold before you can be taught the new spells!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你需要 {0} 金幣才能學習新法術！

English (遊戲原文): The old man has taught you the lore.
The Spell Sages have taught you the lore.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 法術賢者們已傳授你知識。

English (遊戲原文): Which mage seeks to change their class?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 哪位法師尋求轉換職業？

English (遊戲原文): You have no mages in your party that can change class!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你的隊伍中沒有可以轉換職業的法師！

English (遊戲原文): You must know at least 3 spell levels in your present art first.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你必須先精通至少三級現有法術。

English (遊戲原文): There is no class you can change to!
Chinese (請填寫中文): 沒有你可以轉換的職業！

English (遊戲原文): {0} is now a {1} and has learnt the following spells:
Chinese (請填寫中文): {0} 現在是一名 {1}，並學會了以下法術：

English (遊戲原文): Thee understands the sacrifice, dost thou not?\nThee will be stripped of all thy spells and knowledge thereof. Thee will be more powerful than ever before, but more vulnerable as well.\nDost thou accept this sacrifice?
Chinese (請填寫中文): 你明白這項犧牲，對吧？\n你將被剝奪所有法術及相關知識。你將比以往更強大，但也更脆弱。\n你接受這項犧牲嗎？

English (遊戲原文): Know this, the spell to enter Arboria is invoked by uttering 'Apport Arboria' and the spell to return is 'Reditus Arboria'. Be wary, for the spells only work in one place in the land.\n\nThere is a large grove of trees just southwest of Skara Brae. The spell will work there.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 切記，進入阿博利亞的咒語是誦唸「Apport Arboria」，返回的咒語則是「Reditus Arboria」。務必謹慎，因為這些咒語只能在該大陸的特定地點生效。\n\n在斯卡拉布雷西南方有一大片樹林。咒語將在那裡起作用。

English (遊戲原文):
Dragon, dragon,
Why do you lair?
Unfurl your wings, Take to the air!
Soar high above, Far away fly,
Or is that where, You wish to die?
Chinese (請填寫中文):
巨龍，巨龍，
為何蟄伏巢中？
展開雙翼，翱翔蒼穹！
高飛遠颺，遠離此地，
抑或此處，便是你葬身之地？

English (遊戲原文):
Hawkslayer, Hawkslayer,
Why do you ask?
Killing me is a difficult task.
My claws are sharp, my fangs sharper yet,
And my breath flames, let us not forget.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
屠鷹者，屠鷹者，
為何發問？
殺我豈是易事一樁。
利爪鋒銳，尖牙更甚，\莫忘我吐息烈焰焚天。

English (遊戲原文):
Dragon, dragon,
Thou art quite strong.
Your scales are bright and talons are long,
But a duty I have and it is clear:
Whatever it takes, I will drive you from here.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
巨龍啊，巨龍，
你確實強悍無比。
鱗片閃耀，利爪長長，
但我肩負的職責再清楚不過：
無論付出何種代價，我都要將你驅離此地。

English (遊戲原文):
Hawkslayer, Hawkslayer,
Such a brief life.
Have you no wish to again see your wife?
Imagine her tears and grief and despair,
Walk away from this fight, you have not a prayer.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
弒鷹者，弒鷹者，
生命如此短暫。
難道你不想再見到你的妻子？
想想她的淚水、悲傷與絕望，
從這場戰鬥中退開吧，你連一絲勝算都沒有。

English (遊戲原文):
Dragon, dragon,
How wise thou art.
A massive beast with such a kind heart.
I do wish to kiss my wife and my heir,
Pray, fly to the mountains and await me there.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
巨龍啊，巨龍，
你何其睿智。
一頭龐大的野獸，卻有如此仁慈的心。
我確實渴望親吻我的妻子與子嗣，\拜託，飛向群山，在那裡等我。

English (遊戲原文):
Hawkslayer, Hawkslayer,
I thought you were brave.
Here I await you, deep in this cave.
Come, little man, and I'll eat your brain,
Then ravage Lucencia again and again.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
弒鷹者，弒鷹者，
我以為你很勇敢。
我在這洞穴深處等你。
來吧，小個子，我會吃掉你的腦子，
然後一次又一次蹂躪盧森西亞。

English (遊戲原文):
Dragon, dragon,
Great is your heart.
Massive your body, but you are not smart.
The rumble you hear and the dust in the air?
I've closed the cave off and trapped you in there.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
巨龍啊，巨龍，
你的心腸偉大。
身軀龐大，但你並不聰明。
你聽到的轟鳴聲和空中的塵土？
我已經封住了洞穴，把你困在裡面了。

English (遊戲原文):
Hawkslayer, Hawkslayer,
Others will come.
I will wait but I will not succumb.
Hero you are, and incredibly sly,
But the future I know and a hero you'll die...
Chinese (請填寫中文):
弒鷹者，弒鷹者，
其他人會來的。
我會等待，但我不會屈服。
你是英雄，而且極其狡猾，
但我知道未來，你終將以英雄之姿死去……

English (遊戲原文): He was born with the red, red rose,\nSign of his blood, was the link to the past.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他生來帶著那朵紅玫瑰，\n血脈的象徵，是與過去的連結。

English (遊戲原文): In battle, he won the blue, blue rose,\nBlossom of his valor, his weapons were cast.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 在戰鬥中，他贏得了那朵藍玫瑰，\n勇氣的花朵，他的武器因而鑄成。

English (遊戲原文): She was for him the yellow, yellow rose,\nHer spirit divine, his love would always last.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 她對他而言是那朵黃玫瑰，\n她的靈魂神聖，他的愛將永恆不渝。

English (遊戲原文): His pledge he made o'er the white, white rose,\nAnd she accepted it as sooth, and remained his steadfast.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 他在那朵白玫瑰上立下誓言，\n而她視之為真誠，始終堅定不移。

English (遊戲原文): So he made for her the rainbow rose,\nLike Alliria's beauty, a blossom unsurpassed.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 於是他為她打造了那朵彩虹玫瑰，\n如同艾里瑞亞之美，一朵無與倫比的花。

English (遊戲原文):
Mad god, bad god,
Thrust from the sky,
Foolish god, ghoulish god.
We can't hear you cry.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
瘋狂的神，邪惡的神，
被逐出天際，
愚蠢的神，鬼魅般的神。
我們聽不見你的哭喊。

English (遊戲原文):
Rude god, crude god,
Why must you terrify?
Error god, terror god,
Do not your future scry.
Chinese (請填寫中文):

Chinese (請填寫中文): 「嚐一口美酒，或許就會轉為一場現成的冒險，」酒保輕聲笑道。

English (遊戲原文): "Look for the Review Board on Trumpet Street", the barkeep whispers,
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「去喇叭街找仲裁委員會，」酒保低聲說道。

English (遊戲原文): "The gates cannot be scaled, but an entrance always exists", the barkeep stutters.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「城門無法攀越，但總有入口存在，」酒保結結巴巴地說。

English (遊戲原文): "The Stone Golem has been spoken of twofold", the barkeep smiles.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「石魔像的傳聞有兩個版本，」酒保微笑著說。

English (遊戲原文): "The Spectre Snare can draw in even the mightiest", the barkeep grumbles.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「幽魂陷阱連最強大的傢伙都能吸進去，」酒保咕噥道。

English (遊戲原文): "Seek knowledge from the sage," the barkeep smirks.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「去向賢者求取知識，」酒保得意地笑著說。

English (遊戲原文): "The Scarlet Bard likes his ale... Some more coin might help me remember his favorite tavern..." the barkeep chuckles.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「猩紅吟遊詩人喜歡他的麥酒……多給點金幣或許能幫我想起他最愛去哪家酒館……」酒保輕聲笑道。

English (遊戲原文): "The Sage charges 500 in gold for information on magical items," the barkeep whispers.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「賢者對魔法物品的情報收費五百金幣，」酒保低聲說道。

English (遊戲原文): "Seek the Masterkey to pass the gates," the barkeep stutters. "The crypt lies in the wilderness," the barkeep whispers.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「去找萬能鑰匙來通過城門，」酒保結結巴巴地說。「墓穴就在荒野之中，」酒保低聲說道。

English (遊戲原文): "The Scarlet Bard's is often hanging around the Greysword Inn in the south end of Ephesus." the barkeep informs you.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「猩紅吟遊詩人經常待在以弗所南端的灰劍旅店附近。」酒保告訴你。

English (遊戲原文): "The Dreamspell can be learned from the rock," the barkeep grumbles.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「夢之法術可以從岩石中學到，」酒保咕噥道。

English (遊戲原文): "Every city has one dungeon within it," the barkeep grumbles.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「每座城市裡都有一個地下城，」酒保咕噥道。

English (遊戲原文): "Traecham solved his task by chilling; he said 'F.....'," the barkeep mutters.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「崔查姆用冷凍的方式解決了他的任務；他說『該死的……』，」酒保喃喃自語。

English (遊戲原文): "Oscon was sorcerer to Count Waldec... until he turned coat and slew him. Rumour is he’s working with Lagoth Zanta," the barkeep grumbles.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「奧斯康曾是瓦爾德克伯爵的術士……直到他叛變並殺死了伯爵。謠傳他現在和拉戈斯·贊塔合作，」酒保咕噥道。

English (遊戲原文): "There’s a tower in Philippi... it just appeared one day, out of nothing... Some say it comes from another realm, whatever the heck that means," the barkeep whispers.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「腓立比有座塔……有一天就那麼憑空冒了出來……有人說它來自另一個領域，管他那是什麼意思，」酒保低聲說道。

English (遊戲原文): "There's a building in Skara Brae where some of the survivors stashed their goods. It may be helpful," smiles the bartender.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「斯卡拉布雷有棟建築，一些倖存者把他們的東西藏在那裡。或許會有幫助，」酒保微笑著說。

English (遊戲原文): "Be on the lookout for the magic gems, your spellcasters will need them"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「留意那些魔法寶石，你的施法者會需要它們。」

English (遊戲原文): "There lies another bar in Celaria Bree, seek it. It exists only in the dimension called Lucencia."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「在瑟拉利亞·布里還有另一間酒吧，去找它。它只存在於名為盧森西亞的次元中。」

English (遊戲原文): "Seek out the old man in the Review Board. He keeps watch over everything."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「去仲裁委員會找那位老人。他監視著一切。」

English (遊戲原文): "Go to the bard's hall and listen to the songs they sing. They contain useful information."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「前往吟遊詩人大廳，聆聽他們吟唱的歌曲。其中包含有用的資訊。」

English (遊戲原文): "There is said to be a key existing in the Violet Mountains, this will gain access to Cyanis's Tower"
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「據說在紫羅蘭山脈中存在一把鑰匙，它能讓你進入賽亞尼斯之塔。」

English (遊戲原文): "Ack! It's not just a word, but a state of mind."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「啊！這不只是一句話，而是一種心境。」

English (遊戲原文): "The key to finding Sceadu is finding the lock."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「找到斯凱杜的關鍵，就是找到那把鎖。」

English (遊戲原文): "Sceadu can be found in the middle of Nowhere."
Chinese (請填寫中文): 「斯凱杜可以在『無何有之鄉』的中間找到。」

Dead - not alive. This party member has had their health drop to 0. A dead party member can not act in any way. Resurrected by - <u>Temple & Spells</u>.



<smallcaps>Poison</smallcaps> - <color=#F0F0F0FF>POIS</color>

Hit points are slowly drained. This includes while moving and after each round of combat. Cured by - <u>Temple & Spells</u>.



<smallcaps>Petrification</smallcaps> - <color=#F0F0F0FF>STON</color>

Being turned to stone effectively kills the character twice - they will drop to the bottom of the roster, and after being un-petrified they will still need to be resurrected. Cured by - <u>Temple & Spells</u>.



<smallcaps>Insanity</smallcaps> - <color=#F0F0F0FF>NUTS</color>

Insanity causes the loss of control of actions. Insane party members will perform random actions in and out of combat. It is common for the insane to attack other party members at any time. Cured by - <u>Temple & Spells</u>.



<smallcaps>Paralysis</smallcaps> - <color=#F0F0F0FF>PARA</color>

Immobilized from performing actions, including combat. Cured by - <u>Temple & Spells</u>.



<smallcaps>Possession</smallcaps> - <color=#F0F0F0FF>POSS</color>

Being possessed turns the party member against the party. In combat possessed party members will attack members within the party. When not in combat, they will initiate a party attack. Cured by - <u>Temple & Spells</u>.



<smallcaps>Drained</smallcaps> - <color=#F0F0F0FF>DRAIN</color>

The character's level is drained, reducing their level by 1 and reducing their maximum @#HP#. Cured by - <u>Temple</u>.



<smallcaps>Withering</smallcaps> - <color=#F0F0F0FF>OLD</color>

All attributes are reduced to 1. Cured by - <u>Temple & Spells</u>.



<smallcaps>Stunned</smallcaps> - <color=#F0F0F0FF>STUN</color>

Stunned party members miss a round in combat and perform no actions. Cured by - <u>Time</u>.



<smallcaps>Hidden in Shadows</smallcaps> - <color=#F0F0F0FF>HIDE</color>

English (遊戲原文): Like a boxing match, combat is divided into a series of rounds. At the beginning of each round, a decision must be made for what action each character will perform in the upcoming fight. At the beginning of the round a menu of battle options will appear in the , displaying the actions each character can perform the following round. There are several , some are specific. Enemies appear within a range of 10' to 90' feet from the party. Melee range is 10’ feet. Enemies 10' feet away are in melee range and can attack or be attacked with hand-held weapons. can choose to hide in shadows and, if successful, can increase their range by 10’ feet each combat round until they perform an attack. Only the first 4 characters and the first 4 rows of monsters can be attacked physically, as long as they are within . The last 3 characters can only be struck by magical and ranged attacks, and can only attack back, with magic or ranged weapons. This simulates the first 4 party-members being up on the front line of attack, with the last 3 characters acting as backup in case one of the first 4 is killed. The first 4 groups of monsters are in a similar position, they are the only enemies who can attack or be attacked physically. Once all the choices for characters have been entered, the round begins. The most characters or monsters usually make the first strike, but , and also affect this. In evenly matched fights, the outcome often depends on which side gets in the first blow. At the end of a combat round, the monsters that are killed, are removed from the foe’s ranks so their bodies don’t pile up and interfere with battle. A fresh group of monsters may also advance into the first 4 ranks to assist their fellow monsters. If party member dies in combat, they are shuffled to the bottom of the party list. When all of the enemies or party members in combat are dead (whichever comes first) - combat is over. Successfully defeating enemies in combat, awards each party member (characters only) . The amount of XP awarded varies based on difficulty of the fight, the number of enemies defeated and the number of characters who survive. Surviving combat also offers the potential for the party to find a . Combat with enemies occurs both randomly and at set locations. Intra-party combat (Party Attack) can be initiated at almost any time, in case one of the members has become hostile. The rate of scrolling of the combat messages can be .
Chinese (請填寫中文): 就像拳擊比賽一樣，戰鬥分為一系列回合。在每個回合開始時，必須決定每個角色在即將到來的戰鬥中將採取什麼行動。回合開始時，會出現一個戰鬥選項選單，顯示每個角色在下個回合可以執行的行動。有幾種，有些是專屬的。 敵人的出現範圍在距離隊伍10呎到90呎之間。近戰範圍是10呎。距離10呎的敵人處於近戰範圍內，可以使用手持武器攻擊或被攻擊。可以選擇隱入陰影，如果成功，每個戰鬥回合可以增加10呎的距離，直到他們發動攻擊。 只有前4個角色和前4排的怪物可以在近戰範圍內受到物理攻擊。最後3個角色只能受到魔法和遠程攻擊，並且只能使用魔法或遠程武器反擊。這模擬了前4名隊員在前線攻擊，而最後3名角色則作為後備，以防前4名中的一人陣亡。前4組怪物也處於類似的位置，他們是唯一能夠進行物理攻擊或被物理攻擊的敵人。 一旦所有角色的選擇都輸入完畢，回合就開始了。最的角色或怪物通常會先出手，但、和也會影響這一點。在勢均力敵的戰鬥中，結果往往取決於哪一方先出手。 在戰鬥回合結束時，被殺死的怪物會從敵方隊伍中移除，這樣它們的屍體就不會堆積起來干擾戰鬥。新的一組怪物也可能會前進到前4排來協助它們的同類。 如果隊伍成員在戰鬥中死亡，他們會被移到隊伍列表的底部。 當戰鬥中的所有敵人或隊伍成員都死亡時（以先發生者為準）——戰鬥結束。成功擊敗戰鬥中的敵人，會獎勵每個隊伍成員（僅限角色）。獲得的經驗值數量根據戰鬥的難度、擊敗的敵人數量和存活下來的角色數量而變化。在戰鬥中存活下來也提供了隊伍找到的可能性。 與敵人的戰鬥既會隨機發生，也會在固定地點發生。隊伍內部戰鬥（隊伍攻擊）幾乎可以在任何時候發起，以防其中一名成員變得敵對。 戰鬥訊息的滾動速度可以。

English (遊戲原文): The Guild is like a union hall where adventurers hang out, hoping to join a party. This is where a party is formed and where all adventures begin. In Tales of the Unknown (BT1), and The Destiny Knight (BT2), the game starts in the Adventurer's Guild. In Thief of Fate (BT3), the game starts in the . The Adventurer's Guild and the refugee camp are the only spots a party can be formed, characters created, and parties saved. If an entire party roster dies while out and about, they will be transported, still dead, to the guild. By creating and adding a live character, the new very much alive character can then ferry the dead characters to a to resurrect them, or just remove or delete them and create new characters. English (遊戲原文): The Review Board is a group of high level representatives from all 13 different . Upon an in person request, the board will determine whether a character has accumulated enough experience points for advancement to higher . The board teaches new to magic users who qualify for higher too, but charges for this training. Review Boards are closed at night.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
仲裁委員會是由全部13種不同職業的高階代表所組成的團體。

親自提出請求後，委員會將判定一名角色是否累積了足夠的經驗值以晉升至更高的等級。委員會也會傳授新的法術給符合晉升條件的魔法使用者，但會為此收取訓練費用。

English (遊戲原文):
Garth is one of yesterday's almost forgotten heroes, now retired from active adventuring to supply tomorrow's would-be greats. At Garth's shoppe characters can buy armor and weapons, sell items, have items identified, or pool all the party's gold for buying expensive items.



Due to a deal with the city blacksmith, Garth has an infinite supply of basic armor and supplies. But unique Items found in labyrinths, even if sold to Garth, remain in his inventory only until they are sold. Occasionally an item won in combat will remain unidentified. This means that its general type might be apparent such as a shield or ring, but not which exact type, like a dragon shield or ring of power.



Garth can identify items... for a price.



Garth's shop is <u>closed</u> at night.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
Garth是昨日幾乎被遺忘的英雄之一，如今已從活躍的冒險生涯退休，為明日未來的偉大人物提供補給。在Garth的商店裡，角色可以購買護甲與武器、販賣物品、鑑定物品，或集中隊伍的所有金幣來購買昂貴的物品。

由於與城市鐵匠有協議，Garth擁有無限供應的基本護甲與補給品。但在地城中找到的獨特物品，即使賣給Garth，也只會留在他的庫存中直到售出為止。偶爾在戰鬥中獲得的物品會保持未鑑定狀態。這意味著其大致類型可能顯而易見，例如盾牌或戒指，但無法確定具體是哪一種，例如龍盾或力量戒指。

Garth可以鑑定物品……但要收費。

Garth的商店在夜間是關閉的。

English (遊戲原文):
If spell points aren't re-charging fast enough, visit Roscoe's energy emporium. Roscoe will replenish a single or all magic users spell points for a fee. But be prepared for electrifyingly high fees. 



Roscoe can identify specials traits of weapons, armor and items... for a price.



Roscoes is <u>open</u> at night.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
如果法術點數恢復得不夠快，請造訪Roscoe的能量商店。Roscoe會收取費用，為單一或所有魔法使用者的法術點數進行補充。但請準備好面對高得驚人的費用。

Roscoe可以鑑定武器、護甲與物品的特殊屬性……但要收費。

Roscoe的商店在夜間是營業的。

English (遊戲原文): Taverns are favorite places to obtain refreshment and gossip. Watch in taverns - they have a tendency to over tip the bartender and - tip over the barmaid. Order a drink for a bard to refresh the amount they can sing. Taverns are open at night.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
酒館是獲取飲料與八卦的最愛去處。在酒館裡要留意吟遊詩人——他們往往會給酒保太多小費，還會撞倒女侍者。

為吟遊詩人點一杯飲料，可以恢復他們能夠吟唱的次數。

酒館在夜間是營業的。

English (遊戲原文):
Temples are divine places of resurrection and complete healing.



A resurrected character retains all the items, gold and experience points they had before dying, but comes back to life with only 1 hit point.



When they finds out how much it cost to be resurrected, they may turn over their grave.



Temples are <u>open</u> at night.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
神廟是進行復活與完全治療的神聖場所。

被復活的角色會保留死亡前擁有的所有物品、金幣與經驗值，但復活時僅有1點生命值。

當他們發現復活要花多少錢時，可能會氣得在墳墓裡翻身。

神廟在夜間是營業的。

English (遊戲原文):
<width=71f%>Bedder - an old half-elf who reportedly sold his mother to a band of lonely orcs in order to finance his first branch - will deposit gold for safekeeping at any of his bank's branches throughout the realm. Although stingy old Bedder doesn't pay interest on gold deposits, his bank is never robbed and gold can be withdrawn at any time, at any branch.</width><pos=72.5f%><sprite=28/></pos>



Bedder's Bank for the Bold can also safely store some items the party has accumulated through adventuring in the banks safety deposit slots. Unfortunately, Bedder charges a hefty fee to purchase these safety deposit slots. For 10,000 gold he will safely store 10 items. With another 50,000 gold Bedder's bank will store an additional 10 items.



60,000 gold for 20 safety deposit boxes may not be the cheapest thing in the realm, but it is handy.



Banks are <u>closed</u> at night.

<width=71f%>貝德——一名年邁的半精靈，據說為了籌措開設第一家分行，將自己的母親賣給了一群孤獨的獸人——他會在王國各地的銀行分行為冒險隊伍保管金幣。雖然吝嗇的老貝德不支付存款利息，但他的銀行從未被搶劫過，金幣也可隨時在任何分行提取。</width><pos=72.5f%><sprite=28/></pos>


貝德勇者銀行還可以在銀行的安全保管箱中，安全存放冒險隊伍在冒險中累積的一些物品。不幸的是，貝德對購買這些安全保管箱收取高額費用。花費10,000金幣，他可以安全存放10件物品。再花費50,000金幣，貝德的銀行將額外存放10件物品。


花費60,000金幣購買20個安全保管箱，可能不是王國中最便宜的選擇，但確實很方便。


銀行在夜間<u>關閉</u>。

English (遊戲原文):
Casino gambling is a favorite way to relax after a hard day of battling orcs, and casinos are found in almost all of the Realm's cities. The casinos play a game whose closest equivalent is BlackJack.



Casinos are <u>closed</u> at night.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
賭場賭博是在與獸人激戰一天後最受歡迎的放鬆方式，王國中幾乎所有城市都有賭場。賭場玩一種最接近二十一點的遊戲。


賭場在夜間<u>關閉</u>。

Most buildings are unmarked, but some of them are inhabited by corrupt creatures who have skulked in. Don't be afraid to kick in a few doors and find them. There are also handy tips in a few of these.
Chinese (請填寫中文):
大多數建築物都沒有標記，但其中一些被潛入的腐敗生物佔據。不要害怕踢開幾扇門去找出它們。記住，戰鬥對冒險隊伍有益，這是累積足夠經驗值以挑戰越來越強大敵人的唯一途徑。

English (遊戲原文): Portals are holes in the floors and ceilings, and are visible from a distance. The party will not go through a portal merely by standing on it. They must first be instructed to do so. If they jump down through a portal, they will be damaged from the fall unless a levitation spell is active, or an item that conjures the magical equivalent. English (遊戲原文): The skull at the top of the , shows information related to the current effects on the party within dungeons. When the skull's eyes are not glowing, the dungeon has no aura and the party is in a harm free space. When the skull's eyes are glowing, it is in a state where it has information about something in the dungeon that is causing an effect on the party. Red - only a curse, active aura, event timer or general harm is affecting the party. Blue - only a blessing is affecting the party. Purple - a combination of blessings and curses. Curses A curse is a magical effect that is inflicted upon the party to hinder their ability to navigate. Curses can impair vision, stop bard songs and even stop the use of magic. Curses are commonly documented as locations. Blessings Blessings are a magical effect that benefit party members. Blessings are commonly documented as locations of . Active Aura An aura is an invisible magical essence that lurks within the dungeon. The aura can also be built directly into the dungeons structure. Auras can cause anti-magic, anti-apport or anti-phasedoor. Event Timers are time based events. The magic detection skull keeps track of the time left in these events. General Harm Sometimes the party gets into a bit of trouble, the magic detection skull also shows if the party is drowning or freezing.
Chinese (請填寫中文): 位於頂端的骷髏頭，會顯示與地下城中當前影響隊伍的效果相關的資訊。 當骷髏頭的眼睛沒有發光時，表示地下城沒有靈氣，隊伍處於無害的空間。 當骷髏頭的眼睛正在發光時，表示它處於一種狀態，顯示地下城中某物正對隊伍造成影響。 紅色 - 僅有詛咒、活躍靈氣、事件計時器或一般傷害正在影響隊伍。 藍色 - 僅有祝福正在影響隊伍。 紫色 - 祝福與詛咒的組合。 詛咒 詛咒是一種施加在隊伍身上以妨礙其導航能力的魔法效果。詛咒會削弱視力、停止吟遊詩人之歌，甚至阻止魔法的使用。詛咒通常被記錄為地點。 祝福 祝福是一種有益於隊伍成員的魔法效果。祝福通常被記錄為的地點。 活躍靈氣 靈氣是一種潛伏在地下城中的無形魔法本質。靈氣也可能直接建構在地下城的結構中。靈氣可能造成反魔法、反傳送或反相位門。 事件計時器 是基於時間的事件。魔法偵測骷髏頭會追蹤這些事件剩餘的時間。 一般傷害 有時候隊伍會陷入一些麻煩，魔法偵測骷髏頭也會顯示隊伍是否正在溺水或凍僵。

APAR teleports from the parties current location. APAR always travels in the worlds North, East, South and West directions. Not the relative direction of the party. Scry Sight (SCSI) is a helpful spell to identify which direction the party is facing. The direction is also pointed out in the journal, minimap and compass if the appropriate spells are active.
